NAME = re.compile(r'^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$')
USER = re.compile(r'^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$')
GRANTS = {'schema': {'USAGE'}, 'table': {'SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'},
          'sequence': {'USAGE', 'SELECT', 'UPDATE'}}


def normalize_redis_grants(value):
    """Validate typed ACL data, retaining ordered operator command rules."""
    allowed = {'commands', 'keys', 'channels'}
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) - allowed:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
    result = {}
    for key in allowed:
        values = value.get(key, [])
        if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) > 256 or any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item or len(item) > 256 for item in values):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        if key == 'commands':
            if not values or any(not re.fullmatch(r'[+-]?(?:@[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*|[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:\|[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)?)', item) for item in values):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        elif any(any(char.isspace() or ord(char) < 32 for char in item) for item in values):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        result[key] = list(values) if key == 'commands' else sorted(set(values))
    return result


def normalize_clickhouse_grants(values, databases, provider_id):
    if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) > 256:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
    merged = {}
    for value in values:
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {'databaseRef', 'tables', 'privileges'}:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        database = databases.get(value['databaseRef'])
        tables, privileges = value['tables'], value['privileges']
        if (not database or database['providerId'] != provider_id or not isinstance(tables, list) or not tables or len(tables) > 256
                or not isinstance(privileges, list) or not privileges or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in privileges)
                or not set(privileges) <= {'SELECT', 'INSERT', 'CREATE TABLE'}):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        for table in tables:
            name = '*' if table == '*' else identifier(table)
            merged.setdefault((database['name'], name), set()).update(privileges)
    return [dict(database=key[0], table=key[1], privileges=sorted(value)) for key, value in sorted(merged.items())]


def identifier(value, username=False, database=False):
    if (not isinstance(value, str) or not (USER if username or database else NAME).fullmatch(value)
            or value.startswith('pg_') or value in {'postgres', 'template0', 'template1', 'public'}):
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_IDENTIFIER_INVALID')
    return value


def marker(project, provider, library, kind, identity):
    return 'platform.application/v1:' + ':'.join((project, provider, library, kind, identity))


def normalize_grants(values):
    result = []
    if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) > 256:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
    for value in values:
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) - {'schema', 'tables', 'sequences', 'privileges'}:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        schema = identifier(value.get('schema'))
        if 'tables' in value and 'sequences' in value:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        kind = 'table' if 'tables' in value else 'sequence' if 'sequences' in value else 'schema'
        privileges = value.get('privileges')
        if (not isinstance(privileges, list) or not privileges or
                any(not isinstance(p, str) for p in privileges) or not set(privileges) <= GRANTS[kind]):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        objects = value.get('tables' if kind == 'table' else 'sequences', [schema])
        if not isinstance(objects, list) or not objects or len(objects) > 256:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        for name in objects:
            result.append({'kind': kind, 'schema': schema, 'name': identifier(name),
                           'privileges': sorted(set(privileges))})
    merged = {}
    for grant in result:
        key = (grant['kind'], grant['schema'], grant['name'])
        merged.setdefault(key, set()).update(grant['privileges'])
    return [dict(kind=k[0], schema=k[1], name=k[2], privileges=sorted(v)) for k, v in sorted(merged.items())]


def normalize_database_access(values, databases, provider_id, owner):
    """Explicit database-wide policy; never infer creator roles from membership."""
    if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) > 256:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
    result, seen = [], set()
    for value in values:
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) - {'databaseRef', 'privileges', 'additionalCreatorRoles'}:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        database = databases.get(value.get('databaseRef'))
        privileges, creators = value.get('privileges'), value.get('additionalCreatorRoles', [])
        if (not database or database['providerId'] != provider_id or database['mode'] != 'managed'
                or database['name'] in seen or not isinstance(privileges, list) or not privileges
                or len(privileges) > 5 or any(not isinstance(p, str) for p in privileges)
                or len(set(privileges)) != len(privileges) or not set(privileges) <= GRANTS['table'] | {'CREATE'}
                or not isinstance(creators, list) or len(creators) > 256):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        creators = [identifier(role, True) for role in creators]
        if len(set(creators)) != len(creators):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        seen.add(database['name'])
        result.append(dict(database=database['name'], privileges=sorted(privileges),
                           creatorRoles=sorted(set([owner] + creators))))
    return sorted(result, key=lambda row: row['database'])


def project_providers(rows, snapshot, configuration, desired, catalog):
    """Discovery per provider; mutation batches per library and logical instance."""
    jobs, findings, names, logical = {}, [], {}, {}
    applications = snapshot.get('applicationLibraries', {})
    selected = snapshot.get('applicationExecutionScope', {}).get('installLibraries', list(applications.get('libraries', {})))
    rows = [row for row in rows if row['libraryId'] in selected]
    if applications.get('status') != 'PASS':
        return {'status': 'BLOCKED', 'jobs': [], 'findings': [finding('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_INPUT_INVALID', 'applicationLibraryDeployments')]}
    topology = snapshot.get('topology', {}).get('resolved', {}).get('serviceDeployments', {})
    materialized = dict(desired, serviceDeployments={key: dict(value, members=topology.get(key, {}).get('members', value.get('members', {})))
                                                 for key, value in desired.get('serviceDeployments', {}).items()})
    project_id = snapshot['project']['id']

    def provider(ref, security=False):
        deployment = materialized['serviceDeployments'][ref]
        definition = catalog['definitions'][deployment['serviceType']]
        service_type = deployment['serviceType']
        modes = {'postgresql': {'standalone', 'pg_auto_failover'}, 'redis': {'standalone', 'sentinel-ha'},
                 'clickhouse': {'standalone', 'raft-ha'}, 'kafka': {'kraft-standalone', 'kraft-distributed'}}
        if deployment['mode'] not in modes.get(service_type, set()):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_MODE_UNSUPPORTED')
        capabilities = {'postgresql': {'service.postgresql.database', 'service.postgresql.schema', 'service.postgresql.account'},
                        'redis': {'service.redis.account'}, 'clickhouse': {'service.clickhouse.database', 'service.clickhouse.account'},
                        'kafka': {'service.kafka.topic'}}
        if not capabilities[service_type] <= set(definition.get('capabilities', [])):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED')
        if ref not in jobs:
            selector = None
            if service_type == 'kafka':
                listeners = _value(configuration['services'][ref]['configuration'], 'listeners') or {}
                choices = sorted(k for k, v in listeners.items() if v['purpose'] == 'client')
                selector = row.get('connectionDefaults', {}).get('kafka', {}).get('connectionRef') or (choices[0] if len(choices) == 1 else None)
            connection = resolve_connection(ref, {'purpose': 'native' if service_type == 'clickhouse' else 'client'}, selector, materialized, configuration, catalog, snapshot['hosts'])
            targets = connection['targets']
            if service_type == 'kafka':
                for target in targets:
                    member_settings = configuration['services'][ref].get('members', {}).get(target['memberId'], {}).get('configuration', {})
                    target['tlsProfileRef'] = _value(member_settings, 'tlsProfile') or _value(configuration['services'][ref]['configuration'], 'tlsProfile')
            if service_type == 'postgresql' and len(targets) != (1 if deployment['mode'] == 'standalone' else 2):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_MEMBERS_INVALID')
            jobs[ref] = {'providerId': ref, 'projectId': project_id, 'mode': deployment['mode'],
                         'serviceType': service_type, 'candidates': targets, 'libraries': [], 'databases': [], 'accounts': []}
            if service_type == 'kafka':
                jobs[ref]['topics'] = []
        job = jobs[ref]
        if service_type == 'kafka' and (security or any(t.get('securityProtocol') == 'SASL_SSL' for t in job['candidates'])) and 'adminCandidates' not in job:
            settings = configuration['services'][ref]['configuration']
            listeners = _value(settings, 'listeners') or {}
            selectors = [key for key, value in listeners.items()
                         if value['purpose'] == 'client' and value['securityProtocol'] == 'SASL_SSL']
            if len(selectors) != 1:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_ADMIN_LISTENER_AMBIGUOUS')
            targets = resolve_connection(ref, {'purpose': 'client'}, selectors[0], materialized,
                                         configuration, catalog, snapshot['hosts'])['targets']
            for target in targets:
                member_settings = configuration['services'][ref].get('members', {}).get(target['memberId'], {}).get('configuration', {})
                target['tlsProfileRef'] = _value(member_settings, 'tlsProfile') or _value(settings, 'tlsProfile')
            if not targets or any(t.get('securityProtocol') != 'SASL_SSL' for t in targets):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_ADMIN_LISTENER_AMBIGUOUS')
            admin = _value(settings, 'adminCredential')
            if not isinstance(admin, dict) or not re.fullmatch(r'runtime:[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,127}', admin.get('passwordSecretRef', '')):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_ADMIN_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED')
            setting = definition.get('configuration', {}).get('settings', {}).get('adminCredential', {})
            metadata = setting.get('ui', {}).get('x-runtimeSecretRequirement', {})
            if setting.get('x-runtimeSecretDeploymentBound') is not True or not isinstance(metadata.get('requirementRef'), str):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_ADMIN_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED')
            job['adminPasswordRef'] = 'runtime:' + secret_input_requirement_ref(ref, metadata['requirementRef'], 'SERVICE_PASSWORD')
            job['adminCandidates'] = targets
        return jobs[ref]

    def claim(key, owner, mode):
        previous = names.setdefault(key, (owner, mode))
        if previous != (owner, mode) and not (mode == previous[1] == 'existing'):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_NAME_CONFLICT')

    try:
        for row in rows:
            key = (row['libraryId'], row['instanceId'])
            identity = {k: row.get(k) for k in ('resources', 'bindings', 'connectionDefaults', 'resourceDefaults')}
            identity['accounts'] = row['settings'].get('accounts', {})
            if key in logical and logical[key] != identity:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_HOST_CONFLICT')
            logical[key] = identity
        for library_id, library in sorted(applications['libraries'].items()):
            if library_id not in selected:
                continue
            library_rows = [row for row in rows if row['libraryId'] == library_id]
            row = library_rows[0]
            if any({k: other.get(k) for k in ('resources', 'bindings', 'connectionDefaults')} !=
                   {k: row.get(k) for k in ('resources', 'bindings', 'connectionDefaults')} for other in library_rows):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_HOST_CONFLICT')
            databases, schemas = {}, []
            for resource_id, resource in sorted(library.get('resources', {}).items()):
                if resource['kind'] == 'redis.key':
                    ref = row['bindings'].get(resource['binding'], {}).get('deploymentRef')
                    if (desired['serviceDeployments'].get(ref, {}).get('serviceType') != 'redis'
                            or set(resource['parameters']) != {'name'} or not isinstance(resource['parameters']['name'], str)
                            or not resource['parameters']['name'] or 'mode' in resource):
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_RESOURCE_INVALID')
                    continue
                if resource['kind'] not in {'postgresql.database', 'postgresql.schema', 'clickhouse.database', 'kafka.topic'}:
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED')
                ref = row['bindings'].get(resource['binding'], {}).get('deploymentRef')
                job = provider(ref)
                if resource['kind'].split('.')[0] != job['serviceType']:
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_RESOURCE_INVALID')
                if resource['kind'] == 'kafka.topic':
                    topic = dict(library['topics'][resource_id], libraryId=library_id)
                    claim((ref, 'topic', topic['name']), (library_id, resource_id), topic['mode'])
                    previous = [t for t in job['topics'] if t['name'] == topic['name']]
                    if any(any(t[k] != topic[k] for k in ('partitions', 'replicationFactor', 'config')) for t in previous):
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_NAME_CONFLICT')
                    job['topics'].append(topic)
                    continue
                restore = resource['parameters'].get('restore_on_create')
                expected_parameters = {'name', 'restore_on_create'} if restore is not None else {'name'}
                if (set(resource['parameters']) != expected_parameters or
                        (restore is not None and (resource['kind'] != 'postgresql.database' or resource.get('mode', 'managed') != 'managed'))):
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_RESOURCE_INVALID')
                name, mode = identifier(resource['parameters']['name'], database=resource['kind'] == 'postgresql.database'), resource.get('mode', 'managed')
                value = dict(resourceId=resource_id, name=name, mode=mode,
                             marker=marker(project_id, ref, library_id, resource['kind'], resource_id))
                if resource['kind'] in {'postgresql.database', 'clickhouse.database'}:
                    owner = 'pla_' + hashlib.sha256((project_id + ':' + ref + ':' + library_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]
                    value.update(providerId=ref, libraryId=library_id, owner=owner, schemas=[], accounts=[],
                                 ownerMarker=marker(project_id, ref, library_id, 'owner', library_id))
                    if restore is not None:
                        value['restoreOnCreate'] = restore
                    claim((ref, 'database', name), (library_id, resource_id), mode)
                    databases[resource_id] = value
                    if job['serviceType'] == 'clickhouse':
                        value['tables'] = library.get('tables', {}).get(resource_id, [])
                        if any(db['name'] == name and db['providerId'] == ref and db.get('tables', []) != value['tables'] for db in job['databases']):
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_NAME_CONFLICT')
                    job['databases'].append(value)
                    if job['serviceType'] == 'postgresql' and mode == 'managed' and not any(o['name'] == owner for o in job['libraries']):
                        job['libraries'].append({'name': owner, 'marker': value['ownerMarker']})
                else:
                    schemas.append((ref, resource, value))
            for ref, source, schema in schemas:
                database = databases.get(source.get('databaseRef'))
                if not database or database['providerId'] != ref or (schema['mode'] == 'managed' and database['mode'] != 'managed'):
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_DATABASE_REF_INVALID')
                claim((ref, database['name'], schema['name']), (library_id, schema['resourceId']), schema['mode'])
                database['schemas'].append(schema)
            for instance_id, instance in sorted(library.get('instances', {}).items()):
                for account_id, account in sorted(instance.get('credentialRequirements', {}).items()):
                    connection = instance['connections'].get(account_id, {})
                    service_type = connection.get('serviceType')
                    if service_type == 'application':
                        continue  # Prepared as a batch only after this application provider is ready.
                    if service_type not in {'postgresql', 'redis', 'clickhouse', 'kafka'}:
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED')
                    ref = connection['deploymentRef']
                    job = provider(ref, security=service_type == 'kafka')
                    database = databases.get(account.get('databaseRef'))
                    bulk_access = 'databaseAccess' in account
                    if bulk_access and (service_type != 'postgresql' or account['mode'] != 'managed'
                                        or 'service.postgresql.database-access' not in catalog['definitions']['postgresql'].get('capabilities', [])):
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED')
                    if not bulk_access and service_type not in {'redis', 'kafka'} and (not database or database['providerId'] != ref or (account['mode'] == 'managed' and database['mode'] != 'managed')):
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_DATABASE_REF_INVALID')
                    credentials = account['credentials']
                    if set(credentials) != {'username', 'password'} or credentials['username']['source']['kind'] != 'literal':
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_INVALID')
                    if credentials['password']['source']['kind'] not in {'runtime_secret_ref', 'vault_ref', 'generated'}:
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_SOURCE_DEFERRED')
                    if credentials['password']['source']['kind'] == 'generated' and (account['mode'] != 'managed' or not instance.get('agentRequired')):
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GENERATED_PASSWORD_SCOPE_INVALID')
                    username = identifier(credentials['username']['source']['value'], True)
                    admin = configuration['services'][ref]['configuration'].get('adminSuperuser', {}).get('value', {}).get('username')
                    if username in {admin, 'default', 'autoctl_node', 'pgautofailover_replicator'} or (service_type == 'kafka' and username == 'admin'):
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_IDENTIFIER_INVALID')
                    listener = connection.get('connectionRef', 'client')
                    if service_type == 'kafka':
                        if ('service.kafka.account' not in catalog['definitions']['kafka'].get('capabilities', [])
                                or any(t.get('securityProtocol') != 'SASL_SSL' for t in connection['targets'])
                                or 'databaseRef' in account or bulk_access):
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED')
                        grants = normalize_kafka_grants(account.get('grants', []), library.get('topics', {}), ref)
                    elif service_type == 'redis':
                        if listener == 'sentinel' and 'service.redis.sentinel.account' not in catalog['definitions']['redis'].get('capabilities', []):
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED')
                        grants = normalize_redis_grants(account.get('grants', {}))
                        if 'databaseRef' in account:
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_DATABASE_REF_INVALID')
                    elif service_type == 'clickhouse':
                        grants = normalize_clickhouse_grants(account.get('grants', []), databases, ref)
                        if account['mode'] == 'managed' and any(databases[g['databaseRef']]['mode'] != 'managed' for g in account.get('grants', [])):
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
                    elif bulk_access:
                        if 'grants' in account or 'databaseRef' in account:
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
                        owner = 'pla_' + hashlib.sha256((project_id + ':' + ref + ':' + library_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]
                        access = normalize_database_access(account['databaseAccess'], databases, ref, owner)
                        grants = []
                        database = next((db for db in databases.values() if access and db['name'] == access[0]['database']), None)
                    else:
                        grants = normalize_grants(account.get('grants', []))
                        schemas_by_name = {s['name']: s for s in database['schemas']}
                        if any(g['schema'] not in schemas_by_name or
                               (account['mode'] == 'managed' and schemas_by_name[g['schema']]['mode'] != 'managed') for g in grants):
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
                    claim((ref, listener if service_type == 'redis' else 'account', username), (library_id, instance_id, account_id), account['mode'])
                    value = dict(name=username, mode=account['mode'], instanceId=instance_id, accountId=account_id,
                                 database=database['name'] if database else None, libraryId=library_id,
                                 listener=listener, candidates=connection.get('targets', job['candidates']),
                                 passwordRef=(generated_password_ref(project_id, library_id, instance_id, account_id)
                                              if credentials['password']['source']['kind'] == 'generated' else
                                              credentials['password']['source']['ref'] if credentials['password']['source']['kind'] == 'runtime_secret_ref' else
                                              'pla-vault-'+hashlib.sha256(repr(sorted(credentials['password']['source'].items())).encode()).hexdigest()[:32]), grants=grants,
                                 marker=marker(project_id, ref, library_id, 'account', instance_id + '/' + account_id))
                    if bulk_access:
                        value['databaseAccess'] = access
                        value['database'] = database['name'] if database else 'postgres'
                    job['accounts'].append(value)
                    if database:
                        database['accounts'].append(value)
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
        code = str(error)
        if not code.startswith('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_'):
            code = 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_INPUT_INVALID'
        findings.append(finding(code, 'applicationLibraryDeployments'))
    providers = [] if findings else [jobs[k] for k in sorted(jobs)]
    library_jobs, instance_jobs = split_provider_jobs(providers)
    return {'status': 'BLOCKED' if findings else 'PASS', 'jobs': providers,
            'libraryJobs': library_jobs, 'instanceJobs': instance_jobs, 'findings': findings}


def normalize_kafka_grants(values, topics, provider_id):
    """Resolve declared library topic references; never infer privileges from selection."""
    allowed = {'Read', 'Write', 'Create', 'Delete', 'Alter', 'Describe',
               'DescribeConfigs', 'AlterConfigs', 'IdempotentWrite', 'All'}
    result = []
    if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) > 256:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
    for grant in values:
        if not isinstance(grant, dict) or set(grant) - {'topicRef', 'resourceType', 'name', 'patternType', 'operations'}:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        if 'topicRef' in grant:
            topic = topics.get(grant['topicRef'])
            if not topic or topic['deploymentRef'] != provider_id or set(grant) != {'topicRef', 'operations'}:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
            kind, name, pattern = 'topic', topic['name'], 'literal'
        else:
            kind, name, pattern = grant.get('resourceType'), grant.get('name'), grant.get('patternType', 'literal')
            if kind not in {'topic', 'group', 'transactional-id', 'cluster'} or pattern not in {'literal', 'prefixed'}:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
            if not isinstance(name, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,249}|\*', name):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
            if kind == 'cluster' and (name != 'kafka-cluster' or pattern != 'literal'):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
            if kind == 'topic' and (pattern != 'prefixed' or name == '*'):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        operations = grant.get('operations')
        if not isinstance(operations, list) or not operations or any(op not in allowed for op in operations):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        if kind == 'cluster' and not set(operations) <= {'Describe', 'IdempotentWrite'}:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        valid_operations = {'topic': allowed - {'IdempotentWrite'},
                            'group': {'Read', 'Delete', 'Describe', 'All'},
                            'transactional-id': {'Write', 'Describe', 'All'},
                            'cluster': {'Describe', 'IdempotentWrite'}}
        if not set(operations) <= valid_operations[kind]:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        result.append(dict(resourceType=kind, name=name, patternType=pattern, operations=sorted(set(operations))))
    return result


def split_provider_jobs(providers):
    """Execution boundaries are a library resource batch and one instance hook."""
    library_jobs, instance_jobs = [], []
    for job in providers:
        if job['serviceType'] == 'kafka':
            for library_id in sorted({t['libraryId'] for t in job['topics']}):
                library_jobs.append(dict(job, libraryId=library_id,
                                         topics=[t for t in job['topics'] if t['libraryId'] == library_id], accounts=[]))
            for library_id, instance_id in sorted({(a['libraryId'], a['instanceId']) for a in job['accounts']}):
                instance_jobs.append(dict(job, libraryId=library_id, instanceId=instance_id, topics=[],
                                          accounts=[a for a in job['accounts'] if (a['libraryId'], a['instanceId']) == (library_id, instance_id)]))
            continue
        for library_id in sorted({db['libraryId'] for db in job['databases']}):
            databases = [dict(db, accounts=[]) for db in job['databases'] if db['libraryId'] == library_id]
            owners = {db['owner'] for db in databases if db['mode'] == 'managed'}
            library_jobs.append(dict(job, libraryId=library_id, databases=databases, accounts=[],
                                     libraries=[owner for owner in job['libraries'] if owner['name'] in owners]))
        for library_id, instance_id in sorted({(a['libraryId'], a['instanceId']) for a in job['accounts']}):
            accounts = [a for a in job['accounts'] if (a['libraryId'], a['instanceId']) == (library_id, instance_id)]
            database_names = {a['database'] for a in accounts}
            if job.get('serviceType') == 'clickhouse':
                database_names.update(grant['database'] for account in accounts for grant in account['grants'])
            bulk_accounts = [a for a in accounts if 'databaseAccess' in a]
            reconcile_accounts = bulk_accounts + ([a for a in accounts if a['mode'] == 'managed']
                                                  if job.get('serviceType') == 'clickhouse' else [])
            databases = [dict(db, accounts=[a for a in accounts if a['database'] == db['name'] or
                                           (a in bulk_accounts and db['libraryId'] == library_id and db['mode'] == 'managed')])
                         for db in job['databases'] if db['name'] in database_names or
                         (reconcile_accounts and db['libraryId'] == library_id and db['mode'] == 'managed')]
            login_accounts = [dict(a, database=entry['database']) for a in accounts
                              for entry in (a.get('databaseAccess') or [{'database': a['database']}])]
            instance_jobs.append(dict(job, libraryId=library_id, instanceId=instance_id, libraries=[],
                                      databases=databases, accounts=accounts, loginAccounts=login_accounts))
    return library_jobs, instance_jobs

"""Typed A2 preflight. Ansible owns precedence, templates and target execution."""
import base64
import hashlib
import os
import re

try:
    from .application_libraries import checked_file, invocation_package_loader, nonsecret_values
    from .application_scripts import prepare_script_jobs

DIGEST = re.compile(r"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")
REFERENCE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:/-]*(?::[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)?(?:@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})?$")
LABEL = "platform.installer.config-digest"


def runtime_reference(image_id):
    if not isinstance(image_id, str) or not DIGEST.fullmatch(image_id):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ID_INVALID")
    return "platform-application:sha256-" + image_id.split(":", 1)[1]


def pinned_registry_reference(reference, digest):
    if not isinstance(reference, str) or not REFERENCE.fullmatch(reference) or "@" in reference or not DIGEST.fullmatch(digest):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_REGISTRY_REFERENCE_INVALID")
    prefix, slash, name = reference.rpartition("/")
    name = name.split(":", 1)[0]
    return (prefix + slash + name) + "@" + digest


def safe_relative(value):
    return (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value) and not value.startswith("/") and
            "\\" not in value and not any(x in ("", ".", "..") for x in value.split("/")))


def image_requirement(instance_id, image_name, image):
    """One locked image identity for standalone execution and target-free planning."""
    if not isinstance(image_name, str) or not REFERENCE.fullmatch(image_name) or not isinstance(image, dict):
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_IMAGE_NOT_LOCKED')
    reference = runtime_reference(image['imageId'])
    platform = image.get('platform')
    if (not isinstance(platform, dict) or set(platform) - {'os', 'architecture', 'variant'} or
            platform.get('os') != 'linux' or platform.get('architecture') not in ('amd64', 'arm64') or
            ('variant' in platform and (not isinstance(platform['variant'], str) or
             re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9]+', platform['variant']) is None))):
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_IMAGE_PLATFORM_INVALID')
    if image.get('localReference', reference) != reference:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_IMAGE_REFERENCE_NOT_BOUND')
    return dict(id=instance_id + ':image', name=image_name, artifactType='container-image',
                imageId=image['imageId'], platform=image['platform'], localReference=reference)


def resolve_image_lock(native_lock, manifest_lock, prepared=None):
    """Existing standalone lock conflict rule, shared by snapshot and runtime."""
    if native_lock is not None and manifest_lock is not None and native_lock != manifest_lock:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_ARTIFACT_LOCK_CONFLICT')
    legacy = (native_lock or manifest_lock or {}).get('x-container-images', {})
    if prepared is not None:
        for entry in prepared.get('placements', {}).values():
            original = selected_image(legacy, entry['reference'], '', '', '')
            if original is not None and original != entry['image']:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_ARTIFACT_LOCK_CONFLICT')
        return prepared
    return legacy


def bundle_archive(root, digest, record, loader):
    """Verify the locked manifest and selected component; no bundle mutation."""
    manifest_path = checked_file(root, "manifest.yaml")
    with open(manifest_path, "rb") as stream:
        if "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(stream.read()).hexdigest() != digest:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_BUNDLE_DIGEST_INVALID")
    manifest = loader(manifest_path)
    if manifest.get("apiVersion") != "platform.installer/execution-bundle/v1alpha1" or manifest.get("kind") != "ExecutionRuntimeBundle":
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_BUNDLE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
    matches = [x for x in manifest.get("components", []) if x.get("path") == record["ref"]]
    if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0].get("sha256") != record["sha256"] or matches[0].get("size") != record["size"]:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_NOT_LOCKED")
    if not safe_relative(record["ref"]) or not record["ref"].startswith("runtime/artifacts/"):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_PATH_INVALID")
    path = os.path.abspath(root)
    for part in record["ref"].split("/"):
        path = os.path.join(path, part)
        if os.path.islink(path):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_PATH_INVALID")
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_MISSING")
    sha = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            sha.update(chunk)
    if "sha256:" + sha.hexdigest() != record["sha256"] or os.path.getsize(path) != record["size"]:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_INVALID")
    return path


def selected_archive(root, source, offline, loader):
    """Validate fallback bytes only after the target selected the fallback."""
    if source == "REPOSITORY":
        return None
    if source != "OFFLINE_BUNDLE" or not offline:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_SOURCE_INVALID")
    if not root:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_BUNDLE_REQUIRED")
    return bundle_archive(root, offline["bundleDigest"], offline, loader)


def validate_compose(config, job, instance_path, digest):
    """Check only values projected by Core; leave package-authored Compose fields alone."""
    services = config.get("services", {})
    if config.get("name") != job["placement"]["composeProject"] or set(services) != {job["instanceId"]}:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_IDENTITY_INVALID")
    service = services[job["instanceId"]]
    reference = job['settings']['image']
    if '@' in reference:
        reference = job['authority']['requirement']['localReference']
    if (service.get("image") != reference or
            service.get("container_name") != job["placement"]["containerName"]):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_IDENTITY_INVALID")
    launch = service.get("entrypoint") or service.get("command")
    expected_launch = ['/usr/bin/vault', 'agent', '-config=/opt/vault/agent.hcl'] if job.get('agentTemplate') else job['settings']['command']
    if launch != expected_launch or (service.get("entrypoint") and service.get("command")):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_COMMAND_INVALID")
    for key in ("user", "restart"):
        if key in job["settings"] and service.get(key) != job["settings"][key]:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_CONFIGURATION_INVALID")
    if job["settings"].get("readiness", {}).get("mode") == "healthcheck" and not service.get("healthcheck"):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_HEALTHCHECK_REQUIRED")
    expected_labels = {"platform.installer.project": job["projectId"], "platform.installer.library": job["libraryId"],
                       "platform.installer.instance": job["instanceId"], "platform.installer.host": job["hostId"], LABEL: digest}
    labels = service.get("labels", {})
    if any(labels.get(name) != value for name, value in expected_labels.items()):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_LABEL_INVALID")
    expected_env = dict(job["settings"].get("environment", {}), **{key: job["instanceId"] for key in job["identityNames"]})
    environment = service.get("environment", {})
    if any(environment.get(key) != str(value) for key, value in expected_env.items()):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_ENVIRONMENT_INVALID")
    findings = []
    nonsecret_values(environment, "environment", findings)
    if findings:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_SECRET_INVALID")
    expected_ports = sorted((str(x["published"]), x["container"]) for x in job["settings"].get("ports", {}).values())
    ports = service.get("ports", [])
    if sorted((str(x["published"]), x["target"]) for x in ports) != expected_ports:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_PORT_INVALID")
    expected_mounts = {os.path.join(instance_path, "config", x["destination"]): None
                       for x in job["configs"] + job.get("directoryConfigs", []) + job.get("archiveConfigs", [])}
    core_mounts = {os.path.join(instance_path, 'vault'): '/opt/vault'} if job.get('agentTemplate') else {}
    if job.get('agentTemplate') and job.get('pkiPlans'):
        core_mounts[os.path.join(instance_path, 'pki')] = '/opt/application/pki'
    expected_mounts.update(core_mounts)
    for source, target in expected_mounts.items():
        matches = [x for x in service.get("volumes", []) if x.get("source") == source]
        if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0].get("type") != "bind" or not matches[0].get("read_only"):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_MOUNT_INVALID")
        if (target is not None and matches[0].get("target") != target) or not matches[0].get("target", "").startswith("/"):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_MOUNT_INVALID")
    return True


def prepare_runtime(root, snapshot, rows, desired, lock, validator, loader, script_contexts=None):
    libraries = snapshot.get("applicationLibraries", {})
    if snapshot.get("validation", {}).get("status") != "PASS" or libraries.get("status") != "PASS":
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_RUNTIME_PROJECT_BLOCKED")
    image_lock = lock.get("x-container-images", {}) if isinstance(lock, dict) else {}
    schema = os.path.join(validator.schema_root, 'artifact-source/v1alpha2/' +
                          ('prepared-images.schema.json' if image_lock.get('apiVersion') == 'platform.installer/container-images/v1alpha2' else 'image-lock.schema.json'))
    if validator.validate(image_lock, schema) or not DIGEST.fullmatch(lock.get("digest", "")):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_LOCK_INVALID")
    jobs = []
    package_loader = invocation_package_loader(root, loader, validator)
    scope = snapshot.get('applicationExecutionScope', {})
    selected = scope.get('installLibraries', list(libraries['libraries']))
    for row in rows:
        lib_id, app_id, host = row["libraryId"], row["instanceId"], row["hostId"]
        library = libraries["libraries"][lib_id]
        instance = library["instances"][app_id]
        placement = instance["placements"][host]
        settings = row["settings"]
        if lib_id not in selected:
            continue
        if (any(r['kind'] not in {'postgresql.database', 'postgresql.schema', 'clickhouse.database', 'kafka.topic', 'redis.key'} for r in row['resources'].values()) or
                any(instance['connections'].get(k, {}).get('serviceType') not in {'postgresql', 'redis', 'clickhouse', 'kafka', 'application'} for k in instance['credentialRequirements']) or
                any(x.get("tls") for x in instance["connections"].values())):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_RUNTIME_DEFERRED_FEATURE")
        # Recheck packages after native variable composition, before any rendering.
        app_ref = row["applicationName"] + "@" + row["applicationVersion"]
        app = package_loader(app_ref, "application")
        lib = package_loader(row["libraryRef"], "library")
        if row["packageIdentity"] != {"application": app["digest"], "library": lib["digest"]}:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_CHANGED")
        app_render, lib_render = app.get("render", {}), lib.get("render", {})
        agent_template = app_render.get('agent_template') if instance['agentRequired'] else None
        if instance['agentRequired'] and (not agent_template or agent_template not in app['files']):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_AGENT_TEMPLATE_REQUIRED')
        if not app_render.get("compose_template") or not lib_render.get("base_compose_template"):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_RENDER_REQUIRED")
        for package, key in ((app, "compose_template"), (lib, "base_compose_template")):
            if package["render"][key] not in package["files"]:
                raise ValueError("APPLICATION_RENDER_NOT_ALLOWLISTED")
        configs = []
        for config in settings.get("config_files", []):
            name = config.get("template", config.get("source"))
            if name not in app["files"] or not safe_relative(config["destination"]):
                raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_ALLOWLISTED")
            configs.append(dict(config, path=checked_file(root, app["logicalPath"] + "/" + name)))
        directories = []
        for config in settings.get("config_directories", []):
            source = config["source"].rstrip("/") + "/"
            if source not in app["directoryEntries"] or not safe_relative(config["destination"]):
                raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_ALLOWLISTED")
            members = [name for name in app["files"] if name.startswith(source)]
            subdirectories = sorted({config["destination"] + "/" + os.path.dirname(name[len(source):])
                                     for name in members if os.path.dirname(name[len(source):])})
            directories.append(dict(config, source=source, members=[dict(
                destination=config["destination"] + "/" + name[len(source):],
                path=checked_file(root, app["logicalPath"] + "/" + name),
                mode=config.get("file_mode", "0644")) for name in members],
                subdirectories=subdirectories))
        archives = []
        for config in settings.get("config_archives", []):
            if config["source"] not in app["files"] or not safe_relative(config["destination"]):
                raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_ALLOWLISTED")
            archives.append(dict(config, path=checked_file(root, app["logicalPath"] + "/" + config["source"])))
        if len({x["destination"] for x in configs}) != len(configs):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_DESTINATION_COLLISION")
        image = selected_image(image_lock, settings['image'], lib_id, app_id, host)
        if not image:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_NOT_LOCKED")
        reference = runtime_reference(image["imageId"])
        if not REFERENCE.fullmatch(settings["image"]):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_REFERENCE_INVALID")
        if image.get("localReference", reference) != reference:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_REFERENCE_NOT_BOUND")
        registry = image.get("registry")
        if registry and (not REFERENCE.fullmatch(registry["reference"]) or "@" in registry["reference"]):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_REGISTRY_REFERENCE_INVALID")
        # Registry allowlist is node scoped, independent of package defaults.
        configuration = snapshot["effectiveConfiguration"]["services"][row["runtimeRef"]]["configuration"]
        account_setting = configuration.get("accountName", {})
        account = account_setting.get("value") if account_setting.get("state") == "RESOLVED" else None
        if not isinstance(account, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}", account):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_DOCKER_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED")
        offline = image.get("archive")
        archive_path = None
        if offline:
            if not safe_relative(offline["ref"]) or not offline["ref"].startswith("runtime/artifacts/"):
                raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_PATH_INVALID")
            offline = dict(offline, kind="OFFLINE_BUNDLE", type="archive", bundleDigest=lock["digest"])
        requirement = image_requirement(app_id, settings['image'], image)
        authority = assemble_authority(requirement, offline, dict(registry or {}, kind="REPOSITORY"), image=True)
        registry_credentials = row.get('registryCredentials', {}).get(registry_request(registry['reference'])['registry'], {}) if registry else {}
        jobs.append(dict(row, placement=placement, account=account, configs=configs,
                         packageApplicationScripts=app['scripts'], packageLibraryScripts=lib['scripts'],
                         applicationPackagePath=app['logicalPath'], libraryPackagePath=lib['logicalPath'],
                         directoryConfigs=directories, archiveConfigs=archives, registryCredentials=registry_credentials,
                         agentTemplate=checked_file(root, app['logicalPath']+'/'+agent_template) if agent_template else None,
                         appTemplate=checked_file(root, app["logicalPath"] + "/" + app_render["compose_template"]),
                         baseTemplate=checked_file(root, lib["logicalPath"] + "/" + lib_render["base_compose_template"]),
                         baseFilename=lib_render["base_compose_filename"], baseService=lib_render["base_service"],
                         envSource=checked_file(root, lib["logicalPath"] + "/files/.env") if "files/.env" in lib["files"] else None,
                         archivePath=archive_path, authority=authority))
    contexts = provider_script_contexts(root, snapshot, rows, package_loader)
    prepare_script_jobs(root, snapshot, desired, rows, jobs + contexts)
    if script_contexts is not None:
        script_contexts.extend(contexts)
    return jobs


def provider_script_contexts(root, snapshot, rows, package_loader, include_selected=False):
    """Script metadata only: no image, materialization, Docker or PKI preflight."""
    scope = snapshot.get('applicationExecutionScope', {})
    selected = scope.get('installLibraries', list(snapshot['applicationLibraries']['libraries']))
    result = []
    for row in rows:
        if (row['libraryId'] in selected and not include_selected or
                row['libraryId'] not in selected and row['libraryId'] not in scope.get('providerLibraries', [])):
            continue
        library = snapshot['applicationLibraries']['libraries'][row['libraryId']]
        instance = library['instances'][row['instanceId']]
        app = package_loader(row['applicationName'] + '@' + row['applicationVersion'], 'application')
        lib = package_loader(row['libraryRef'], 'library')
        account = snapshot['effectiveConfiguration']['services'][row['runtimeRef']]['configuration']['accountName']['value']
        placement = instance['placements'][row['hostId']]
        result.append(dict(libraryId=row['libraryId'], instanceId=row['instanceId'], hostId=row['hostId'],
                           placement={key: placement[key] for key in ('runtimeDirectory', 'runtimePath') if key in placement},
                           account=account, settings={key: row['settings'].get(key, {}) for key in ('parameters', 'endpoint')},
                           projectId=snapshot['project']['id'], scriptContextOnly=row['libraryId'] not in selected,
                           applicationPackagePath=app['logicalPath'], libraryPackagePath=lib['logicalPath'],
                           packageApplicationScripts=app['scripts'], packageLibraryScripts=lib['scripts']))
    return result


def validate_config_contents(configs):
    for item in configs:
        content = item["content"]
        if not isinstance(content, str):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_CONTENT_INVALID")
        if item.get("encoding") == "base64":
            raw = base64.b64decode(content, validate=True)
            if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != item['sha256']:
                raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_CONTENT_INVALID")
            content = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        elif len(content.encode("utf-8")) > 1024 * 1024 and item.get("destination") is None:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_CONTENT_INVALID")
        findings = []
        nonsecret_values(content, "config", findings)
        if findings:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_SECRET_FORBIDDEN")
    return True


def agent_config(runtime):
    """Closed supervisor profile: no arbitrary exec, template files or token sinks."""
    import json
    vault = runtime['vault']
    q = json.dumps
    lines = ['exit_after_auth = false', 'vault {', '  address = '+q(vault['endpoint_url']),
             '  ca_cert = '+q(vault['ca_container_path']), '}', 'auto_auth {', '  method "approle" {',
             '    mount_path = '+q(vault['auth_mount']), '    config = {',
             '      role_id_file_path = '+q(vault['role_id_container_path']), '    }', '  }', '}']
    lines += ['template_config {', '  exit_on_retry_failure = true', '}']
    for binding in vault['env_templates']:
        lines += ['env_template '+q(binding['name'])+' {', '  contents = '+q(binding['contents']),
                  '  error_on_missing_key = true', '}']
    lines += ['exec {', '  command = '+q(runtime['application_command']),
              '  restart_on_secret_changes = "always"', '}']
    return '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'


def validate_agent(content, runtime):
    if content.replace('\r\n', '\n').strip() != agent_config(runtime).strip():
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_AGENT_PROFILE_INVALID')
    return True

"""Resolve versioned package scripts from the existing application projection."""
import json
try:
    from .application_endpoints import placement_target, public_endpoint_url
    from .application_libraries import checked_file
    from .application_connections import active_script, library_script_hosts, script_secret_source, script_secret_reference, connection_callback

def _scalar(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return str(value).lower()
    if isinstance(value, (str, int, float)):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
        return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)
    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_REFERENCE_INVALID')


def _instance(library, name):
    matches = [(instance_id, value) for instance_id, value in library['instances'].items()
               if value['applicationName'] == name]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_REFERENCE_INVALID')
    return matches[0]


def _argument(argument, job, library, hosts, desired, provider_library=None, snapshot=None):
    if isinstance(argument, str):
        return argument
    source = argument['valueFrom']
    if source == 'integration_consumers':
        return _scalar(integration_consumers(snapshot, job['libraryId'], desired))
    if source == 'applicationId':
        return job['instanceId']
    if source == 'projectId':
        return job['projectId']
    if source == 'libraryId':
        return job['libraryId']
    if source == 'targetHostId':
        return job['hostId']
    if source == 'parameter':
        name = argument['name']
        if name not in job['settings'].get('parameters', {}):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_REFERENCE_INVALID')
        return _scalar(job['settings']['parameters'][name])
    if source in ('placement_https', 'endpoint'):
        name = argument.get('application', argument.get('name'))
        if source == 'endpoint' and name is None:
            return public_endpoint_url(job['instanceId'], job['settings'], desired)
        instance_id, instance = _instance(library, name)
        placement = instance['placements'].get(job['hostId'])
        if placement is None:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_TARGET_INVALID')
        if source == 'endpoint':
            return public_endpoint_url(instance_id, placement, desired)
        target = placement_target(placement, job['hostId'], hosts)
        if placement.get('endpoint', {}).get('protocol') != 'https':
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_HTTPS_PLACEMENT_REQUIRED')
        return 'https://' + target['address'] + ':' + str(target['port'])
    if source in ('connection', 'provided_connection'):
        connection = ((provider_library or library).get('providedConnections', {}).get(argument['name'], {}) if source == 'provided_connection'
                      else library['instances'][job['instanceId']]['connections'].get(argument['name'], {}))
        if 'field' in argument:
            parts = argument['field'].split('.')
            if parts[0] == 'credentials':
                credential = connection.get('credentials', {}).get(parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else '', {})
                if (len(parts) != 4 or parts[2:] != ['source', 'value'] or credential.get('sensitive', True)
                        or credential.get('source', {}).get('kind') != 'literal'):
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_SECRET_ARGUMENT_FORBIDDEN')
                return _scalar(credential['source']['value'])
            value = connection
            for part in parts:
                if part == 'credentials':
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_SECRET_ARGUMENT_FORBIDDEN')
                value = value[part]
            return _scalar(value)
        if connection.get('url'):
            return connection['url']
        targets = connection.get('targets', [])
        local = [target for target in targets if target['hostId'] == job['hostId']]
        target = local[0] if len(local) == 1 else targets[0] if len(targets) == 1 else None
        if target is None or 'address' not in target or 'port' not in target:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_REFERENCE_INVALID')
        return str(target['address']) + ':' + str(target['port'])
    if source == 'account_batch':
        return _scalar(job['accountBatch'])
    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_REFERENCE_INVALID')


def _secret_reference(source, declaration, job):
    if source and source.get('kind') == 'generated' and declaration.get('valueFrom') == 'secret_binding':
        try:
            from .runtime_secret_identity import generated_password_ref
        except ImportError:
            from runtime_secret_identity import generated_password_ref
        binding = job['secretBindings'][declaration['binding']]['source']
        return generated_password_ref(job['projectId'], job['libraryId'], job['instanceId'], binding['account'])
    return script_secret_reference(source)


def prepare_script_jobs(root, snapshot, desired, rows, jobs, phase=None):
    libraries = snapshot['applicationLibraries']['libraries']
    if (not any(job.get('packageApplicationScripts') or job.get('packageLibraryScripts') for job in jobs)
            and not any(connection.get('connectionProvisioner') for library in libraries.values()
                        for instance in library['instances'].values() for connection in instance.get('connections', {}).values())):
        for job in jobs:
            job.pop('packageApplicationScripts', None)
            job.pop('packageLibraryScripts', None)
            job['scripts'] = []
        return jobs
    libraries = snapshot['applicationLibraries']['libraries']
    hosts = {host: {'ansible_host': value['ansibleHost']} for host, value in snapshot['hosts'].items()}
    for job in jobs:
        if 'projectId' not in job and 'project' in snapshot:
            job['projectId'] = snapshot['project']['id']
        library = libraries[job['libraryId']]
        instance = library['instances'][job['instanceId']]
        app_scripts = job.pop('packageApplicationScripts', [])
        lib_scripts = job.pop('packageLibraryScripts', [])
        if {item['id'] for item in app_scripts} & {item['id'] for item in lib_scripts}:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_ID_CONFLICT')
        declarations = [(item, 'instance', job['applicationPackagePath']) for item in app_scripts]
        for item in lib_scripts:
            if job['hostId'] in library_script_hosts(library, job['instanceId'], item):
                declarations.append((item, 'library', job['libraryPackagePath']))
        scripts = []
        for script, scope, package_path in declarations:
            if phase is not None and script['phase'] != phase:
                continue
            if job.get('scriptContextOnly') and script['phase'] != 'integration_apply':
                continue
            if not active_script(script, instance):
                continue
            eligible = sorted(instance['placements'] if scope == 'instance' else {
                host for member in library['instances'].values() if active_script(script, member)
                for host in member['placements']})
            if not eligible:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_TARGET_INVALID')
            selected = eligible[0] if script.get('target') or script.get('execution', 'each_target') == 'once' else job['hostId']
            if job['hostId'] != selected:
                continue
            secret_inputs = {}
            for name, source in script.get('secretInputs', {}).items():
                value = script_secret_source(source, library, instance)
                if value is None and source.get('optional', False):
                    continue
                secret_inputs[name] = _secret_reference(value, source, dict(job, secretBindings=instance.get("secretBindings", {})))
            targets = [None]
            if script.get('target'):
                connection = instance['connections'][script['target']['connection']]
                if connection.get('serviceType') != 'application':
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_TARGET_INVALID')
                target_hosts = sorted({item['hostId'] for item in connection['targets']})
                if not target_hosts:
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_TARGET_INVALID')
                if script.get('execution', 'each_target') == 'once':
                    target_hosts = target_hosts[:1]
                targets = [dict(libraryId=connection['libraryId'], instanceId=connection['applicationId'],
                                hostId=host) for host in target_hosts]
            if script['phase'] == 'provider_prepare' and targets == [None]:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_TARGET_REQUIRED')
            for target in targets:
                argument_job = dict(job, hostId=target['hostId']) if target else job
                scripts.append(dict(id=script['id'], phase=script['phase'], order=script.get('order', 0), scope=scope,
                                path=checked_file(root, package_path + '/' + script['source']),
                                argv=[_argument(value, argument_job, library, hosts, desired, snapshot=snapshot) for value in script.get('argv', [])],
                                secretInputs=secret_inputs, target=target, runOn=script.get('run_on', 'target'),
                                targetConnection=script.get('target', {}).get('connection'),
                                sharedInputs=[value['name'] for value in script.get('secretInputs', {}).values()
                                              if value.get('valueFrom') == 'library_secret']))
        job['scripts'] = scripts
    if phase == 'post_install':
        return jobs
    for job in jobs:
        if job.get('scriptContextOnly'):
            continue
        library = libraries[job['libraryId']]
        instance = library['instances'][job['instanceId']]
        if job['hostId'] != min(instance['placements']):
            continue
        for alias, connection in instance.get('connections', {}).items():
            if connection.get('serviceType') != 'application' or not connection.get('connectionProvisioner'):
                continue
            provider, _, callback = connection_callback(libraries, connection)
            provider_job = min((item for item in jobs if item['libraryId'] == connection['libraryId']
                                and item['instanceId'] == connection['applicationId']), key=lambda item: item['hostId'])
            secret_inputs, shared_inputs = {}, []
            for key, source in callback.get('secretInputs', {}).items():
                value = script_secret_source(source, library, instance, provider)
                if value is None and source.get('optional', False):
                    continue
                secret_inputs[key] = script_secret_reference(value)
                if source.get('valueFrom') == 'library_secret':
                    shared_inputs.append(source['name'])
                elif source.get('valueFrom') == 'secret_binding':
                    binding = instance['secretBindings'][source['binding']]['source']
                    if 'library_secret' in binding:
                        shared_inputs.append(binding['library_secret'])
            identifier = alias + '.' + callback['id']
            if any(item['id'] == identifier for item in job['scripts']):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_SCRIPT_ID_CONFLICT')
            job['scripts'].append(dict(id=identifier, phase='provider_prepare', order=callback.get('order', 0),
                scope='instance', path=checked_file(root, provider_job['applicationPackagePath'] + '/' + callback['source']),
                argv=[_argument(value, dict(job, hostId=provider_job['hostId']), library, hosts, desired, provider)
                      for value in callback.get('argv', [])],
                secretInputs=secret_inputs, sharedInputs=shared_inputs, targetConnection=alias, runOn=callback.get('run_on', 'target'),
                target=dict(libraryId=connection['libraryId'], instanceId=connection['applicationId'], hostId=provider_job['hostId'])))
    return jobs

"""Invocation-only library selection. The complete project remains authoritative."""
import copy


def execution_scope(snapshot, library_order=None, skipped=None):
    libraries = snapshot.get('applicationLibraries', {}).get('libraries', {})
    order = sorted(libraries) if library_order is None else library_order
    skipped = [] if skipped is None else skipped
    if (not isinstance(order, list) or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in order)
            or len(order) != len(set(order)) or set(order) != set(libraries)):
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_LIBRARY_ORDER_INVALID')
    if (not isinstance(skipped, list) or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in skipped)
            or len(skipped) != len(set(skipped)) or set(skipped) - set(libraries)):
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_LIBRARY_SELECTION_INVALID')
    installed = [key for key in order if key not in skipped]
    consumers = {library_id + '/' + instance_id
                 for library_id in installed for instance_id in libraries[library_id].get('instances', {})}
    providers = set()
    for library_id in installed:
        for instance in libraries[library_id].get('instances', {}).values():
            for connection in instance.get('connections', {}).values():
                if connection.get('serviceType') == 'application':
                    owner, identity = connection['libraryId'], connection['applicationId']
                    # Connections have already been validated by the resolver. Scope
                    # projection does not introduce a second connection validator.
                    providers.add(owner + '/' + identity)
    return dict(libraryOrder=list(order), skippedLibraries=sorted(skipped),
                installLibraries=installed, consumerInstances=sorted(consumers),
                providerInstances=sorted(providers),
                providerLibraries=[key for key in order if any(item.startswith(key + '/') for item in providers)])


def scope_for(snapshot):
    return snapshot.get('applicationExecutionScope') or execution_scope(snapshot)


def scoped_snapshot(snapshot, scope):
    """Attach execution facts without removing provider definitions from the snapshot."""
    result = dict(snapshot)
    result['applicationExecutionScope'] = copy.deepcopy(scope)
    return result


def selected_rows(rows, scope):
    return [row for row in rows if row['libraryId'] in scope['installLibraries']]


def integration_consumers(snapshot, provider_library_id, desired=None):
    """Nonsecret, selected endpoint/parameter metadata for package integration hooks."""
    libraries = snapshot.get('applicationLibraries', {}).get('libraries', {})
    scope = scope_for(snapshot)
    result = []
    for library_id in scope['installLibraries']:
        for instance_id, instance in sorted(libraries[library_id].get('instances', {}).items()):
            aliases = sorted(alias for alias, connection in instance.get('connections', {}).items()
                             if connection.get('serviceType') == 'application'
                             and connection['libraryId'] == provider_library_id)
            if not aliases:
                continue
            placements = {host: {key: copy.deepcopy(placement.get(key, {}))
                                 for key in ('endpoint', 'parameters')}
                          for host, placement in sorted(instance.get('placements', {}).items())}
            if desired is not None:
                try:
                    from .application_endpoints import public_endpoint_url
                except ImportError:
                    from application_endpoints import public_endpoint_url
                for placement in placements.values():
                    if placement.get('endpoint', {}).get('enabled'):
                        placement['endpointUrl'] = public_endpoint_url(instance_id, placement, desired)
            result.append(dict(libraryId=library_id, applicationId=instance_id,
                               connections=aliases, placements=placements))
    return result

"""Target-free Vault jobs; no values, network access or Installer lifecycle."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
try:
    from .application_connections import used_script_sources
except ImportError:
    from application_connections import used_script_sources

SEGMENT = re.compile(r'^[A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$')


def segment(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not SEGMENT.fullmatch(value) or value in {'.', '..'}:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_REFERENCE_INVALID')
    return value


def jaas_field(field):
    """Quote a JAAS string with native template functions, preserving Unicode/HTML."""
    expression = '.Data.data.' + field
    for source, target in [('\\', '\\\\'), ('"', '\\"'), ('\n', '\\n'), ('\r', '\\r'),
                           ('\t', '\\t'), ('\b', '\\b'), ('\f', '\\f')]:
        expression += ' | replaceAll %s %s' % (json.dumps(source), json.dumps(target))
    return '"{{ ' + expression + ' }}"'


def kv_source(source, row):
    if source.get('kind') == 'vault_ref':
        ref = row['bindings'].get(source['binding'], {}).get('deploymentRef')
        parts = source['document'].split('/')
        for part in parts:
            segment(part)
        return dict(providerId=ref, mount=segment(source['mount']), document='/'.join(parts), field=segment(source['field']))
    return None


def project_vault(rows, prepared):
    snapshot = prepared['snapshot']
    libraries = snapshot['applicationLibraries']['libraries']
    plans = prepared['pki_materialization']['materializationPlans']
    project = segment(snapshot['project']['id'])
    providers, library_jobs, instance_jobs, source_jobs = {}, [], [], []
    selected_libraries = snapshot.get('applicationExecutionScope', {}).get('installLibraries', list(libraries))
    script_sources = used_script_sources(libraries, selected_libraries, snapshot.get('applicationExecutionScope', {}).get('providerLibraries', []))
    for library_id, library in sorted(libraries.items()):
        selected = [r for r in rows if r['libraryId'] == library_id]
        row = selected[0]
        if any(r.get('vaultRef', {}) != row.get('vaultRef', {}) for r in selected):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_HOST_CONFLICT')
        installing = library_id in selected_libraries
        active = [i for i in library['instances'].values() if i['agentRequired']] if installing else []
        sources = [c['source'] for i in library['instances'].values() for a in i['credentialRequirements'].values()
                   for c in a['credentials'].values() if c['source']['kind'] == 'vault_ref'] if installing else []
        sources += [source for source in script_sources.get(library_id, []) if source['kind'] == 'vault_ref']
        if installing and any(c['source']['kind'] == 'generated' and
               (field != 'password' or a.get('mode') != 'managed' or not i['agentRequired'])

               for field, c in a['credentials'].items()):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_GENERATED_PASSWORD_SCOPE_INVALID')
        if not active and not sources:
            continue
        auth = row.get('vaultRef', {})
        ref = row['bindings'].get(auth.get('binding'), {}).get('deploymentRef')
        if not ref:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_BINDING_REQUIRED')
        connections = [c for i in library['instances'].values() for c in i['connections'].values()
                       if c.get('deploymentRef') == ref and c.get('serviceType') == 'vault']
        if not connections or any(c != connections[0] for c in connections):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_CONNECTION_INVALID')
        targets = connections[0]['targets']
        endpoint = snapshot.get('endpoints', {}).get('deployments', {}).get(ref)
        if not targets or (not endpoint and len(targets) != 1):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_CONNECTION_AMBIGUOUS')
        target = targets[0]
        address = endpoint['fqdn'] if endpoint else target['address']
        if not isinstance(address, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9.-]+', address):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_CONNECTION_INVALID')
        ca_plans = [p for p in plans if p['hostId'] == target['hostId'] and p['tlsProfileId'] == target.get('tlsProfileRef')]
        if len(ca_plans) != 1:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_CA_PLAN_REQUIRED')
        # Owner contract: all published endpoints use HTTPS port 443.
        url = 'https://%s' % address if endpoint else 'https://%s:%s' % (address, target['port'])

                        routeAddress=address, caHost=target['hostId'], caSource=ca_plans[0]['targetDirectory']+'/ca-chain.pem',
                        auth=auth)
        if ref in providers and providers[ref] != provider:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_AUTH_CONFLICT')
        providers[ref] = provider
        for source in sources:
            location = kv_source(source, row)
            if location['providerId'] != ref:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_SOURCE_PROVIDER_MISMATCH')
            password_ref = 'pla-vault-'+hashlib.sha256(repr(sorted(source.items())).encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
            entry = dict(location, passwordRef=password_ref)
            if any(job['passwordRef'] == password_ref and job != entry for job in source_jobs):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS')
            if entry not in source_jobs:
                source_jobs.append(entry)
        if not installing:
            continue  # Credential reads for callbacks never imply provider-owned writes.
        shared = {}
        used_shared = {binding['source']['library_secret'] for instance in library['instances'].values()
                       for binding in instance.get('secretBindings', {}).values() if 'library_secret' in binding['source']}
        for name, value in sorted(library['sharedSecretRequirements'].items()):
            if name not in used_shared:
                continue
            source = value['source']
            if source['kind'] == 'pki_credential':
                profile = row['bindings'].get(source['binding'], {}).get('profileRef')
                if any(r['bindings'].get(source['binding'], {}).get('profileRef') != profile for r in selected):
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_PKI_CREDENTIAL_AMBIGUOUS')
                hosts = {r['hostId'] for r in selected}
                matches = [p for p in plans if p['hostId'] in hosts and p['tlsProfileId'] == profile
                           and 'PKCS12_KEYSTORE' in p['formats']]
                if (source['credential'] != 'java_keystore_password' or len(matches) != len(hosts)
                        or len({p.get('storePasswordSecretRef') for p in matches}) != 1
                        or not matches[0].get('storePasswordSecretRef')):
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_PKI_CREDENTIAL_AMBIGUOUS')
                shared[name] = dict(source=dict(kind='runtime_secret_ref', ref=matches[0]['storePasswordSecretRef']), pkiPlans=matches)
            elif source['kind'] in {'runtime_secret_ref', 'vault_ref'}:
                shared[name] = dict(source=source)
            else:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_SOURCE_DEFERRED')
        mounts = {r['settings']['provisioner']['secrets']['mount'] for r in selected if
                  r['settings'].get('provisioner', {}).get('secret_bindings')}
        if len(mounts) > 1:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_SHARED_MOUNT_CONFLICT')
        mount = segment(next(iter(mounts), 'secret'))
        shared_doc = '%s/shared' % segment(library_id)
        documents = []
        shared_locations = {}
        for name, value in shared.items():
            location = kv_source(value['source'], row)
            if location and location['providerId'] != ref:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_SOURCE_PROVIDER_MISMATCH')
            if location and not any(all(entry.get(key) == value for key, value in location.items()) for entry in source_jobs):
                source_jobs.append(location)
            shared_locations[name] = location or dict(mount=mount, document=shared_doc, field=segment(name))
        writable_shared = {k: v for k, v in shared.items() if v['source']['kind'] != 'vault_ref'}
        if writable_shared:
            documents.append(dict(mount=mount, document=shared_doc, fields=writable_shared))
        library_jobs.append(dict(providerId=ref, libraryId=library_id, documents=documents))
        for instance_id, instance in sorted(library['instances'].items()):
            instance_rows = [r for r in selected if r['instanceId'] == instance_id]
            provisioner = instance_rows[0]['settings'].get('provisioner', {})
            if not instance['agentRequired']:
                continue
            locations, account_docs = {}, []
            for account_id, account in sorted(instance['credentialRequirements'].items()):
                fields = {}
                document = '%s/%s/accounts/%s' % (segment(library_id), segment(instance_id), segment(account_id))
                for field, credential in account['credentials'].items():
                    source = credential['source']
                    location = kv_source(source, row)
                    if location and location['providerId'] != ref:
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_SOURCE_PROVIDER_MISMATCH')
                    if source['kind'] not in {'literal', 'runtime_secret_ref', 'vault_ref', 'generated'}:
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_SOURCE_DEFERRED')
                    locations[(account_id, field)] = location or dict(mount=mount, document=document, field=segment(field))
                    if not location:
                        fields[field] = dict(source=source)
                        if source['kind'] == 'generated':

                            fields[field]['passwordRef'] = password_ref

                                                    field=field, passwordRef=password_ref))
                if fields:
                    account_docs.append(dict(mount=mount, document=document, fields=fields))
            envs, paths, read_fields = [], set(), {}
            for name, binding in sorted(instance['secretBindings'].items()):
                source = binding['source']
                location = shared_locations[source['library_secret']] if 'library_secret' in source else locations[(source['account'], source['field'])]
                path = location['mount']+'/data/'+location['document']
                paths.add(path)
                read_fields.setdefault(path, []).append(location['field'])
                if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*', location['field']):
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_AGENT_FIELD_INVALID')
                # Supervisor templates are keyed by contents. Distinct env names
                # reading one field need a no-output comment to remain distinct.
                contents = '{{/* %s */}}{{ with secret %s }}{{ .Data.data.%s }}{{ end }}' % (name, json.dumps(path), location['field'])
                if binding.get('format') == 'kafka_scram_jaas':

                            or instance['connections'][source['account']]['serviceType'] != 'kafka'):
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_AGENT_FIELD_INVALID')
                    user = locations[(source['account'], 'username')]
                    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*', user['field']):

                    user_path = user['mount']+'/data/'+user['document']

                    read_fields.setdefault(user_path, []).append(user['field'])
