from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function

__metaclass__ = type

try:
    from .project_validation import canonical_digest
except ImportError:
    from project_validation import canonical_digest


REQUIRED_DEFAULT_KEYS = (
    "authorityValidityDays", "leafValidityDays", "keyAlgorithm", "keySize",
    "usages", "scope", "targetRoot", "sanPolicy", "subject",
)


def _finding(code, field, message, status="BLOCKED"):
    return {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1",
        "kind": "Finding",
        "code": code,
        "status": status,
        "category": "pki-resolution",
        "field": field,
        "safeMessage": message,
    }


def _string_list(values):
    return sorted(set(value for value in values if isinstance(value, str) and value))


def _safe_identity_value(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and value and "\n" not in value and "\r" not in value and "\x00" not in value


def _host_identity(host_id, host_vars):
    values = host_vars.get(host_id, {}) if isinstance(host_vars, dict) else {}
    values = values if isinstance(values, dict) else {}
    address = values.get("ansible_host") or host_id
    dns_names = _string_list([host_id] + ([address] if isinstance(address, str) and not _looks_like_ip(address) else []))
    ip_addresses = _string_list([address] if _looks_like_ip(address) else [])
    return {"hostId": host_id, "dnsNames": dns_names, "ipAddresses": ip_addresses}


def _looks_like_ip(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return False
    if ":" in value:
        return True
    parts = value.split(".")
    return len(parts) == 4 and all(part.isdigit() and 0 <= int(part) <= 255 for part in parts)


def _profile_defaults(profile, defaults):
    profile = profile if isinstance(profile, dict) else {}
    policy = profile.get("sanPolicy", {}) if isinstance(profile.get("sanPolicy"), dict) else {}
    subject = profile.get("subject", {}) if isinstance(profile.get("subject"), dict) else {}
    return {
        "authorityRef": profile.get("authorityRef"),
        "keyAlgorithm": profile.get("keyAlgorithm", defaults["keyAlgorithm"]),
        "keySize": profile.get("keySize", defaults["keySize"]),
        "validityDays": profile.get("validityDays", defaults["leafValidityDays"]),
        "usages": _string_list(profile.get("usages", defaults["usages"])),
        "sanPolicy": {
            "includeHostDns": policy.get("includeHostDns", defaults["sanPolicy"]["includeHostDns"]),
            "includeHostIp": policy.get("includeHostIp", defaults["sanPolicy"]["includeHostIp"]),
            "includeEndpointFqdns": policy.get("includeEndpointFqdns", defaults["sanPolicy"]["includeEndpointFqdns"]),
            "includeEndpointWildcard": policy.get("includeEndpointWildcard", defaults["sanPolicy"]["includeEndpointWildcard"]),
            "includeEndpointVip": policy.get("includeEndpointVip", defaults["sanPolicy"]["includeEndpointVip"]),
        },
        "subject": dict(defaults["subject"], **subject),
    }


def _consumer_records(topology, inventory_deployments=None):
    records = []
    deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    for deployment_id, deployment in sorted(deployments.items()):
        if not isinstance(deployment, dict):
            continue
        deployment_config = deployment.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(deployment.get("configuration"), dict) else {}
        members = deployment.get("members", {}) if isinstance(deployment.get("members"), dict) else {}
        for member_id, member in sorted(members.items()):
            if not isinstance(member, dict):
                continue
            member_config = member.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(member.get("configuration"), dict) else {}
            tls_profile = member_config.get("tlsProfile", deployment_config.get("tlsProfile"))
            if isinstance(tls_profile, str) and tls_profile:
                records.append({
                    "deploymentId": deployment_id,
                    "memberId": member_id,
                    "hostId": member.get("host"),
                    "tlsProfileRef": tls_profile,
                })
        # Host-scoped services use inventory placement instead of logical
        # members.  Preserve the same generic tlsProfile contract.
        for host_id, placements in sorted((inventory_deployments or {}).items()):
            placement = placements.get(deployment_id) if isinstance(placements, dict) else None
            if not isinstance(placement, dict):
                continue
            placement_config = placement.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(placement.get("configuration"), dict) else {}
            tls_profile = placement_config.get("tlsProfile", deployment_config.get("tlsProfile"))
            if isinstance(tls_profile, str) and tls_profile:
                records.append({
                    "deploymentId": deployment_id, "memberId": "host--%s" % host_id,
                    "hostId": host_id, "tlsProfileRef": tls_profile,
                })
    unique = {}
    for record in records:
        unique[(record["deploymentId"], record["memberId"], record.get("hostId"), record["tlsProfileRef"])] = record
    return [unique[key] for key in sorted(unique)]


def _scope_key(scope, consumer):
    if scope == "MEMBER":
        return "%s--%s--%s" % (consumer["tlsProfileRef"], consumer["deploymentId"], consumer["memberId"])
    if scope == "DEPLOYMENT":
        return "%s--%s" % (consumer["tlsProfileRef"], consumer["deploymentId"])
    return "%s--%s" % (consumer["tlsProfileRef"], consumer["hostId"])


def _endpoint_values(topology, resolved_service_endpoints, deployment_ids, policy, host_id=None):
    projection = resolved_service_endpoints if isinstance(resolved_service_endpoints, dict) else {}
    endpoints = projection.get("endpoints", {}) if isinstance(projection.get("endpoints"), dict) else {}
    selected = [endpoints[key] for key in sorted(endpoints) if key in deployment_ids and isinstance(endpoints[key], dict)]
    host_endpoints = projection.get("hostEndpoints", {}) if isinstance(projection.get("hostEndpoints"), dict) else {}
    selected_host = [value for value in host_endpoints.values() if isinstance(value, dict)
                     and value.get("serviceDeploymentId") in deployment_ids
                     and (host_id is None or value.get("hostId") == host_id)]
    endpoint_groups = set(
        endpoint.get("endpointGroupId")
        for endpoint in selected
        if isinstance(endpoint.get("endpointGroupId"), str)
    )
    deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    provider_addresses = []
    if policy["includeEndpointVip"]:
        for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
            deployment = deployments[deployment_id]
            if not isinstance(deployment, dict) or deployment.get("endpointGroupRef") not in endpoint_groups:
                continue
            virtual_addresses = deployment.get("virtualAddresses", [])
            if isinstance(virtual_addresses, list):
                provider_addresses.extend(
                    address.get("address") for address in virtual_addresses
                    if isinstance(address, dict) and _looks_like_ip(address.get("address"))
                )
    return {
        "dnsNames": _string_list(name for endpoint in selected + selected_host for name in endpoint.get("sanDnsNames", [])) if policy["includeEndpointFqdns"] else [],
        "wildcardDnsNames": _string_list(name for endpoint in selected + selected_host for name in endpoint.get("wildcardDnsNames", [])) if policy["includeEndpointWildcard"] else [],
        "ipAddresses": _string_list(provider_addresses),
    }


def resolve_certificate_requests(project_id, topology, host_vars, defaults=None, resolved_service_endpoints=None, inventory_deployments=None):
    """Purely derive certificate identity and target plans from topology bindings.

    It returns no key material or resolved secrets.  The generic `tlsProfile`
    reference is deliberately resolved from deployment/member configuration so
    services may opt in without manually creating one scope per Kafka member.
    """
    desired = topology if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    defaults = defaults if isinstance(defaults, dict) else {}
    missing_defaults = [key for key in REQUIRED_DEFAULT_KEYS if key not in defaults]
    if missing_defaults or not isinstance(defaults.get("sanPolicy"), dict) or not isinstance(defaults.get("subject"), dict):
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": [_finding("PKI_DEFAULTS_INVALID", "platform_pki_policy_defaults", "PKI policy defaults must be supplied by the materialization role")], "requests": [], "materializationPlans": []}
    authorities = desired.get("certificateAuthorities", {}) if isinstance(desired.get("certificateAuthorities"), dict) else {}
    profiles = desired.get("certificateProfiles", {}) if isinstance(desired.get("certificateProfiles"), dict) else {}
    tls_profiles = desired.get("tlsProfiles", {}) if isinstance(desired.get("tlsProfiles"), dict) else {}
    findings = []
    grouped = {}
    for consumer in _consumer_records(desired, inventory_deployments):
        tls_profile = tls_profiles.get(consumer["tlsProfileRef"])
        field = "serviceDeployments.%s.members.%s.configuration.tlsProfile" % (consumer["deploymentId"], consumer["memberId"])
        if not isinstance(tls_profile, dict):
            findings.append(_finding("TLS_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND", field, "TLS profile reference is not defined"))
            continue
        profile_ref = tls_profile.get("certificateProfileRef")
        profile = profiles.get(profile_ref)
        if not isinstance(profile, dict):
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND", field, "TLS profile references an unknown certificate profile"))
            continue
        authority_ref = profile.get("authorityRef")
        authority = authorities.get(authority_ref)
        if not isinstance(authority, dict) or authority.get("mode") != "MANAGED":
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_AUTHORITY_UNSUPPORTED", field, "TLS profile requires a defined MANAGED certificate authority"))
            continue
        if not consumer.get("hostId"):
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_CONSUMER_HOST_REQUIRED", field, "TLS certificate consumer has no physical host placement"))
            continue
        scope = tls_profile.get("scope", defaults["scope"])
        if scope not in ("HOST", "MEMBER", "DEPLOYMENT"):
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_SCOPE_INVALID", field, "TLS profile scope must be HOST, MEMBER or DEPLOYMENT"))
            continue
        grouped.setdefault(_scope_key(scope, consumer), {"scope": scope, "tlsProfile": tls_profile, "tlsProfileId": consumer["tlsProfileRef"], "profileRef": profile_ref, "authorityRef": authority_ref, "consumers": []})["consumers"].append(consumer)
    if findings:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": findings, "requests": [], "materializationPlans": []}

    requests, plans = [], []
    for scope_id, group in sorted(grouped.items()):
        profile = _profile_defaults(profiles[group["profileRef"]], defaults)
        authority = authorities[group["authorityRef"]]
        consumers = sorted(group["consumers"], key=lambda value: (value["hostId"], value["deploymentId"], value["memberId"]))
        hosts = _string_list(value["hostId"] for value in consumers)
        identities = [_host_identity(host_id, host_vars) for host_id in hosts]
        dns_names = _string_list(name for identity in identities for name in identity["dnsNames"]) if profile["sanPolicy"]["includeHostDns"] else []
        ip_addresses = _string_list(address for identity in identities for address in identity["ipAddresses"]) if profile["sanPolicy"]["includeHostIp"] else []
        endpoint_values = _endpoint_values(desired, resolved_service_endpoints, set(value["deploymentId"] for value in consumers), profile["sanPolicy"], hosts[0] if len(hosts) == 1 else None)
        dns_names = _string_list(dns_names + endpoint_values["dnsNames"] + endpoint_values["wildcardDnsNames"])
        ip_addresses = _string_list(ip_addresses + endpoint_values["ipAddresses"])
        request = {
            "id": scope_id,
            "projectId": project_id,
            "scope": group["scope"],
            "profileId": group["profileRef"],
            "authorityId": group["authorityRef"],
            "authorityCommonName": authority.get("commonName", group["authorityRef"]),
            "authorityValidityDays": authority.get("validityDays", defaults["authorityValidityDays"]),
            "commonName": (dns_names or ip_addresses or [scope_id])[0],
            "dnsNames": dns_names,
            "ipAddresses": ip_addresses,
            "keyAlgorithm": profile["keyAlgorithm"],
            "keySize": profile["keySize"],
            "validityDays": profile["validityDays"],
            "usages": profile["usages"],
            "subject": profile["subject"],
            "consumers": consumers,
        }
        unsafe_values = [request["commonName"]] + request["dnsNames"] + request["ipAddresses"] + [request["authorityCommonName"]] + [value for value in request["subject"].values() if value]
        if not all(_safe_identity_value(value) for value in unsafe_values):
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_IDENTITY_VALUE_INVALID", "certificateProfiles.%s" % group["profileRef"], "Certificate identity values must not contain control characters"))
            continue
        request["authorityFingerprint"] = canonical_digest({
            "authorityId": request["authorityId"],
            "commonName": request["authorityCommonName"],
            "validityDays": request["authorityValidityDays"],
            "mode": authority.get("mode"),
        })
        request["certificateRequestFingerprint"] = canonical_digest(request)
        requests.append(request)
        for host_id in hosts:
            target_root = "%s/%s/%s" % (defaults["targetRoot"].rstrip("/"), project_id, scope_id)
            plan = {
                "id": "%s--%s" % (scope_id, host_id),
                "requestId": scope_id,
                "tlsProfileId": group["tlsProfileId"],
                "authorityId": group["authorityRef"],
                "hostId": host_id,
                "targetDirectory": target_root,
                "formats": ["PEM", "PKCS12_KEYSTORE", "PKCS12_TRUSTSTORE"],
                "keyAlias": "platform-%s" % scope_id.replace("_", "-"),
                "trustAlias": "platform-ca-%s" % group["authorityRef"].replace("_", "-"),
                "storePasswordSecretRef": group["tlsProfile"].get("storePasswordSecretRef"),
            }
            plan["materializationFingerprint"] = canonical_digest({
                "requestFingerprint": request["certificateRequestFingerprint"],
                "hostId": host_id,
                "targetDirectory": target_root,
                "formats": plan["formats"],
                "keyAlias": plan["keyAlias"],
                "trustAlias": plan["trustAlias"],
            })
            plans.append(plan)
    if findings:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": findings, "requests": [], "materializationPlans": []}
    return {"status": "PASS", "findings": [], "requests": requests, "materializationPlans": plans}

import hashlib

API_VERSION = "platform.installer/project-snapshot/v1alpha1"
GENERATED_PATH = "inventory/group_vars/all/platform-state.yml"
_SECRET_KEY = re.compile(r"password|passphrase|private.?key|token|secret", re.I)


def _logical(path):
    return path.replace("\\", "/")


def project_documents(project_root, installer_owned_paths=None):
    """Fingerprint canonical project bytes without parsing or rewriting them."""
    root = os.path.realpath(project_root)
    owned = set(_logical(item) for item in (installer_owned_paths or []))
    candidates = ["project.yml", "ansible.cfg", "inventory/hosts.yml"]
    try:
        from .application_libraries import package_inputs
    except ImportError:
        from application_libraries import package_inputs
    candidates.extend(package_inputs(root))
    for directory in ("inventory/group_vars", "inventory/host_vars"):
        absolute = os.path.join(root, directory.replace("/", os.sep))
        if not os.path.isdir(absolute):
            continue
        for current, dirs, files in os.walk(absolute):
            if any(os.path.islink(os.path.join(current, item)) for item in dirs):
                raise ValueError("Canonical project variable directories must not contain symlinks")
            dirs[:] = sorted(item for item in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(current, item)))
            for name in sorted(files):
                if os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower() in (".yml", ".yaml", ".json"):
                    candidates.append(_logical(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(current, name), root)))
    documents = []
    revision_parts = []
    for logical_path in sorted(set(candidates)):
        absolute = os.path.join(root, logical_path.replace("/", os.sep))
        if os.path.islink(absolute):
            raise ValueError("Canonical project documents must not be symlinks")
        if not os.path.isfile(absolute):
            continue
        with open(absolute, "rb") as stream:
            content = stream.read()
        generated = logical_path == GENERATED_PATH
        digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
        documents.append({
            "logicalPath": logical_path,
            "digest": digest,
            "ownership": "GENERATED_READ_ONLY" if generated else (
                "INSTALLER_OWNED" if logical_path in owned else "USER_OWNED_READ_ONLY"
            ),
            "revisionIncluded": not generated,
        })
        if not generated:
            revision_parts.append(logical_path.encode("utf-8") + b"\0" + digest.encode("ascii") + b"\0")
    revision = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(b"".join(revision_parts)).hexdigest()
    return documents, revision


def redact(value, key=None):
    """Defence-in-depth redaction for every value crossing the query boundary."""
    if key and _SECRET_KEY.search(str(key)) and not str(key).lower().endswith(("secretref", "credentialref")):
        return "[REDACTED]"
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {item: redact(value[item], item) for item in sorted(value)}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [redact(item) for item in value]
    return value


def _catalog_view(catalog):
    definitions = catalog.get("definitions", {}) if isinstance(catalog, dict) else {}
    result = {}
    for service_type, definition in sorted(definitions.items()):
        if not isinstance(definition, dict):
            continue
        if definition.get("x-conformanceOnly") is True:
            continue
        metadata = definition.get("metadata", {}) if isinstance(definition, dict) else {}
        result[service_type] = {
            "definitionVersion": metadata.get("version"),
            "displayName": metadata.get("displayName", service_type),
            "description": metadata.get("description"),
            "modes": sorted((definition.get("modes") or {}).keys()),
            "topology": definition.get("modes", {}),
            "capabilities": sorted(definition.get("capabilities") or []),
            "configuration": definition.get("configuration", {}),
            "endpoint": definition.get("endpoint"),
            "endpointProvider": definition.get("endpointProvider"),
            "compatibilityRef": definition.get("compatibilityRef"),
            "definitionDigest": definition.get("x-definitionDigest"),
        }
    return result


def _configuration_view(configuration, desired_state_path, role_default_paths, ownership):
    result = redact(configuration)
    for deployment_id, service in result.get("services", {}).items():
        service_type = service.get("serviceType")
        for setting_name, setting in service.get("configuration", {}).items():
            source = setting.get("source") if isinstance(setting, dict) else None
            logical_path = "serviceDeployments.%s.configuration.%s" % (deployment_id, setting_name)
            if source == "ROLE_DEFAULT":
                setting["physicalOrigin"] = {"kind": "ROLE_DEFAULT", "logicalPath": role_default_paths.get(service_type)}
                setting["editPolicy"] = "OVERRIDE"
                setting["semanticSource"] = "ROLE_DEFAULT"
                setting["logicalPath"] = logical_path
                if desired_state_path:
                    setting["overrideTarget"] = {"intendedDocument": desired_state_path, "logicalPath": logical_path}
            elif source == "DEPLOYMENT_OVERRIDE":
                setting["physicalOrigin"] = ({"kind": "GROUP_VARS", "logicalPath": desired_state_path}
                                             if desired_state_path else {"kind": "UNKNOWN"})
                setting["editPolicy"] = ("FUTURE_EDITABLE" if ownership.get(desired_state_path) == "INSTALLER_OWNED"
                                         else "READ_ONLY_UNRESOLVED" if not desired_state_path else "READ_ONLY")
                setting["semanticSource"] = "USER_PROJECT_VALUE"
                setting["logicalPath"] = logical_path
            else:
                setting.setdefault("editPolicy", "READ_ONLY_UNRESOLVED")
                setting.setdefault("semanticSource", source or "DERIVED")
                setting.setdefault("physicalOrigin", {"kind": "UNKNOWN"})
        for member in service.get("members", {}).values():
            for setting in member.get("configuration", {}).values():
                if isinstance(setting, dict) and setting.get("source") == "MEMBER_OVERRIDE":
                    setting["physicalOrigin"] = {"kind": "INVENTORY", "logicalPath": "inventory/hosts.yml"}
                    setting["editPolicy"] = "READ_ONLY"
                    setting["semanticSource"] = "USER_PROJECT_VALUE"
    return result


def _integration_view(desired_state, catalog, endpoint_result, haproxy_result, dns_result, hosts):
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    definitions = catalog.get("definitions", {}) if isinstance(catalog, dict) else {}
    providers = {}
    for deployment_id, deployment in sorted(deployments.items()):
        definition = definitions.get(deployment.get("serviceType"), {}) if isinstance(deployment, dict) else {}
        group_id = deployment.get("endpointGroupRef") if isinstance(deployment, dict) else None
        if group_id and isinstance(definition.get("endpointProvider"), dict):
            providers.setdefault(group_id, []).append({
                "deploymentId": deployment_id,
                "virtualAddresses": deployment.get("virtualAddresses", []),
                "status": "STATIC_VALID",
            })
    relations = service_integration_relations(desired_state, set(
        item.get("serviceType") for item in deployments.values() if isinstance(item, dict)
    ), inventory_deployments={host: value.get("platformDeployments", {}) for host, value in hosts.items()})
    for relation in relations:
        relation["endpoint"] = endpoint_result.get("endpoints", {}).get(relation["sourceDeploymentId"])
        relation["addressProviders"] = providers.get(relation.get("endpointGroupId"), [])
    return {
        "relations": relations,
        "addressProvidersByEndpointGroup": providers,
        "haproxyBackends": haproxy_result.get("backends", {}),
        "dnsZones": dns_result.get("zones", {}),
    }


def build_project_snapshot(project_id, project_name, documents, project_revision, catalog,
                           hosts, desired_state, topology_result, configuration_result,
                           endpoint_result, pki_result, haproxy_result,
                           dns_result, desired_state_path, role_default_paths, core_version="0.1.0", identity_source="PROJECT_MANIFEST", references=None):
    ownership = {item["logicalPath"]: item["ownership"] for item in documents}
    results = (topology_result, configuration_result, endpoint_result, pki_result, haproxy_result, dns_result)
    findings = []
    for item in results:
        findings.extend(item.get("findings", []) if isinstance(item, dict) else [])
    unique = {}
    for finding in findings:
        key = (finding.get("field", ""), finding.get("code", ""), finding.get("safeMessage", ""))
        unique[key] = finding
    findings = [unique[key] for key in sorted(unique)]
    blocked = bool(findings)
    topology = topology_result.get("resolvedTopology") if topology_result.get("status") == "PASS" else None
    configuration = _configuration_view(configuration_result, desired_state_path, role_default_paths, ownership)
    requests = pki_result.get("requests", []) if pki_result.get("status") == "PASS" else []
    identities = [{key: item[key] for key in (
        "id", "scope", "tlsProfileId", "dnsNames", "ipAddresses", "consumers",
        "certificateRequestFingerprint") if key in item} for item in requests]
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    readiness = {}
    for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
        affected = any(deployment_id in finding.get("field", "") for finding in findings)
        readiness[deployment_id] = {
            "status": "BLOCKED" if affected else "REQUIRES_PREPARATION",
            "runtime": "NOT_CHECKED",
        }
    validation = {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/validation-result/v1alpha1",
        "kind": "ValidationResult",
        "status": "BLOCKED" if blocked else "PASS",
        "summary": {"blocked": len(findings), "pass": 0 if blocked else 1},
        "findings": findings,
    }
    snapshot = {
        "apiVersion": API_VERSION,
        "kind": "ProjectSnapshot",
        "status": "PARTIAL" if blocked else "PASS",
        "partial": blocked,
        "project": {"id": project_id, "name": project_name, "identitySource": identity_source},
        "projectRevision": project_revision,
        "catalogRevision": catalog.get("digest"),
        "coreVersion": core_version,
        "documents": documents,
        "hosts": {key: hosts[key] for key in sorted(hosts)},
        "references": redact(references if isinstance(references, dict) else {"hosts": {}}),
        "serviceCatalog": _catalog_view(catalog),
        "serviceDeployments": redact(deployments),
        "effectiveConfiguration": configuration,
        "endpointGroups": redact(desired_state.get("endpointGroups", {})),
        "topology": {"resolved": topology, "placementsByHost": {
            host_id: hosts[host_id].get("platformDeployments", {}) for host_id in sorted(hosts)
        }} if topology is not None else None,
        "endpoints": redact({
            "deployments": endpoint_result.get("endpoints", {}),
            "hosts": endpoint_result.get("hostEndpoints", {}),
        }),
        "integrations": redact(_integration_view(
            desired_state, catalog, endpoint_result, haproxy_result, dns_result, hosts,
        )),
        "pki": {"status": pki_result.get("status"), "certificateIdentities": redact(identities)},
        "validation": validation,
        "readiness": {"status": "BLOCKED" if blocked else "REQUIRES_PREPARATION", "services": readiness},
        "findings": findings,
    }
    snapshot["snapshotFingerprint"] = canonical_digest(snapshot)
    return redact(snapshot)

def finding(code, field, message, status="BLOCKED"):

        "status": status,

def select_desired_state(manifest, legacy_topology, ansible_desired_state=None):
    """Choose Ansible-native desired state with bounded project compatibility."""
    manifest = manifest if isinstance(manifest, dict) else {}
    legacy = legacy_topology if isinstance(legacy_topology, dict) else {}
    native = ansible_desired_state if isinstance(ansible_desired_state, dict) else {}
    current = manifest.get("desiredState")
    has_current = isinstance(current, dict)
    has_legacy = bool(legacy)
    has_native = bool(native)
    findings = []
    if has_native:
        compatibility = []
        if has_current:
            compatibility.append(("project.yml desiredState", current))
        if has_legacy:
            compatibility.append(("platform_project", legacy))
        if any(canonical_digest(candidate) != canonical_digest(native) for _, candidate in compatibility):
            findings.append(finding(
                "ANSIBLE_DESIRED_STATE_CONFLICT", "platform_desired_state",
                "Ansible-native desired state differs from a compatibility desired-state source",
            ))
        elif compatibility:
            findings.append(finding(
                "ANSIBLE_DESIRED_STATE_COMPATIBILITY_DEPRECATED", "platform_desired_state",
                "Ansible-native desired state duplicates deprecated compatibility input: %s" %
                ", ".join(source for source, _ in compatibility), "DEPRECATED",
            ))
        return native, findings
    if has_current and has_legacy:
        if canonical_digest(current) != canonical_digest(legacy):
            findings.append(finding(
                "DESIRED_STATE_LEGACY_CONFLICT", "desiredState",
                "project.yml desiredState and legacy platform_project differ",
            ))
        else:
            findings.append(finding(
                "LEGACY_PLATFORM_PROJECT_DEPRECATED", "platform_project",
                "Legacy platform_project duplicates project.yml desiredState", "DEPRECATED",
            ))
        return current, findings
    if has_current:
        return current, findings
    if has_legacy:
        findings.append(finding(
            "LEGACY_PLATFORM_PROJECT_DEPRECATED", "platform_project",
            "Legacy platform_project is a compatibility input; migrate to project.yml desiredState",
            "DEPRECATED",
        ))
        return legacy, findings
    return {}, findings


def synthesize_ansible_manifest(desired_state, service_catalog, project_id="ansible-project"):
    """Build an ephemeral validation manifest; it is never persisted as desired state."""
    desired_state = desired_state if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    service_catalog = service_catalog if isinstance(service_catalog, dict) else {}
    definitions = service_catalog.get("definitions", {}) if isinstance(service_catalog.get("definitions"), dict) else {}
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(desired_state.get("serviceDeployments"), dict) else {}
    used = sorted(set(
        item.get("serviceType") for item in deployments.values()
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("serviceType")
    ))
    services = {}
    for service_type in used:
        definition = definitions.get(service_type, {})
        metadata = definition.get("metadata", {}) if isinstance(definition, dict) else {}
        services[service_type] = {
            "definitionVersion": metadata.get("version", "unknown"),
            "digest": definition.get("x-definitionDigest", "sha256:" + ("0" * 64)),
        }
    return {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/v2alpha1",
        "kind": "PlatformProject",
        "metadata": {"id": project_id or "ansible-project"},
        "desiredStateContract": "platform.installer/project-desired-state/v2alpha1",
        "catalogLock": {
            "apiVersion": "platform.installer/catalog/v1alpha1",
            "digest": service_catalog.get("digest", "sha256:" + ("0" * 64)),
            "services": services,
        },
        "artifactLock": {
            "apiVersion": "platform.installer/artifacts/v1alpha1",
            "digest": "sha256:" + ("0" * 64),
        },
    }


def canonical_placements(placement_by_host, inventory_hosts):
    """Canonicalize inventory host-level platform_members without Ansible precedence."""
    inventory_set = set(inventory_hosts or [])
    source = placement_by_host if isinstance(placement_by_host, dict) else {}
    result, findings = {}, []
    for host_id in sorted(source):
        deployments = source[host_id]
        if host_id not in inventory_set:
            findings.append(finding("PLACEMENT_HOST_NOT_TARGET", "platform_members.%s" % host_id,
                                    "Placement host is not a platform target"))
            continue
        if not isinstance(deployments, dict):
            findings.append(finding("PLACEMENT_ENTRY_INVALID", "platform_members.%s" % host_id,
                                    "Host platform_members must be a deployment map"))
            continue
        for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
            members = deployments[deployment_id]
            if not isinstance(members, list):
                findings.append(finding("PLACEMENT_ENTRY_INVALID", "platform_members.%s.%s" % (host_id, deployment_id),
                                        "Deployment placement must be a member list"))
                continue
            for member_id in members:
                key = (deployment_id, member_id)
                if key in result:
                    findings.append(finding("PLACEMENT_ENTRY_DUPLICATE", "platform_members.%s.%s" % (host_id, deployment_id),
                                            "A member may be placed only once"))
                result[key] = host_id
    return result, findings


def canonical_inventory_members(deployments_by_host, inventory_hosts):
    """Normalize reserved host.platform_deployments into canonical members."""
    inventory_set = set(inventory_hosts or [])
    source = deployments_by_host if isinstance(deployments_by_host, dict) else {}
    result, findings = {}, []
    for host_id in sorted(source):
        deployments = source[host_id]
        field_prefix = "platform_deployments.%s" % host_id
        if host_id not in inventory_set:
            findings.append(finding("MEMBER_HOST_NOT_TARGET", field_prefix,
                                    "Host with platform_deployments is not a platform target"))
            continue
        if not isinstance(deployments, dict):
            findings.append(finding("INVENTORY_DEPLOYMENTS_INVALID", field_prefix,
                                    "platform_deployments must be a deployment map"))
            continue
        for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
            deployment = deployments[deployment_id]
            if not isinstance(deployment, dict):
                findings.append(finding("INVENTORY_DEPLOYMENT_INVALID", "%s.%s" % (field_prefix, deployment_id),
                                        "Inventory deployment must be an object"))
                continue
            # A deployment without members is a host-scoped placement.  Its
            # service manifest decides whether that shape is valid; preserving
            # it here avoids inventing logical member ids for host-native roles.
            if "members" not in deployment:
                continue
            members = deployment.get("members")
            member_prefix = "%s.%s.members" % (field_prefix, deployment_id)
            if not isinstance(members, dict):
                findings.append(finding("INVENTORY_MEMBERS_INVALID", member_prefix,
                                        "Deployment members must be an object keyed by member id"))
                continue
            for member_id in sorted(members):
                member = members[member_id]
                key = (deployment_id, member_id)
                if key in result:
                    findings.append(finding("INVENTORY_MEMBER_DUPLICATE", member_prefix,
                                            "A member may be owned by only one inventory host"))
                    continue
                if not isinstance(member, dict):
                    findings.append(finding("INVENTORY_MEMBER_INVALID", "%s.%s" % (member_prefix, member_id),
                                            "Inventory member must be an object"))
                    continue
                result[key] = {
                    "host": host_id,
                    "roles": member.get("roles", []),
                    "configuration": member.get("configuration", {}),
                    "identity": member.get("identity", {}),
                }
    return result, findings


def topology_with_inventory_members(desired_state, inventory_members):
    """Compose the ephemeral resolver view; persistent project state stays member-free."""
    desired_state = desired_state if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {})
    result = dict(desired_state)
    result_deployments = {}
    for deployment_id, deployment in (deployments.items() if isinstance(deployments, dict) else []):
        copied = dict(deployment) if isinstance(deployment, dict) else deployment
        if isinstance(copied, dict):
            copied["members"] = {
                member_id: dict(member)
                for (candidate_deployment, member_id), member in sorted(inventory_members.items())
                if candidate_deployment == deployment_id
            }
        result_deployments[deployment_id] = copied
    result["serviceDeployments"] = result_deployments
    return result

def canonical_digest(value):
    encoded = json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()


def _canonical_fingerprint(value):
    return canonical_digest(value)


def _finding(code, field, message, details=None):
    finding = {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1",
        "kind": "Finding",
        "code": code,
        "status": "BLOCKED",
        "category": "project-validation",
        "field": field,
        "safeMessage": message,
    }
    if details:
        finding["safeDetails"] = details
    return finding

def _configuration_finding(code, field, message, service_type, deployment_id, **details):
    safe_details = {"service": service_type, "deploymentId": deployment_id}
    safe_details.update(details)
    return _finding(code, field, message, safe_details)


def _suggest_property(value, candidates):
    matches = get_close_matches(value, sorted(candidates), n=1, cutoff=0.75)
    return matches[0] if matches else None


def _matches_configuration_type(value, expected):
    if expected == "integer":
        return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
    if expected == "number":
        return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
    if expected == "string":
        return isinstance(value, str)
    if expected == "boolean":
        return isinstance(value, bool)
    if expected == "object":
        return isinstance(value, dict)
    if expected == "array":
        return isinstance(value, list)
    if expected == "null":
        return value is None
    return True


def _validate_configuration_value(value, setting, field, service_type, deployment_id):
    """Validate literal managed input from a published service setting."""
    if isinstance(value, str) and ("{{" in value or "{%" in value or "{#" in value):
        return []
    expected = setting.get("type")
    validation = setting.get("validation", {}) if isinstance(setting.get("validation", {}), dict) else {}
    findings = []
    if expected and not _matches_configuration_type(value, expected):
        return [_configuration_finding(
            "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_TYPE_INVALID", field,
            "Configuration property does not match the service schema type",
            service_type, deployment_id, expected=[expected], property=field.rsplit(".", 1)[-1],
        )]
    if "enum" in validation and value not in validation["enum"]:
        findings.append(_configuration_finding(
            "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_ENUM_INVALID", field,
            "Configuration property is not one of the values allowed by the service schema",
            service_type, deployment_id, property=field.rsplit(".", 1)[-1],
        ))
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        if "minimum" in validation and value < validation["minimum"]:
            findings.append(_configuration_finding("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_MINIMUM_INVALID", field,
                "Configuration property is below the service schema minimum", service_type, deployment_id,
                property=field.rsplit(".", 1)[-1], minimum=validation["minimum"]))
        if "maximum" in validation and value > validation["maximum"]:
            findings.append(_configuration_finding("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_MAXIMUM_INVALID", field,
                "Configuration property is above the service schema maximum", service_type, deployment_id,
                property=field.rsplit(".", 1)[-1], maximum=validation["maximum"]))
    if isinstance(value, str) and "minLength" in validation and len(value) < validation["minLength"]:
        findings.append(_configuration_finding("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_MIN_LENGTH_INVALID", field,
            "Configuration string is shorter than the service schema minimum", service_type, deployment_id,
            property=field.rsplit(".", 1)[-1], minLength=validation["minLength"]))
    return findings


def _validate_managed_configuration(definition, configuration, field_prefix, scope, service_type, deployment_id, source_namespace):
    """Validate only service-owned configuration namespaces; ordinary vars stay opaque."""
    findings = []
    configuration = configuration if configuration is not None else {}
    if not isinstance(configuration, dict):
        return [_configuration_finding("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_INVALID", field_prefix,
            "Service configuration must be an object", service_type, deployment_id,
            sourceNamespace=source_namespace)]
    if not isinstance(definition, dict) or not isinstance(definition.get("configuration"), dict):
        return []
    contract = definition.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(definition, dict) else {}
    settings = contract.get("settings") if isinstance(contract, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(settings, dict):
        if configuration:
            return [_configuration_finding("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_SETTINGS_REQUIRED", "catalog.definitions.%s.configuration.settings" % service_type,
                "Service package must declare configuration settings", service_type, deployment_id,
                sourceNamespace="service catalog")]
        return []
    for logical, value in sorted(configuration.items()):
        setting = settings.get(logical)
        field = "%s.%s" % (field_prefix, logical)
        if not isinstance(setting, dict):
            details = {"sourceNamespace": source_namespace, "property": logical}
            suggested = _suggest_property(logical, settings)
            if suggested:
                details["suggestedProperty"] = suggested
            findings.append(_configuration_finding("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PROPERTY_UNKNOWN", field,
                "Configuration property is not declared by the service schema", service_type, deployment_id, **details))
            continue
        scopes = setting.get("scopes", [])
        if scope not in scopes:
            findings.append(_configuration_finding("MEMBER_SCOPE_SETTING_NOT_ALLOWED", field,
                "Configuration property is not allowed at this scope", service_type, deployment_id,
                sourceNamespace=source_namespace, property=logical, scope=scope, allowedScopes=scopes))
            continue
        if setting.get("kind") == "ADVANCED":
            if not isinstance(value, dict):
                findings.append(_configuration_finding("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_TYPE_INVALID", field,
                    "Advanced configuration must be an object", service_type, deployment_id,
                    sourceNamespace=source_namespace, property=logical, expected=["object"]))
                continue
            reserved = definition.get("x-reservedAdvancedProperties", []) if isinstance(definition, dict) else []
            reserved_names = set(reserved if isinstance(reserved, list) else [])
            if service_type == "kafka":
                reserved_names.update(
                    property_name for property_name in value
                    if isinstance(property_name, str) and re.match(r"^listener\.name\..*\.ssl\.", property_name)
                )
            for property_name in sorted(set(value).intersection(reserved_names)):
                findings.append(_configuration_finding("ADVANCED_SETTING_RESERVED", "%s.%s" % (field, property_name),
                    "Advanced configuration property is controlled by the service role", service_type, deployment_id,
                    sourceNamespace=source_namespace, property=property_name))
            continue
        findings.extend(_validate_configuration_value(value, setting, field, service_type, deployment_id))
    return findings


def _supported_modes(definition):
    modes = definition.get("modes", {}) if isinstance(definition, dict) else {}
    if isinstance(modes, dict):
        return set(modes.keys())
    if isinstance(modes, list):
        return {
            mode.get("id") if isinstance(mode, dict) else mode
            for mode in modes
            if (isinstance(mode, str) and mode) or (isinstance(mode, dict) and mode.get("id"))
        }
    return set()


def _definition_version(definition):
    if not isinstance(definition, dict):
        return None
    metadata = definition.get("metadata", {})
    return definition.get("definitionVersion") or (
        metadata.get("version") if isinstance(metadata, dict) else None
    )


def _is_digest(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and DIGEST_PATTERN.match(value) is not None


def _normalized_key(value):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", value.lower())


def _is_secret_value_key(key):
    normalized = _normalized_key(key)
    if normalized.endswith("ref"):
        return False
    if normalized == "secretrequirements":
        return False
    return any(term in normalized for term in SECRET_KEY_TERMS)


def _secret_value_fields(value, path="", identifier_map=False):
    fields = []
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key in sorted(value, key=lambda item: str(item)):
            child_path = "%s.%s" % (path, key) if path else str(key)
            if isinstance(key, str) and not identifier_map and _is_secret_value_key(key):
                fields.append(child_path)
            child_identifier_map = isinstance(key, str) and key in IDENTIFIER_MAP_FIELDS
            fields.extend(
                _secret_value_fields(value[key], child_path, child_identifier_map)
            )
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, item in enumerate(value):
            child_path = "%s[%d]" % (path, index)
            fields.extend(_secret_value_fields(item, child_path, False))
    return fields


def validate_project(manifest, topology, desired_hosts, service_catalog, inventory_hosts, placements=None, host_scoped_deployments=None, inventory_host_addresses=None):
    manifest = manifest if isinstance(manifest, dict) else {}
    topology = topology if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    service_catalog = service_catalog if isinstance(service_catalog, dict) else {}
    inventory_host_set = set(inventory_hosts or [])
    placements = placements if isinstance(placements, dict) else None
    findings = []

    if manifest.get("apiVersion") != SUPPORTED_PROJECT_API_VERSION:
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "PROJECT_API_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED",
                "apiVersion",
                "Project apiVersion is missing or unsupported",
                {"supported": [SUPPORTED_PROJECT_API_VERSION]},
            )
        )
    if manifest.get("kind") != "PlatformProject":
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "PROJECT_KIND_INVALID",
                "kind",
                "Project kind must be PlatformProject",
            )
        )
    metadata = manifest.get("metadata", {})
    if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or not isinstance(metadata.get("id"), str) or not metadata.get("id", "").strip():
        findings.append(
            _finding("PROJECT_ID_REQUIRED", "metadata.id", "Project metadata.id must be a non-empty string")
        )
    if manifest.get("desiredStateContract") != "platform.installer/project-desired-state/v2alpha1":
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "PROJECT_DESIRED_STATE_CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED",
                "desiredStateContract",
                "Project desiredStateContract is missing or unsupported",
            )
        )
    catalog_lock = manifest.get("catalogLock", {})
    if not isinstance(catalog_lock, dict):
        findings.append(
            _finding("PROJECT_CATALOG_INVALID", "catalogLock", "Project catalog lock must be an object")
        )
        catalog_lock = {}
    if catalog_lock.get("apiVersion") != "platform.installer/catalog/v1alpha1":
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "PROJECT_CATALOG_API_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED",
                "catalogLock.apiVersion",
                "Project catalog lock apiVersion is missing or unsupported",
            )
        )
    if not _is_digest(catalog_lock.get("digest")):
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "PROJECT_CATALOG_DIGEST_INVALID",
                "catalogLock.digest",
                "Project catalog lock must declare a valid SHA256 digest",
            )
        )
    catalog_services = catalog_lock.get("services", {})
    if not isinstance(catalog_services, dict):
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "PROJECT_CATALOG_SERVICES_INVALID",
                "catalogLock.services",
                "Project catalog services lock must be an object",
            )
        )
        catalog_services = {}
    artifact_lock = manifest.get("artifactLock", {})
    if not isinstance(artifact_lock, dict) or artifact_lock.get("apiVersion") != "platform.installer/artifacts/v1alpha1":
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "PROJECT_ARTIFACT_LOCK_INVALID",
                "artifactLock",
                "Project artifact lock is missing or has an unsupported apiVersion",
            )
        )
    elif not _is_digest(artifact_lock.get("digest")):
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "PROJECT_ARTIFACT_DIGEST_INVALID",
                "artifactLock.digest",
                "Project artifact lock must declare a valid SHA256 digest",
            )
        )

    desired_hosts = desired_hosts if isinstance(desired_hosts, dict) else {}

    for field in sorted(
        set(
            _secret_value_fields(topology)
            + _secret_value_fields(desired_hosts, "hosts", True)
        )
    ):
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "PLAINTEXT_SECRET_FIELD_FORBIDDEN",
                field,
                "Portable desired state must use a runtime secret reference instead of a secret value field",
            )
        )

    if service_catalog.get("apiVersion") != "platform.installer/catalog/v1alpha1" or service_catalog.get("kind") != "ServiceCatalog":
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "SERVICE_CATALOG_INVALID",
                "catalog",
                "Published service catalog identity is missing or unsupported",
            )
        )
    unsigned_catalog = {
        key: value for key, value in service_catalog.items() if key != "digest"
    }
    computed_catalog_digest = canonical_digest(unsigned_catalog)
    if service_catalog.get("digest") != computed_catalog_digest:
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "SERVICE_CATALOG_DIGEST_MISMATCH",
                "catalog.digest",
                "Published service catalog digest does not match its canonical content",
                {
                    "computedDigest": computed_catalog_digest,
                    "declaredDigest": service_catalog.get("digest"),
                },
            )
        )
    if catalog_lock.get("digest") != computed_catalog_digest:
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "PROJECT_CATALOG_DIGEST_MISMATCH",
                "catalogLock.digest",
                "Project catalog lock does not match the canonical published catalog",
                {
                    "catalogDigest": computed_catalog_digest,
                    "lockedDigest": catalog_lock.get("digest"),
                },
            )
        )

    deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {})
    if not isinstance(deployments, dict):
        findings.append(
            _finding(
                "SERVICE_DEPLOYMENTS_INVALID",
                "serviceDeployments",
                "serviceDeployments must be an object keyed by deployment id",
            )
        )
        deployments = {}

    authorities = topology.get("certificateAuthorities", {})
    profiles = topology.get("certificateProfiles", {})
    tls_profiles = topology.get("tlsProfiles", {})
    if not isinstance(authorities, dict):
        findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_AUTHORITIES_INVALID", "certificateAuthorities", "Certificate authorities must be an object"))
        authorities = {}
    if not isinstance(profiles, dict):
        findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_PROFILES_INVALID", "certificateProfiles", "Certificate profiles must be an object"))
        profiles = {}
    if not isinstance(tls_profiles, dict):
        findings.append(_finding("TLS_PROFILES_INVALID", "tlsProfiles", "TLS profiles must be an object"))
        tls_profiles = {}
    for profile_id, profile in sorted(profiles.items()):
        authority_ref = profile.get("authorityRef") if isinstance(profile, dict) else None
        if authority_ref not in authorities:
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_AUTHORITY_NOT_FOUND", "certificateProfiles.%s.authorityRef" % profile_id, "Certificate profile references an unknown certificate authority"))
    for tls_profile_id, tls_profile in sorted(tls_profiles.items()):
        profile_ref = tls_profile.get("certificateProfileRef") if isinstance(tls_profile, dict) else None
        if profile_ref not in profiles:
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND", "tlsProfiles.%s.certificateProfileRef" % tls_profile_id, "TLS profile references an unknown certificate profile"))

    definitions = _catalog_definitions(service_catalog)
    endpoint_groups = topology.get("endpointGroups", {})
    if not isinstance(endpoint_groups, dict):
        findings.append(_finding("ENDPOINT_GROUPS_INVALID", "endpointGroups", "Endpoint groups must be an object keyed by endpoint group id"))
        endpoint_groups = {}
    virtual_address_owner = {}
    for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
        deployment = deployments[deployment_id]
        prefix = "serviceDeployments.%s" % deployment_id
        if not isinstance(deployment, dict):
            findings.append(
                _finding("SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT_INVALID", prefix, "Service deployment must be an object")
            )
            continue

        service_type = deployment.get("serviceType")
        definition = definitions.get(service_type)
        if not service_type:
            findings.append(
                _finding(
                    "SERVICE_TYPE_REQUIRED",
                    prefix + ".serviceType",
                    "Service deployment must select a service type",
                )
            )
        elif definition is None:
            findings.append(
                _finding(
                    "SERVICE_DEFINITION_NOT_FOUND",
                    prefix + ".serviceType",
                    "Referenced service definition is not available in the pinned catalog",
                    {"serviceType": service_type},
                )
            )
        else:
            endpoint_group = deployment.get("endpointGroup")
            if endpoint_group is not None:
                if endpoint_group not in endpoint_groups:
                    findings.append(_finding("ENDPOINT_GROUP_NOT_FOUND", prefix + ".endpointGroup", "Endpoint group reference is not defined"))
                elif not isinstance(definition.get("endpoint"), dict):
                    findings.append(_configuration_finding("ENDPOINT_SERVICE_UNSUPPORTED", prefix + ".endpointGroup", "Service package does not support a generic client endpoint", service_type, deployment_id))
            endpoint_group_ref = deployment.get("endpointGroupRef")
            endpoint_provider = isinstance(definition.get("endpointProvider"), dict)
            provider_fields = ("endpointGroupRef", "virtualRouterId", "virtualAddresses")
            if endpoint_provider:
                for field_name in provider_fields:
                    if field_name not in deployment:
                        findings.append(_finding("ENDPOINT_PROVIDER_FIELD_REQUIRED", prefix + "." + field_name, "Endpoint provider deployment requires " + field_name))
            if endpoint_group_ref is not None:
                if endpoint_group_ref not in endpoint_groups:
                    findings.append(_finding("ENDPOINT_GROUP_NOT_FOUND", prefix + ".endpointGroupRef", "Endpoint group reference is not defined"))
                elif not endpoint_provider:
                    findings.append(_configuration_finding("ENDPOINT_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED", prefix + ".endpointGroupRef", "Service package does not provide endpoint-group addresses", service_type, deployment_id))
            elif any(field_name in deployment for field_name in provider_fields):
                findings.append(_configuration_finding("ENDPOINT_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED", prefix, "Service package does not provide endpoint-group addresses", service_type, deployment_id))
            virtual_addresses = deployment.get("virtualAddresses", [])
            if endpoint_provider and isinstance(virtual_addresses, list):
                for index, virtual_address in enumerate(virtual_addresses):
                    address = virtual_address.get("address") if isinstance(virtual_address, dict) else None
                    if isinstance(address, str):
                        previous = virtual_address_owner.get(address)
                        if previous is not None:
                            findings.append(_finding("VIRTUAL_ADDRESS_DUPLICATE", prefix + ".virtualAddresses.%d.address" % index, "A virtual address may belong to only one endpoint-provider deployment", {"address": address, "otherDeploymentId": previous}))
                        else:
                            virtual_address_owner[address] = deployment_id
            service_lock = catalog_services.get(service_type)
            if not isinstance(service_lock, dict):
                findings.append(
                    _finding(
                        "SERVICE_CATALOG_LOCK_NOT_FOUND",
                        "catalogLock.services.%s" % service_type,
                        "Used service type must be pinned by the project catalog lock",
                        {"serviceType": service_type},
                    )
                )
            else:
                locked_version = service_lock.get("definitionVersion")
                selected_version = deployment.get("definitionVersion")
                catalog_version = _definition_version(definition)
                if selected_version and (selected_version != locked_version or (
                    catalog_version and selected_version != catalog_version
                )):
                    findings.append(
                        _finding(
                            "SERVICE_DEFINITION_VERSION_MISMATCH",
                            prefix + ".definitionVersion",
                            "Deployment, project lock, and catalog definition versions must match",
                            {
                                "catalogVersion": catalog_version,
                                "lockedVersion": locked_version,
                                "selectedVersion": selected_version,
                            },
                        )
                    )
                locked_digest = service_lock.get("digest")
                definition_digest = (
                    definition.get("x-definitionDigest")
                    if isinstance(definition, dict)
                    else None
                )
                if isinstance(definition, dict):
                    unsigned_definition = {
                        key: value
                        for key, value in definition.items()
                        if key not in ("x-definitionDigest", "x-sourceManifest")
                    }
                    computed_definition_digest = canonical_digest(unsigned_definition)
                else:
                    computed_definition_digest = None
                if definition_digest != computed_definition_digest:
                    findings.append(
                        _finding(
                            "SERVICE_DEFINITION_DIGEST_MISMATCH",
                            "catalog.definitions.%s.x-definitionDigest" % service_type,
                            "Service definition digest does not match its canonical content",
                            {
                                "computedDigest": computed_definition_digest,
                                "declaredDigest": definition_digest,
                                "serviceType": service_type,
                            },
                        )
                    )
                if locked_digest != computed_definition_digest:
                    findings.append(
                        _finding(
                            "PROJECT_SERVICE_DEFINITION_DIGEST_MISMATCH",
                            "catalogLock.services.%s.digest" % service_type,
                            "Project service lock does not match the canonical service definition",
                            {
                                "definitionDigest": computed_definition_digest,
                                "lockedDigest": locked_digest,
                                "serviceType": service_type,
                            },
                        )
                    )
            mode = deployment.get("mode")
            modes = _supported_modes(definition)
            if not mode or mode not in modes:
                findings.append(
                    _finding(
                        "SERVICE_MODE_UNSUPPORTED",
                        prefix + ".mode",
                        "Selected service mode is not supported by the service definition",
                        {"serviceType": service_type, "supportedModes": sorted(modes)},
                    )
                )
            findings.extend(_validate_managed_configuration(
                definition,
                deployment.get("configuration", {}),
                prefix + ".configuration",
                "deployment",
                service_type,
                deployment_id,
                "platform_desired_state.serviceDeployments",
            ))

        mode_definition = {}
        if isinstance(definition, dict) and isinstance(definition.get("modes"), dict):
            mode_definition = definition["modes"].get(deployment.get("mode"), {})
        placement = mode_definition.get("placement", {}) if isinstance(mode_definition, dict) else {}
        host_scoped = placement.get("hostScoped") is True
        host_participants = (host_scoped_deployments or {}).get(deployment_id, {}) if host_scoped else {}
        if host_scoped:
            if "members" in deployment:
                findings.append(_finding("HOST_SCOPED_MEMBERS_FORBIDDEN", prefix + ".members", "Host-scoped services use inventory host placement and must not define logical members"))
            if not isinstance(host_participants, dict):
                findings.append(_finding("HOST_SCOPED_PLACEMENT_INVALID", prefix, "Host-scoped placement must be an inventory host map"))
                host_participants = {}
            for host_id, configuration in sorted(host_participants.items()):
                if host_id not in inventory_host_set:
                    findings.append(_finding("MEMBER_HOST_NOT_FOUND", "platform_deployments.%s.%s" % (host_id, deployment_id), "Host-scoped placement must reference a declared inventory host", {"host": host_id}))
                if not isinstance(configuration, dict):
                    findings.append(_finding("HOST_SCOPED_PLACEMENT_INVALID", "platform_deployments.%s.%s" % (host_id, deployment_id), "Host-scoped deployment configuration must be an object"))
            member_count = len(host_participants)
            minimum_members = placement.get("minMembers")
            maximum_members = placement.get("maxMembers")
            if isinstance(minimum_members, int) and member_count < minimum_members:
                findings.append(_finding("SERVICE_MEMBER_COUNT_BELOW_MINIMUM", prefix, "Service deployment has fewer participating hosts than the selected mode requires", {"actual": member_count, "minimum": minimum_members}))
            if isinstance(maximum_members, int) and member_count > maximum_members:
                findings.append(_finding("SERVICE_MEMBER_COUNT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM", prefix, "Service deployment has more participating hosts than the selected mode permits", {"actual": member_count, "maximum": maximum_members}))
            continue
        if deployment_id in (host_scoped_deployments or {}):
            findings.append(_finding("HOST_SCOPED_PLACEMENT_UNSUPPORTED", prefix, "Selected service mode does not support host-scoped inventory placement"))
        members = deployment.get("members", {})
        if not isinstance(members, dict):
            findings.append(
                _finding(
                    "SERVICE_MEMBERS_INVALID",
                    prefix + ".members",
                    "Service members must be an object keyed by member id",
                )
            )
            continue
        supported_roles = set(mode_definition.get("memberRoles", [])) if isinstance(mode_definition, dict) else set()
        placed_hosts = []
        for member_id in sorted(members):
            member = members[member_id]
            field = prefix + ".members.%s.host" % member_id
            host = placements.get((deployment_id, member_id)) if placements is not None else (member.get("host") if isinstance(member, dict) else None)
            if host:
                placed_hosts.append(host)
            if not host or host not in inventory_host_set:
                findings.append(
                    _finding(
                        "MEMBER_HOST_NOT_FOUND",
                        field,
                        "Explicit member placement must reference a declared inventory host",
                        {"host": host} if host else None,
                    )
                )
            roles = member.get("roles", []) if isinstance(member, dict) else []
            if not isinstance(roles, list):
                findings.append(
                    _finding(
                        "MEMBER_ROLES_INVALID",
                        prefix + ".members.%s.roles" % member_id,
                        "Member roles must be a list of role identifiers",
                    )
                )
                roles = []
            invalid_roles = [role for role in roles if not isinstance(role, str) or not role]
            if invalid_roles:
                findings.append(
                    _finding(
                        "MEMBER_ROLES_INVALID",
                        prefix + ".members.%s.roles" % member_id,
                        "Member roles must contain only non-empty string identifiers",
                    )
                )
            for role in sorted(set(role for role in roles if isinstance(role, str) and role)):
                if supported_roles and role not in supported_roles:
                    findings.append(
                        _finding(
                            "MEMBER_ROLE_UNSUPPORTED",
                            prefix + ".members.%s.roles" % member_id,
                            "Member role is not supported by the selected service mode",
                            {"role": role, "supportedRoles": sorted(supported_roles)},
                        )
                    )
            if isinstance(member, dict) and isinstance(definition, dict):
                findings.extend(_validate_managed_configuration(
                    definition,
                    member.get("configuration", {}),
                    prefix + ".members.%s.configuration" % member_id,
                    "member",
                    service_type,
                    deployment_id,
                    "inventory.platform_deployments" if placements is not None else "platform_desired_state",
                ))
        placement = mode_definition.get("placement", {}) if isinstance(mode_definition, dict) else {}
        member_count = len(members)
        minimum_members = placement.get("minMembers")
        maximum_members = placement.get("maxMembers")
        if isinstance(minimum_members, int) and member_count < minimum_members:
            findings.append(
                _finding(
                    "SERVICE_MEMBER_COUNT_BELOW_MINIMUM",
                    prefix + ".members",
                    "Service deployment has fewer members than the selected mode requires",
                    {"actual": member_count, "minimum": minimum_members},
                )
            )
        if isinstance(maximum_members, int) and member_count > maximum_members:
            findings.append(
                _finding(
                    "SERVICE_MEMBER_COUNT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM",
                    prefix + ".members",
                    "Service deployment has more members than the selected mode permits",
                    {"actual": member_count, "maximum": maximum_members},
                )
            )
        if placement.get("distinctHosts") and len(placed_hosts) != len(set(placed_hosts)):
            findings.append(
                _finding(
                    "PLACEMENT_DISTINCT_HOSTS_REQUIRED",
                    prefix + ".members",
                    "Selected service mode requires every member to use a distinct host",
                )
            )
        role_cardinality = placement.get("roleCardinality", {})
        if isinstance(role_cardinality, dict):
            for role in sorted(role_cardinality):
                constraint = role_cardinality[role]
                if not isinstance(constraint, dict):
                    continue
                actual = sum(
                    1
                    for member in members.values()
                    if isinstance(member, dict)
                    and isinstance(member.get("roles"), list)
                    and role in member["roles"]
                )
                minimum = constraint.get("minimum")
                maximum = constraint.get("maximum")
                if isinstance(minimum, int) and actual < minimum:
                    findings.append(
                        _finding(
                            "SERVICE_ROLE_COUNT_BELOW_MINIMUM",
                            prefix + ".members",
                            "Service deployment has fewer members with a required role than the selected mode permits",
                            {"actual": actual, "minimum": minimum, "role": role},
                        )
                    )
                if isinstance(maximum, int) and actual > maximum:
                    findings.append(
                        _finding(
                            "SERVICE_ROLE_COUNT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM",
                            prefix + ".members",
                            "Service deployment has more members with a role than the selected mode permits",
                            {"actual": actual, "maximum": maximum, "role": role},
                        )
                    )

    # NET-03 DNS semantics require only desired/inventory projections.  This
    # remains controller-only and must never infer addresses from target facts.
    bind_deployments = [
        item for item in deployments.values()
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("serviceType") == "bind"
    ]
    dns_client_deployments = [
        (deployment_id, item) for deployment_id, item in deployments.items()
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("serviceType") == "dns-client"
    ]
    if bind_deployments or dns_client_deployments:
        try:
            from .dns_resolution import resolve_dns_zones
        except ImportError:
            from dns_resolution import resolve_dns_zones
        dns_inventory_deployments = {}
        for deployment_id, participants in (host_scoped_deployments or {}).items():
            if not isinstance(participants, dict):
                continue
            for host_id, participant in participants.items():
                dns_inventory_deployments.setdefault(host_id, {})[deployment_id] = participant
        dns_result = resolve_dns_zones(
            topology, service_catalog, inventory_host_addresses or {}, dns_inventory_deployments
        )
        findings.extend(dns_result["findings"])
        for deployment_id, deployment in sorted(dns_client_deployments):
            prefix = "serviceDeployments.%s.configuration.dnsServerRef" % deployment_id
            configuration = deployment.get("configuration", {})
            reference = configuration.get("dnsServerRef") if isinstance(configuration, dict) else None
            referenced = deployments.get(reference) if isinstance(reference, str) else None
            if not isinstance(referenced, dict):
                findings.append(_finding(
                    "DNS_CLIENT_SERVER_NOT_FOUND", prefix,
                    "DNS client must reference an existing authoritative DNS deployment",
                    {"dnsServerRef": reference} if isinstance(reference, str) else None,
                ))
            elif referenced.get("serviceType") != "bind":
                findings.append(_finding(
                    "DNS_CLIENT_SERVER_TYPE_INVALID", prefix,
                    "DNS client dnsServerRef must reference a BIND deployment",
                    {"dnsServerRef": reference, "serviceType": referenced.get("serviceType")},
                ))
            elif reference not in dns_result["zones"]:
                findings.append(_finding(
                    "DNS_CLIENT_SERVER_RESOLUTION_BLOCKED", prefix,
                    "Referenced BIND deployment has no valid authoritative DNS projection",
                    {"dnsServerRef": reference},
                ))

    # NET-04 is target-free: endpoint and relation semantics are derived only
    # from canonical desired state plus declared inventory placement.
    try:
        from .service_endpoint_resolution import resolve_service_endpoints
        from .haproxy_resolution import resolve_haproxy_backends
    except ImportError:
        from service_endpoint_resolution import resolve_service_endpoints
        from haproxy_resolution import resolve_haproxy_backends
    endpoint_inventory = {}
    for deployment_id, participants in (host_scoped_deployments or {}).items():
        if isinstance(participants, dict):
            for host_id, participant in participants.items():
                endpoint_inventory.setdefault(host_id, {})[deployment_id] = participant
    endpoint_result = resolve_service_endpoints(topology, service_catalog, inventory_deployments=endpoint_inventory)
    findings.extend(endpoint_result["findings"])
    if any(isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("serviceType") == "haproxy" for item in deployments.values()):
        backend_result = resolve_haproxy_backends(topology, service_catalog, inventory_host_addresses or {}, endpoint_inventory, endpoint_result, {})
        findings.extend(backend_result["findings"])

    for deployment_id, deployment in sorted(deployments.items()):
        if not isinstance(deployment, dict) or deployment.get("serviceType") != "keepalived":
            continue
        tracking = deployment.get("configuration", {}).get("haproxyHealthTracking") if isinstance(deployment.get("configuration"), dict) else None
        if not isinstance(tracking, dict):
            continue
        reference = tracking.get("serviceDeploymentRef")
        field = "serviceDeployments.%s.configuration.haproxyHealthTracking.serviceDeploymentRef" % deployment_id
        referenced = deployments.get(reference)
        if not isinstance(referenced, dict):
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_HEALTH_TRACKING_DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND", field, "HAProxy health tracking references an unknown deployment"))
            continue
        if referenced.get("serviceType") != "haproxy":
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_HEALTH_TRACKING_DEPLOYMENT_TYPE_INVALID", field, "HAProxy health tracking must reference an HAProxy deployment"))
        if not deployment.get("endpointGroupRef") or referenced.get("endpointGroup") != deployment.get("endpointGroupRef"):
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_HEALTH_TRACKING_ENDPOINT_GROUP_MISMATCH", field, "Keepalived and HAProxy health tracking deployments must share an endpoint group"))
        for host_id, placement in sorted(endpoint_inventory.items()):
            if deployment_id in placement and reference not in placement:
                findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_HEALTH_TRACKING_PARTICIPANT_MISSING", "platform_deployments.%s.%s" % (host_id, deployment_id), "Every Keepalived participant with HAProxy tracking must also host the referenced HAProxy deployment"))

    findings.sort(key=lambda item: (item["field"], item["code"]))
    blocked = len(findings)
    return {
        "apiVersion": RESULT_API_VERSION,
        "kind": "ProjectValidationResult",
        "status": "BLOCKED" if blocked else "PASS",
        "projectFingerprint": _canonical_fingerprint(
            {
                "manifest": manifest,
                "desiredState": topology,
                "hosts": {key: desired_hosts[key] for key in sorted(desired_hosts)},
            }
        ),
        "summary": {
            "pass": 1 if blocked == 0 else 0,
            "actionRequired": 0,
            "blocked": blocked,
            "warning": 0,
            "unknown": 0,
            "skipped": 0,
        },
        "findings": findings,
    }


def write_validation_artifact(path, result):
    parent = os.path.dirname(path) or "."
    if not os.path.isdir(parent):
        os.makedirs(parent)
    descriptor, temporary_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".validation-", suffix=".json", dir=parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as artifact:
            json.dump(result, artifact, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
            artifact.write("\n")
            artifact.flush()
            os.fsync(artifact.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary_path, path)
    except Exception:
        try:
            os.unlink(temporary_path)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise
