@@PORTABLE {"path":"docker/application-connection-probe/main.go","mode":420,"size":15303,"sha256":"0cf58a973035cc04ff5049559ba3d401e51099a10c7796fb28e6cd5807287294","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":15303}
// application-connection-probe is a QA-only application started by Vault Agent.
// It never prints credential values or persists them in project files.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/tls"
	"crypto/x509"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type check struct {
	State  string `json:"state"`
	Reason string `json:"reason,omitempty"`
}

type status struct {
	Overall   string           `json:"overall"`
	Checks    map[string]check `json:"checks"`
	CheckedAt string           `json:"checkedAt"`
}

func env(name, fallback string) string {
	if value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return fallback
}

func result(err error) check {
	if err == nil {
		return check{State: "ok"}
	}
	// Errors may contain addresses, DSNs or fragments of server output. Expose only a code.
	return check{State: "failed", Reason: "CONNECTION_CHECK_FAILED"}
}

func require(names ...string) error {
	for _, name := range names {
		if os.Getenv(name) == "" {
			return errors.New("missing input")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func trustedPool(ctx context.Context) (*x509.CertPool, string, error) {
	path := os.Getenv("PROBE_TRUSTSTORE_PKCS12")
	if path == "" {
		return nil, "", errors.New("missing truststore")
	}
	if err := require("PROBE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/usr/bin/openssl", "pkcs12", "-in", path,
		"-nokeys", "-passin", "env:PROBE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD")
	pem, err := cmd.Output()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", errors.New("PKCS12_READ_FAILED")
	}
	pool := x509.NewCertPool()
	if !pool.AppendCertsFromPEM(pem) {
		return nil, "", errors.New("PKCS12_CERTS_MISSING")
	}
	// psql needs a file; /run/probe must be a container tmpfs, never a project mount.
	if err := os.MkdirAll("/run/probe", 0700); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	path = filepath.Join("/run/probe", "ca.pem")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, pem, 0600); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	return pool, path, nil
}

func clientIdentity(ctx context.Context) (tls.Certificate, string, string, error) {
	path := os.Getenv("PROBE_KEYSTORE_PKCS12")
	if path == "" || os.Getenv("PROBE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD") == "" {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", errors.New("missing client keystore")
	}
	extract := func(args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/usr/bin/openssl", append([]string{
			"pkcs12", "-in", path, "-passin", "env:PROBE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"}, args...)...)
		output, err := cmd.Output()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("PKCS12_CLIENT_READ_FAILED")
		}
		return output, nil
	}
	certPEM, err := extract("-clcerts", "-nokeys")
	if err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", err
	}
	keyPEM, err := extract("-nocerts", "-nodes")
	if err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", err
	}
	identity, err := tls.X509KeyPair(certPEM, keyPEM)
	if err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", errors.New("PKCS12_CLIENT_INVALID")
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll("/run/probe", 0700); err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", err
	}
	certPath, keyPath := "/run/probe/client-cert.pem", "/run/probe/client-key.pem"
	if err := os.WriteFile(certPath, certPEM, 0600); err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", err
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(keyPath, keyPEM, 0600); err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", err
	}
	return identity, certPath, keyPath, nil
}

func postgres(ctx context.Context, caPath, certPath, keyPath string) error {
	if err := require("PGHOST", "PGPORT", "PGDATABASE", "PGUSER", "PGPASSWORD"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/usr/bin/psql", "-X", "-A", "-t", "-q", "-c", "SELECT 1")
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "PGSSLMODE=verify-full", "PGSSLROOTCERT="+caPath,
		"PGSSLCERT="+certPath, "PGSSLKEY="+keyPath,
		"PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=4", "PGOPTIONS=-c statement_timeout=3000")
	output, err := cmd.Output()
	if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(string(output)) != "1" {
		return errors.New("POSTGRES_QUERY_FAILED")
	}
	return nil
}

func respWrite(conn net.Conn, args ...string) error {
	var builder strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "*%d\r\n", len(args))
	for _, arg := range args {
		fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "$%d\r\n%s\r\n", len(arg), arg)
	}
	_, err := io.WriteString(conn, builder.String())
	return err
}

func respLine(conn net.Conn) (string, error) {
	var bytes []byte
	for len(bytes) < 4096 {
		one := make([]byte, 1)
		if _, err := io.ReadFull(conn, one); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		bytes = append(bytes, one[0])
		if len(bytes) >= 2 && bytes[len(bytes)-2] == '\r' && bytes[len(bytes)-1] == '\n' {
			return string(bytes[:len(bytes)-2]), nil
		}
	}
	return "", errors.New("RESP_TOO_LONG")
}

func respBulk(conn net.Conn) (string, error) {
	line, err := respLine(conn)
	if err != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(line, "$") {
		return "", errors.New("RESP_BULK_INVALID")
	}
	size, err := strconv.Atoi(line[1:])
	if err != nil || size < 0 || size > 4096 {
		return "", errors.New("RESP_BULK_INVALID")
	}
	value := make([]byte, size+2)
	if _, err = io.ReadFull(conn, value); err != nil || string(value[size:]) != "\r\n" {
		return "", errors.New("RESP_BULK_INVALID")
	}
	return string(value[:size]), nil
}

func redis(ctx context.Context, pool *x509.CertPool, identity tls.Certificate, prefix string) error {
	host, port, user, password := prefix+"_HOST", prefix+"_PORT", prefix+"_USER", prefix+"_PASSWORD"
	if err := require(host, port, user, password); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return redisAt(ctx, pool, identity, os.Getenv(host), os.Getenv(port), os.Getenv(user), os.Getenv(password), prefix)
}

func redisAt(ctx context.Context, pool *x509.CertPool, identity tls.Certificate, host, port, user, password, prefix string) error {
	dialer := &tls.Dialer{NetDialer: &net.Dialer{Timeout: 4 * time.Second},
		Config: &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, RootCAs: pool, ServerName: host, Certificates: []tls.Certificate{identity}}}
	conn, err := dialer.DialContext(ctx, "tcp", net.JoinHostPort(host, port))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(4 * time.Second))
	if err = respWrite(conn, "AUTH", user, password); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	line, err := respLine(conn)
	if err != nil || line != "+OK" {
		return errors.New("REDIS_AUTH_FAILED")
	}
	if err = respWrite(conn, "PING"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	line, err = respLine(conn)
	if err != nil || line != "+PONG" {
		return errors.New("REDIS_PING_FAILED")
	}
	if prefix == "SENTINEL" {
		if err = require("SENTINEL_MASTER_NAME", "REDIS_TARGETS", "REDIS_USER", "REDIS_PASSWORD"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err = respWrite(conn, "SENTINEL", "get-master-addr-by-name", os.Getenv("SENTINEL_MASTER_NAME")); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		line, err = respLine(conn)
		if err != nil || line != "*2" {
			return errors.New("SENTINEL_DISCOVERY_FAILED")
		}
		master, err := respBulk(conn)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		masterPort, err := respBulk(conn)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		address := net.JoinHostPort(master, masterPort)
		for _, target := range strings.Split(os.Getenv("REDIS_TARGETS"), ",") {
			if strings.TrimSpace(target) == address {
				return redisAt(ctx, pool, identity, master, masterPort, os.Getenv("REDIS_USER"), os.Getenv("REDIS_PASSWORD"), "MASTER")
			}
		}
		return errors.New("SENTINEL_MASTER_UNEXPECTED")
	}
	// Only this QA application may write, and only with an explicit fixture namespace.
	if prefix == "REDIS" && os.Getenv("PROBE_REDIS_KEY_PREFIX") != "" {
		key := os.Getenv("PROBE_REDIS_KEY_PREFIX") + "probe-" + strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano(), 10)
		if err = respWrite(conn, "SET", key, "1", "EX", "30"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if line, err = respLine(conn); err != nil || line != "+OK" {
			return errors.New("REDIS_WRITE_FAILED")
		}
		defer respWrite(conn, "DEL", key)
		if err = respWrite(conn, "GET", key); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if value, err := respBulk(conn); err != nil || value != "1" {
			return errors.New("REDIS_READ_FAILED")
		}
		if err = respWrite(conn, "DEL", key); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if line, err = respLine(conn); err != nil || line != ":1" {
			return errors.New("REDIS_DELETE_FAILED")
		}
		if err = respWrite(conn, "GET", "__platform_forbidden_namespace__:probe"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if line, err = respLine(conn); err != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(line, "-NOPERM") {
			return errors.New("REDIS_NAMESPACE_UNRESTRICTED")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func kafka(ctx context.Context, pool *x509.CertPool) error {
	if os.Getenv("KAFKA_TARGETS") != "" {
		for _, target := range strings.Split(os.Getenv("KAFKA_TARGETS"), ",") {
			host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(strings.TrimSpace(target))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err = kafkaAt(ctx, pool, host, port); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	if err := require("KAFKA_HOST", "KAFKA_PORT"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return kafkaAt(ctx, pool, os.Getenv("KAFKA_HOST"), os.Getenv("KAFKA_PORT"))
}

func kafkaAt(ctx context.Context, pool *x509.CertPool, host, port string) error {
	dialer := &tls.Dialer{NetDialer: &net.Dialer{Timeout: 4 * time.Second},
		Config: &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, RootCAs: pool, ServerName: host}}
	conn, err := dialer.DialContext(ctx, "tcp", net.JoinHostPort(host, port))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(4 * time.Second))
	// ApiVersions v0: request header only, no SASL identity or topic operation.
	request := []byte{0, 0, 0, 10, 0, 18, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0}
	if _, err = conn.Write(request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var header [8]byte
	if _, err = io.ReadFull(conn, header[:]); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if size := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(header[:4]); size < 4 || size > 1<<20 || binary.BigEndian.Uint32(header[4:]) != 1 {
		return errors.New("KAFKA_PROTOCOL_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	body := make([]byte, binary.BigEndian.Uint32(header[:4])-4)
	if _, err = io.ReadFull(conn, body); err != nil || len(body) < 6 || binary.BigEndian.Uint16(body[:2]) != 0 || binary.BigEndian.Uint32(body[2:6]) == 0 {
		return errors.New("KAFKA_API_VERSIONS_FAILED")
	}
	return nil
}

func clickhouse(ctx context.Context, pool *x509.CertPool, identity tls.Certificate) error {
	if err := require("CLICKHOUSE_URL", "CLICKHOUSE_USER", "CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	target := strings.TrimRight(os.Getenv("CLICKHOUSE_URL"), "/")
	if !strings.HasPrefix(target, "https://") {
		return errors.New("CLICKHOUSE_HTTPS_REQUIRED")
	}
	transport := &http.Transport{TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, RootCAs: pool, Certificates: []tls.Certificate{identity}}}
	defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second, Transport: transport}
	query := func(sql string) (int, string, error) {
		request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, target+"/", strings.NewReader(sql))
		if err != nil {
			return 0, "", err
		}
		request.SetBasicAuth(os.Getenv("CLICKHOUSE_USER"), os.Getenv("CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD"))
		response, err := client.Do(request)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, "", err
		}
		defer response.Body.Close()
		body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 1024))
		return response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)), err
	}
	code, body, err := query("SELECT 1 FORMAT TabSeparated")
	if err != nil || code != http.StatusOK || body != "1" {
		return errors.New("CLICKHOUSE_QUERY_FAILED")
	}
	if os.Getenv("PROBE_CLICKHOUSE_TABLE") != "" {
		database, table := os.Getenv("PROBE_CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE"), os.Getenv("PROBE_CLICKHOUSE_TABLE")
		deniedDatabase, deniedTable := os.Getenv("PROBE_CLICKHOUSE_DENIED_DATABASE"), os.Getenv("PROBE_CLICKHOUSE_DENIED_TABLE")
		for _, value := range []string{database, table, deniedDatabase, deniedTable} {
			if value == "" || len(value) > 63 || strings.IndexFunc(value, func(char rune) bool {
				return !(char >= 'a' && char <= 'z' || char >= '0' && char <= '9' || char == '_' || char == '-')
			}) >= 0 {
				return errors.New("CLICKHOUSE_FIXTURE_INVALID")
			}
		}
		code, body, err = query("SELECT count() FROM `" + database + "`.`" + table + "` FORMAT TabSeparated")
		if _, numberErr := strconv.ParseUint(body, 10, 64); err != nil || numberErr != nil || code != http.StatusOK {
			return errors.New("CLICKHOUSE_FIXTURE_SELECT_FAILED")
		}
		code, body, err = query("SELECT count() FROM `" + deniedDatabase + "`.`" + deniedTable + "` FORMAT TabSeparated")
		if err != nil || code == http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(body, "Code: 497") {
			return errors.New("CLICKHOUSE_SCOPE_UNRESTRICTED")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func vaultAgent() error {
	// Agent env_template must populate this from an allowed Vault KV path.
	// The value is never included in the status response.
	if os.Getenv("PROBE_VAULT_MARKER") == "" {
		return errors.New("VAULT_TEMPLATE_MISSING")
	}
	return nil
}

func collect(ctx context.Context) status {
	report := status{Overall: "ok", Checks: map[string]check{}, CheckedAt: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)}
	pool, caPath, err := trustedPool(ctx)
	report.Checks["pkcs12"] = result(err)
	var identity tls.Certificate
	var certPath, keyPath string
	if err == nil {
		identity, certPath, keyPath, err = clientIdentity(ctx)
	}
	report.Checks["pkcs12Client"] = result(err)
	if err == nil {
		report.Checks["postgresql"] = result(postgres(ctx, caPath, certPath, keyPath))
		report.Checks["redis"] = result(redis(ctx, pool, identity, "REDIS"))
		report.Checks["sentinel"] = result(redis(ctx, pool, identity, "SENTINEL"))
		report.Checks["kafka"] = result(kafka(ctx, pool))
		report.Checks["clickhouse"] = result(clickhouse(ctx, pool, identity))
	} else {
		for _, name := range []string{"postgresql", "redis", "sentinel", "kafka", "clickhouse"} {
			report.Checks[name] = check{State: "blocked", Reason: "PKCS12_UNAVAILABLE"}
		}
	}
	report.Checks["vaultAgent"] = result(vaultAgent())
	for _, name := range []string{"pkcs12", "pkcs12Client", "postgresql", "redis", "sentinel", "kafka", "clickhouse", "vaultAgent"} {
		if report.Checks[name].State != "ok" {
			report.Overall = "failed"
		}
	}
	return report
}

func handler(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	if request.URL.Path != "/status" {
		http.NotFound(writer, request)
		return
	}
	if request.Method != http.MethodGet {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(request.Context(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	report := collect(ctx)
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	if report.Overall != "ok" {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
	}
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(report)
}

func main() {
	port := env("PROBE_PORT", "8080")
	if _, err := strconv.Atoi(port); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "INVALID_PORT")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	server := &http.Server{Addr: "0.0.0.0:" + port, Handler: http.HandlerFunc(handler),
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second}
	if err := server.ListenAndServe(); !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PROBE_SERVER_FAILED")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"examples/sdku/application-packages/data-manager/1.0.0/assets/ensure-project.sh","mode":420,"size":892,"sha256":"3c2455a32c569ac7cf97fe7adc6da6fa3a2ec344d6d0d85ded6ae52bda4ac8e5","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":892}
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
endpoint=${1%/}
project_name=$2
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
curl --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 30 \
  "$endpoint/v1/project" > "$work/projects.json"
if jq -e --arg name "$project_name" 'any(.[]; .name == $name)' "$work/projects.json" >/dev/null; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"status":"ok","changed":false}'
  exit 0
fi
project_id=$(jq '([.[].id] | max // 0) + 1' "$work/projects.json")
jq -n --argjson id "$project_id" --arg name "$project_name" '{id:$id,name:$name}' > "$work/project.json"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 30 \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary "@$work/project.json" \
  "$endpoint/v1/project" > "$work/created.json"
jq -e --arg name "$project_name" '.name == $name' "$work/created.json" >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' '{"status":"ok","changed":true}'

@@END

@@PORTABLE {"path":"examples/szi/application-packages/keycloak/1.0.0/assets/scripts/bootstrap-admin.sh","mode":420,"size":5261,"sha256":"0f78edd29429e30e362ad22a5eaef307f0276637d240f57b9bd5d08482a297e7","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":5261}
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077

fail() { printf '%s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
compose() {
  docker compose --project-name "$compose_project" \
    --project-directory "$instance_path" \
    --env-file "$library_path/.env" \
    -f "$instance_path/compose.yml" "$@"
}
label() { docker container inspect --format "{{ index .Config.Labels \"$1\" }}" "$2"; }
owned() {
  [ "$(label platform.installer.project "$1")" = "$project_id" ] &&
  [ "$(label platform.installer.library "$1")" = "$library_id" ] &&
  [ "$(label platform.installer.instance "$1")" = "$instance_id" ] &&
  [ "$(label platform.installer.host "$1")" = "$host_id" ]
}

[ "$#" -eq 12 ] && [ "$1" = '--realm' ] && [ "$2" = 'master' ] &&
  [ "$3" = '--db-user' ] && [ "$5" = '--project' ] &&
  [ "$7" = '--library' ] && [ "$9" = '--instance' ] &&
  [ "${11}" = '--host' ] || fail APPLICATION_KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_ARGUMENT_INVALID
db_user=$4
project_id=$6
library_id=$8
instance_id=${10}
host_id=${12}
case "$db_user" in *[!a-zA-Z0-9_]*|'') fail APPLICATION_KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_ARGUMENT_INVALID;; esac
for value in "$project_id" "$library_id" "$instance_id" "$host_id"; do
  case "$value" in *[!a-zA-Z0-9_-]*|'') fail APPLICATION_KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_ARGUMENT_INVALID;; esac
done
instance_path=$(pwd -P)
library_path=$(dirname "$instance_path")
compose_project="$project_id-$library_id-$instance_id-$host_id"
container_name="$instance_id-$host_id"
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"
export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/docker.sock"
: "${PLATFORM_SCRIPT_SECRET_BOOTSTRAP_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE:?}"
: "${PLATFORM_SCRIPT_SECRET_DB_PASSWORD_FILE:?}"

if docker container inspect "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  owned "$container_name" || fail APPLICATION_KEYCLOAK_CONTAINER_OWNERSHIP_INVALID
  printf '{"status":"ok","changed":false}\n'
  exit 0
fi

temporary_name="${instance_id}-platform-bootstrap"
if docker container inspect "$temporary_name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  owned "$temporary_name" || fail APPLICATION_KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_CONTAINER_CONFLICT
  [ "$(docker container inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' "$temporary_name")" = false ] ||
    fail APPLICATION_KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_CONTAINER_CONFLICT
  docker container rm "$temporary_name" >/dev/null || fail APPLICATION_KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_CLEANUP_FAILED
fi

wrapper="$instance_path/.scripts/keycloak-bootstrap-wrapper.sh"
trace_wrapper="$instance_path/.scripts/keycloak-bootstrap-trace.sh"
work="$instance_path/.scripts/.bootstrap-work"
diagnostic_directory="$instance_path/.scripts/diagnostics"
mkdir -p "$diagnostic_directory"
diagnostic_log="$diagnostic_directory/bootstrap-admin-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$.log"
mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -f "$wrapper" "$trace_wrapper"; rm -rf "$work"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cat > "$trace_wrapper" <<'TRACE'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
fifo=/run/platform-admin-work/trace-pipe
mkfifo "$fifo"
# Raw xtrace exists only in this pipe. Never persist it before redaction.
jq -Rrs --rawfile admin /run/platform-db-password \
  --rawfile bootstrap /run/platform-bootstrap-secret '
  def variants: ., @sh, (@json | .[1:-1]), @uri;
  ([ $admin, $bootstrap ] | map(., split("\n")[]) | map(select(length > 0) | variants)
    | unique | sort_by(length) | reverse) as $secrets
  | reduce $secrets[] as $secret (. ; split($secret) | join("[REDACTED]"))
  | gsub("eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+"; "[REDACTED_JWT]")
' < "$fifo" >&2 &
redactor=$!
set +e
PS4='+ keycloak-bootstrap trace: ' /bin/sh -x /run/platform-bootstrap-wrapper "$@" > "$fifo" 2>&1
result=$?
wait "$redactor"
redaction_result=$?
set -e
rm -f "$fifo"
[ "$redaction_result" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
exit "$result"
TRACE
cat > "$wrapper" <<'WRAPPER'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export KC_DB_USERNAME="$1"
export KC_DB_PASSWORD="$(cat /run/platform-db-password)"
export PLATFORM_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET="$(cat /run/platform-bootstrap-secret)"
# This offline CLI has no published ports and does not run the Vault Agent.
# Keep its management interface on HTTP; production TLS is configured by Agent.
unset KC_HTTPS_KEY_STORE_FILE KC_HTTPS_KEY_STORE_TYPE
unset KC_HTTPS_CERTIFICATE_FILE KC_HTTPS_CERTIFICATE_KEY_FILE
export KC_HTTP_ENABLED=true
export KC_HTTP_MANAGEMENT_SCHEME=http
exec /usr/lib/keycloak/bin/kc.sh bootstrap-admin service --client-id temp-admin \
  --client-secret:env=PLATFORM_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET --no-prompt
WRAPPER
chmod 0600 "$wrapper"

printf 'bootstrap-admin start=%s host=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$host_id" > "$diagnostic_log"
compose_result=0
compose run --rm --no-deps --pull never -T --name "$temporary_name" \
  --user 0:0 --entrypoint /bin/sh \
  -v "$wrapper:/run/platform-bootstrap-wrapper:ro" \
  -v "$trace_wrapper:/run/platform-trace-wrapper:ro" \
  -v "$work:/run/platform-admin-work" \

@@PORTABLE {"path":"examples/szi/application-packages/keycloak/1.0.0/assets/scripts/integration.sh","mode":420,"size":20764,"sha256":"ad7bd204236d1e206de296767959c21b4425d7abdca33f85943e360cc37fd0e7","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":20764}
#!/bin/sh
# Provider-owned REST client. Core supplies argv and private input files only.
set -eu
umask 077
exec 3>&1
identity_step=0
http_status=0
curl_exit=0
fail() { exit 1; }
finish() {
  result=$?
  set +x
  if [ -n "${work:-}" ] && [ -f "$work/http-status" ]; then
    read -r http_status curl_exit < "$work/http-status"
  fi
  if [ -n "${trace_pid:-}" ]; then
    exec 2>&4
    wait "$trace_pid" || result=1
    cat "$diagnostic_log" >&4
    printf 'integration finish=%s rc=%s step=%s http_status=%s curl_exit=%s log=%s\n' \
      "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$result" "$identity_step" "$http_status" "$curl_exit" "$diagnostic_log" >&4
  fi
  if [ "$result" -ne 0 ]; then
    printf '{"status":"error","step":%s,"http_status":%s,"curl_exit":%s}\n' "$identity_step" "$http_status" "$curl_exit" >&3
  fi
  [ -z "${work:-}" ] || rm -rf "$work"
  exit "$result"
}
trap finish EXIT
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM
[ "$#" -eq 8 ] || fail
operation=$1; url=${2%/}; realm=$3; admin_user=$4

  --rawfile batch "$trace_accounts" '
  def variants: ., @sh, (@json | .[1:-1]), @uri;
  ([$admin, $client, ($batch | fromjson? | .passwords? // {} | .. | strings)]
    | map(., split("\n")[]) | map(select(length > 0) | variants)
    | unique | sort_by(length) | reverse) as $secrets
  | reduce $secrets[] as $secret (. ; split($secret) | join("[REDACTED]"))
  | gsub("eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+"; "[REDACTED_JWT]")

# curl uses the installed system CA trust; an explicit CA may be supplied by the caller.
transport() {
  curl_exit=0
  http_status=$(curl --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 "$@") || curl_exit=$?
  case "$http_status" in [0-9][0-9][0-9]) http_status=$((1$http_status-1000));; *) http_status=0;; esac
  printf '%s %s\n' "$http_status" "$curl_exit" > "$work/http-status"
  [ "$curl_exit" -eq 0 ] || fail
}
token() {
  token_realm=$1; token_user=$2; token_password=$3
  token_realm_path=$(printf '%s' "$token_realm" | jq -sRr @uri)
  jq -njr --arg user "$token_user" --rawfile password "$token_password" \
    '"client_id=admin-cli&grant_type=password&username="+($user|@uri)+"&password="+($password|@uri)' > "$work/form"
  transport --output "$work/token.json" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' --data-binary @"$work/form" \
    "$url/realms/$token_realm_path/protocol/openid-connect/token"
  [ "$http_status" -eq 200 ] && jq -e '.access_token | type == "string" and length > 0' "$work/token.json" >/dev/null
}
admin_token() {
  token master "$admin_user" "$admin_password" || fail
  jq -er '.access_token | "header = " + ("Authorization: Bearer " + . | @json)' "$work/token.json" > "$work/admin-curl.conf" || fail
}
identity_step=1
admin_token
realm_path=$(printf '%s' "$realm" | jq -sRr @uri)
kc() {
  method=$1; resource=$2; shift 2
  case "$method" in get) method=GET;; create) method=POST;; update) method=PUT;; delete) method=DELETE;; *) fail;; esac
  query=''; body=''
  while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      -r) shift 2;;
      -q) key=${2%%=*}; value=${2#*=}; encoded=$(printf '%s' "$value" | jq -sRr @uri); query="$query&$key=$encoded"; shift 2;;
      -f) body=$2; shift 2;;
      -n) shift;;
      *) fail;;
    esac
  done
  set -- --config "$work/admin-curl.conf" --request "$method" --output "$work/response" --write-out '%{http_code}'
  if [ -n "$body" ]; then set -- "$@" --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary "@$body"; fi
  auth_retry=0
  while :; do
    transport "$@" "$url/admin/realms/$realm_path/$resource?${query#&}"
    [ "$http_status" -eq 401 ] && [ "$auth_retry" -eq 0 ] || break
    admin_token
    auth_retry=1
  done
  case "$http_status" in 2??) ;; *) fail;; esac
  cat "$work/response"
}
printf '%s' "$payload" > "$work/payload.json"
get_exact() {
  resource=$1; field=$2; name=$3
  if [ "$resource" = groups ]; then
    kc get groups -r "$realm" -q search="$name" -q exact=true > "$work/matches.json" || fail
  else
    kc get "$resource" -r "$realm" -q "$field=$name" -q exact=true > "$work/matches.json" || fail
  fi
  jq --arg field "$field" --arg value "$name" '[.[] | select(.[$field] == $value)]' "$work/matches.json" > "$work/exact.json" || fail
  jq -r '.[0].id // empty' "$work/exact.json"
}
group() {
  identity_step=10
  name=$1
  id=$(get_exact groups name "$name")
  if [ -n "$id" ]; then
    identity_step=11
    kc get "groups/$id" -r "$realm" > "$work/group.json" || fail
  else
    identity_step=12
    jq -n --arg name "$name" '{name:$name}' > "$work/group.json"
    kc create groups -r "$realm" -f "$work/group.json" >/dev/null || fail
    changed=true
    id=$(get_exact groups name "$name")
    [ -n "$id" ] || fail
    kc get "groups/$id" -r "$realm" > "$work/group.json" || fail
  fi
}

principal_roles() {
  identity_step=13
  principal_resource=$1
  principal_id=$id
  jq -e 'def name: type == "string" and length > 0 and (test("[\u0000-\u001f]") | not);
    type == "object" and (.realm_roles | type == "array" and all(.[]; name)) and
    (.client_roles | type == "object" and all(to_entries[]; (.key | name) and (.value | type == "array" and all(.[]; name))))' \
    "$work/role-file.json" >/dev/null || fail
  jq -r '.client_roles | to_entries[] | select(.value | length > 0) | .key' "$work/role-file.json" > "$work/role-clients"
  reconcile_roles roles "$principal_resource/$principal_id/role-mappings/realm" realm
  while IFS= read -r client_id; do
    client_uuid=$(get_exact clients clientId "$client_id")
    [ -n "$client_uuid" ] || fail
    kc get "clients/$client_uuid" -r "$realm" > "$work/role-client.json" || fail
    reconcile_roles "clients/$client_uuid/roles" "$principal_resource/$principal_id/role-mappings/clients/$client_uuid" client
  done < "$work/role-clients"
}

reconcile_roles() {
  identity_step=14
  role_resource=$1; mapping_resource=$2; role_kind=$3
  if [ "$role_kind" = realm ]; then
    jq '.realm_roles | unique' "$work/role-file.json" > "$work/required-roles.json"
  else
    jq --arg client "$client_id" '.client_roles[$client] | unique' "$work/role-file.json" > "$work/required-roles.json"
  fi
  [ "$(jq length "$work/required-roles.json")" -gt 0 ] || return 0
  kc get "$role_resource" -r "$realm" > "$work/available-roles.json" || fail
  jq -r --slurpfile available "$work/available-roles.json" '. - [$available[0][].name] | .[]' \
    "$work/required-roles.json" > "$work/missing-role-names" || fail
  if [ -s "$work/missing-role-names" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r role_name; do
      jq -n --arg name "$role_name" \
        '{name:$name}' > "$work/new-role.json"
      kc create "$role_resource" -r "$realm" -f "$work/new-role.json" >/dev/null || fail
      changed=true
    done < "$work/missing-role-names"
    kc get "$role_resource" -r "$realm" > "$work/available-roles.json" || fail
  fi
  jq --slurpfile names "$work/required-roles.json" \
    '[.[] | select(.name as $name | $names[0] | index($name))]' \
    "$work/available-roles.json" > "$work/selected-roles.json" || fail
  [ "$(jq length "$work/selected-roles.json")" = "$(jq length "$work/required-roles.json")" ] || fail
  kc get "$mapping_resource" -r "$realm" > "$work/role-mappings.json" || fail
  jq --slurpfile current "$work/role-mappings.json" \
    '[.[] | select(.id as $id | [$current[0][].id] | index($id) | not)]' \
    "$work/selected-roles.json" > "$work/missing-mappings.json" || fail
  if [ "$(jq length "$work/missing-mappings.json")" -gt 0 ]; then
    kc create "$mapping_resource" -r "$realm" -f "$work/missing-mappings.json" >/dev/null || fail
    changed=true
    kc get "$mapping_resource" -r "$realm" > "$work/role-mappings.json" || fail
  fi
  jq -e --slurpfile required "$work/selected-roles.json" \
    '([ $required[0][].id ] - [ .[].id ]) | length == 0' "$work/role-mappings.json" >/dev/null || fail
}

case "$operation" in
  groups|group-roles)
    jq 'if type == "array" then {groups: .} else . end' "$work/payload.json" > "$work/groups-payload.json" || fail
    jq -e '.groups | type == "array" and all(.[]; (if type == "object" then .name else . end) |
      type == "string" and length > 0 and (test("[\r\n]") | not))' "$work/groups-payload.json" >/dev/null || fail
    jq -c '.groups[] | if type == "string" then {name:.,roles_file:{realm_roles:[],client_roles:{}}} else . end' \
      "$work/groups-payload.json" > "$work/groups"
    while IFS= read -r group_json; do
      printf '%s' "$group_json" > "$work/group-input.json"
      name=$(jq -r '.name' "$work/group-input.json")
      group "$name"
      if [ "$operation" = group-roles ]; then
        jq '.roles_file' "$work/group-input.json" > "$work/role-file.json"
        principal_roles groups
      fi
    done < "$work/groups"
    ;;
  client)
    identity_step=20
    case "$endpoint" in https://*|http://*) ;; *) fail;; esac
    case "$proxy" in https://*) ;; *) fail;; esac
    jq --arg id "$instance" --arg endpoint "$endpoint" --arg proxy "$proxy" '
      {protocol:"openid-connect",enabled:true,standardFlowEnabled:true,
       directAccessGrantsEnabled:false,publicClient:true,serviceAccountsEnabled:false,
       rootUrl:($proxy+"/"+$id+"/"),baseUrl:($proxy+"/"+$id+"/"),webOrigins:[$proxy]} + . |
      .clientId=$id | .name=$id | .description=$endpoint |
      .redirectUris=(.redirectUris // [($proxy+"/"+$id+"/*")]) | del(.id,.secret)' "$work/payload.json" > "$work/client-model.json"
    jq 'del(.clientRoles,.authorizationSettings)' "$work/client-model.json" > "$work/client.json"
    model_matches='def matches($a;$d):
      if ($d|type)=="object" then ($a|type)=="object" and
        all($d|to_entries[]|select(.key!="id" and .key!="_id"); matches($a[.key];.value))
      elif ($d|type)=="array" then ($a|type)=="array" and ($a|length)==($d|length) and
        all($d[]; . as $v | any($a[]; matches(.;$v)))
      elif ($d|type)=="string" and ($a|type)=="string" and ($d|test("^[\\[{]")) then
        try matches(($a|fromjson);($d|fromjson)) catch ($a==$d)
      else $a==$d end;
      matches(.;$desired[0])'
    if [ "$(jq -r '.publicClient' "$work/client.json")" = false ] && [ -s "$client_secret" ]; then
      jq --rawfile secret "$client_secret" '.secret=$secret' "$work/client.json" > "$work/next.json"
      mv "$work/next.json" "$work/client.json"
    fi
    new_authorization=false
    id=$(get_exact clients clientId "$instance")
    if [ -z "$id" ]; then
      new_authorization=$(jq -r '.authorizationServicesEnabled // false' "$work/client.json")
      kc create clients -r "$realm" -f "$work/client.json" >/dev/null || fail
      changed=true
    else
      kc get "clients/$id" -r "$realm" > "$work/current.json" || fail
      if [ "$(jq -r '.authorizationServicesEnabled // false' "$work/client.json")" = true ] &&
        [ "$(jq -r '.authorizationServicesEnabled // false' "$work/current.json")" = false ]; then
        new_authorization=true
      fi
      jq --slurpfile current "$work/current.json" '.attributes=($current[0].attributes + .attributes)' "$work/client.json" > "$work/next.json"
      mv "$work/next.json" "$work/client.json"
      # The secret endpoint is private and never a script output.
      if [ "$(jq -r '.publicClient' "$work/client.json")" = false ] && [ -s "$client_secret" ]; then
        kc get "clients/$id/client-secret" -r "$realm" > "$work/secret.json" || fail
        jq --slurpfile secret "$work/secret.json" '.secret=$secret[0].value' "$work/current.json" > "$work/next.json"
        mv "$work/next.json" "$work/current.json"
      fi
      if ! jq -e --slurpfile desired "$work/client.json" "$model_matches" "$work/current.json" >/dev/null; then
        kc update "clients/$id" -r "$realm" -f "$work/client.json" >/dev/null || fail
        changed=true
      fi
    fi
    id=$(get_exact clients clientId "$instance")
    [ -n "$id" ] || fail
    identity_step=22
    for scope_kind in default optional; do
      case "$scope_kind" in default) scope_field=defaultClientScopes;; optional) scope_field=optionalClientScopes;; esac
      if jq -e --arg field "$scope_field" 'has($field)' "$work/client-model.json" >/dev/null; then
        jq --arg field "$scope_field" '.[$field]' "$work/client-model.json" > "$work/desired-scopes.json"
        kc get "clients/$id/$scope_kind-client-scopes" -r "$realm" > "$work/current-scopes.json" || fail
        jq -r --slurpfile desired "$work/desired-scopes.json" '.[]|select(.name as $name|$desired[0]|index($name)|not)|.id' \
          "$work/current-scopes.json" > "$work/remove-scopes"
        while IFS= read -r scope_id; do
          kc delete "clients/$id/$scope_kind-client-scopes/$scope_id" -r "$realm" >/dev/null || fail
          changed=true
        done < "$work/remove-scopes"
        kc get client-scopes -r "$realm" > "$work/realm-scopes.json" || fail
        jq -r --slurpfile current "$work/current-scopes.json" '.[]|select(. as $name|[$current[0][].name]|index($name)|not)' \
          "$work/desired-scopes.json" > "$work/add-scopes"
        while IFS= read -r scope_name; do
          scope_id=$(jq -r --arg name "$scope_name" '.[]|select(.name==$name)|.id' "$work/realm-scopes.json")
          [ -n "$scope_id" ] || fail
          kc update "clients/$id/$scope_kind-client-scopes/$scope_id" -r "$realm" >/dev/null || fail
          changed=true
        done < "$work/add-scopes"
      fi
    done
    # Client roles must exist before authorization policies resolve their named references.
    jq -c '.clientRoles[]?' "$work/client-model.json" > "$work/client-roles"
    while IFS= read -r role; do
      printf '%s' "$role" > "$work/client-role.json"
      role_name=$(jq -r .name "$work/client-role.json")
      kc get "clients/$id/roles" -r "$realm" -q briefRepresentation=false > "$work/current-roles.json" || fail
      jq --arg name "$role_name" '.[] | select(.name==$name)' "$work/current-roles.json" > "$work/current-role.json"
      if [ ! -s "$work/current-role.json" ]; then
        kc create "clients/$id/roles" -r "$realm" -f "$work/client-role.json" >/dev/null || fail
        changed=true
      elif ! jq -e --slurpfile desired "$work/client-role.json" "$model_matches" "$work/current-role.json" >/dev/null; then
        role_path=$(printf '%s' "$role_name" | jq -sRr @uri)
        kc update "clients/$id/roles/$role_path" -r "$realm" -f "$work/client-role.json" >/dev/null || fail
        changed=true
      fi
    done < "$work/client-roles"
    if jq -e '.authorizationSettings != null' "$work/client-model.json" >/dev/null; then
      identity_step=21
      jq '.authorizationSettings' "$work/client-model.json" > "$work/authorization.json"
      # Only the defaults generated by this transition are removed; existing authored settings remain.
      if [ "$new_authorization" = true ]; then
        for kind in policy resource; do
          kc get "clients/$id/authz/resource-server/$kind" -r "$realm" > "$work/generated-defaults.json" || fail
          jq -r '.[]|select(.name=="Default Permission" or .name=="Default Policy" or .name=="Default Resource")|.id // ._id' \
            "$work/generated-defaults.json" > "$work/generated-default-ids"
          while IFS= read -r default_id; do
            kc delete "clients/$id/authz/resource-server/$kind/$default_id" -r "$realm" >/dev/null || fail
          done < "$work/generated-default-ids"
        done
      fi
      kc get "clients/$id/authz/resource-server/settings" -r "$realm" > "$work/current-authorization.json" || fail
      if ! jq -e --slurpfile desired "$work/authorization.json" "$model_matches" "$work/current-authorization.json" >/dev/null; then
        kc create "clients/$id/authz/resource-server/import" -r "$realm" -f "$work/authorization.json" >/dev/null || fail
        changed=true
      fi
      kc get "clients/$id/authz/resource-server/settings" -r "$realm" > "$work/current-authorization.json" || fail
      jq -e --slurpfile desired "$work/authorization.json" "$model_matches" "$work/current-authorization.json" >/dev/null || fail
    fi
    kc get "clients/$id" -r "$realm" > "$work/current.json" || fail
    # Secrets are checked independently of the normal client representation.
    jq 'del(.secret)' "$work/client.json" > "$work/check.json"
    jq -e --slurpfile desired "$work/check.json" "$model_matches" "$work/current.json" >/dev/null || fail
    if [ "$(jq -r '.publicClient' "$work/client.json")" = false ]; then
      kc get "clients/$id/client-secret" -r "$realm" > "$work/secret.json" || fail
      if ! jq -e '.value | type=="string" and length>0' "$work/secret.json" >/dev/null; then
        kc create "clients/$id/client-secret" -r "$realm" > "$work/secret.json" || fail
        changed=true
      fi
      if [ -s "$client_secret" ]; then
        jq -e --rawfile expected "$client_secret" '.value == $expected' "$work/secret.json" >/dev/null || fail
      fi
    fi
    ;;
  accounts)
    [ -s "$accounts" ] || fail
    jq -e '.accounts | type == "array"' "$accounts" >/dev/null || fail
    identity_step=30
    count=$(jq '.accounts | length' "$accounts")
    index=0
    while [ "$index" -lt "$count" ]; do
      jq --argjson index "$index" '.accounts[$index] as $a | $a + {password:.passwords[$a.id]}' "$accounts" > "$work/account.json"
      username=$(jq -r '.username' "$work/account.json")
      mode=$(jq -r '.mode' "$work/account.json")
      new_account=false
      id=$(get_exact users username "$username")
      if [ -n "$id" ]; then
        kc get "users/$id" -r "$realm" > "$work/user.json" || fail
      else
        [ "$mode" = managed ] || fail
        new_account=true
        jq '{username:.username,enabled:true}' "$work/account.json" > "$work/user.json"
        kc create users -r "$realm" -f "$work/user.json" >/dev/null || fail
        changed=true
        id=$(get_exact users username "$username")
        [ -n "$id" ] || fail
        kc get "users/$id" -r "$realm" > "$work/user.json" || fail
      fi
      # Set the initial password before the first login; probe existing accounts for idempotency.
      jq -jr .password "$work/account.json" > "$work/user-password"
      if [ "$new_account" = true ] || ! token "$realm" "$username" "$work/user-password"; then
        [ "$mode" = managed ] || fail
        jq '{type:"password",value:.password,temporary:false}' "$work/account.json" > "$work/credential.json"
        kc update "users/$id/reset-password" -r "$realm" -f "$work/credential.json" >/dev/null || fail
        changed=true
      fi
      token "$realm" "$username" "$work/user-password" || fail
      if [ "$mode" = managed ]; then
        jq -r '.parameters.groups[]? ' "$work/account.json" > "$work/groups"
        while IFS= read -r name; do
          group_id=$(get_exact groups name "$name"); [ -n "$group_id" ] || fail
          kc get "users/$id/groups" -r "$realm" > "$work/memberships.json" || fail
          if ! jq -e --arg id "$group_id" 'any(.[]; .id == $id)' "$work/memberships.json" >/dev/null; then
            kc update "users/$id/groups/$group_id" -r "$realm" -n >/dev/null || fail
            changed=true
          fi
          kc get "users/$id/groups" -r "$realm" > "$work/memberships.json" || fail
          jq -e --arg id "$group_id" 'any(.[]; .id == $id)' "$work/memberships.json" >/dev/null || fail
        done < "$work/groups"
        jq '.parameters as $p | ($p.roles_file // {realm_roles:[],client_roles:{}}) |
          .realm_roles = ((.realm_roles // []) + ($p.roles // []) | unique)' \
          "$work/account.json" > "$work/role-file.json" || fail
        principal_roles users
      fi
      index=$((index+1))
    done
    ;;
  *) fail;;
esac
printf '{"status":"ok","changed":%s}\n' "$changed"

@@END

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
fail() { printf '%s\n' APPLICATION_ROUTES_APPLY_FAILED >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$#" -eq 4 ] || [ "$#" -eq 5 ] || fail
project=$1; library=$2; instance=$3
path=$(pwd -P)
diagnostic_directory="$path/.scripts/diagnostics"
mkdir -p "$diagnostic_directory"
diagnostic_log="$diagnostic_directory/prepare-routes-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$.log"
step=0
finish() {
  result=$?
  set +x
  [ -z "${stage:-}" ] || rm -rf "$stage"
  exec 2>&3
  cat "$diagnostic_log" >&3
  printf 'prepare-routes finish=%s rc=%s step=%s log=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$result" "$step" "$diagnostic_log" >&3
  if [ "$result" -ne 0 ]; then printf '{"status":"error","step":%s}\n' "$step"; fi
  exit "$result"
}
exec 3>&2
trap finish EXIT
exec 2>> "$diagnostic_log"
PS4='+ prepare-routes trace: '
set -x
mkdir -p "$path/routes"
chmod 0755 "$path/routes"
stage=$(mktemp -d "$path/.scripts/routes-input-XXXXXX")
step=10
if [ "$#" -eq 5 ]; then
  printf '%s' "$5" > "$stage/consumers.json"
  jq --arg owner "platform.application.routes/v1:$project:$library:$instance" '
    {owner: $owner, routes: (reduce .[] as $consumer ({};
      ($consumer.placements | to_entries | sort_by(.key) |
        map(.value | select(.endpointUrl != null)) | first) as $placement |
      if $placement == null then . else
        .[$consumer.applicationId] = {endpoint: $placement.endpointUrl,
          subpath: ("/" + $consumer.applicationId),
          parameters: ($placement.parameters.IDENTITY_ROUTE // {})}
      end))}
  ' "$stage/consumers.json" > "$stage/requested.json"
else
  cp "$path/config/routes.requested.json" "$stage/requested.json"
fi
step=20
if [ -f "$path/routes/routes.effective.json" ]; then
  cp "$path/routes/routes.effective.json" "$stage/previous.json"
else
  printf 'null\n' > "$stage/previous.json"
fi
jq --slurpfile requested "$stage/requested.json" '
  . as $previous | $requested[0] as $requested |
  ($previous // {owner: $requested.owner, routes: {}}) as $existing |
  if ($requested.owner | type) != "string" or ($requested.routes | type) != "object" then
    error("APPLICATION_ROUTES_INPUT_INVALID")
  elif $existing.owner != $requested.owner or ($existing.routes | type) != "object" then
    error("APPLICATION_ROUTES_OWNER_INVALID")
  elif (all($requested.routes | to_entries[];
    (.key | test("^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*$")) and (.value | type) == "object" and
    .value.subpath == ("/" + .key) and (.value.endpoint | type) == "string" and
    (.value.endpoint | test("^https?://[^/\\s]+$"))) | not) then
    error("APPLICATION_ROUTES_INPUT_INVALID")
  else
    ($existing + {routes: ($existing.routes + $requested.routes)}) as $effective |
    {effective: $effective, changed: ($previous != $effective)}
  end
' "$stage/previous.json" > "$stage/merged.json"
step=30
if jq -e .changed "$stage/merged.json" >/dev/null; then
  jq .effective "$stage/merged.json" > "$stage/routes.effective.json"
  chmod 0644 "$stage/routes.effective.json"
  mv "$stage/routes.effective.json" "$path/routes/routes.effective.json"
fi
jq '{status: "ok", changed: .changed}' "$stage/merged.json" > "$stage/result.json"
chmod 0644 "$stage/result.json"
mv "$stage/result.json" "$path/routes/result.json"
cat "$path/routes/result.json"
printf '\n'

@@END

    local function get_attr_from_jwt(token, attr)
        -- извлекаем payload

    -- Функция подмены спец символов для защиты от инъекций
    local function escape_html(s)
        if not s then return "" end
        s = tostring(s)
        s = s:gsub("&", "&amp;")
             :gsub("<", "&lt;")
             :gsub(">", "&gt;")
             :gsub('"', "&quot;")
             :gsub("'", "&#39;")
        return s
    end

    -- Функция экранирования для JS-строки
    local function js_string_escape(s)
        if not s then return "" end
            s = s:gsub("\\", "\\\\")
            s = s:gsub("'", "\'")
            s = s:gsub('"', '\"')
            s = s:gsub("\n", "\n")
            s = s:gsub("\r", "\r")
            s = s:gsub("\t", "\t")
        return s
    end

        for line in io.lines(fileEnvPath) do

            for key, value in string.gmatch(line, '([^=]+)="(.-)"') do

            end
        end

    -- tab - таблица параметров и их значений. Например {param1 = "DERP", param2 = "DUMB"}
    local function interp(s, tab)
        return (s:gsub('($%b{})', function(w) return tab[w:sub(3, -2)] or w end))

    local function invalidate_session_from_grant_access(frontend_url, message_to_user, clear_cookies)

    -- Функция сравнения адресов
    local function endsWith(str, suffix)
        return str:sub(-(#suffix)) == suffix
    end

    --Функция для конвертации ссылки в /logout-ссылку. Не добавляет /logout, если в ссылке уже есть /logout
    local function urlToLogoutUrl(url)
        if endsWith(url, '/logout') then
            return url
        end
        if endsWith(url, "/") then
            return url .. 'logout'
        else
            return url .. '/logout'
        end
    end

    -- Функция для работы со статическими файлами
    local function isStaticResource(url)
        local fragments = {}
        for fragment in string.gmatch(url, "/([^/]+)") do
            table.insert(fragments, fragment)
        end
        if (#fragments >= 2) then
            return fragments[2] == "static"
        else
            return false
        end
    end

    -- Функция проверки строки на то, что она пустая
    local function isEmptyString(str)
        return str == nil or str == ""
    end

    --Функция, возвращающая первый параметр, если он не пустой, или значение по умолчанию (второй параметр)
    local function ifStringPresentOrElse(value, default)
        if isNotEmptyString(value) then
            return value
        end
        return default
    end

    -- Функция проверки необходимых заголовков
    --suppress_error = true, если нужно игнорировать ошибку, не выводить errorWindow и не прерывать работу скрпита
    local function urlencode(str, update_url, suppress_errorWindow, err_msg)
        if str ~= nil and str ~= "" then
            str =
            string.gsub(
                    str,
                    "([^0-9a-zA-Z !'()*._~-])",
                    function(c)
                        return string.format("%%%02X", string.byte(c))
                    end
            )
            str = string.gsub(str, " ", "%%20")
            return str
        elseif suppress_errorWindow ~= true then
            ngx.update_time()
            ngx.log(ngx.ERR, "Передана пустая строка для приведения к URL-escape формату")
            err_msg = ifStringPresentOrElse(err_msg, "Передана пустая строка для приведения к URL-escape формату.")
            errorWindow(nil, err_msg, true, update_url, false, ngx.HTTP_BAD_REQUEST)
        end
        return ""
    end

    -- Функция перенаправления на смену пароля, если она запрошена в URI. ТОЛЬКО для запросов на /change_password
    local function redirectToPasswordChangeIfRequested(ngx_request_uri, ngx_server_name, keycloak_host, realm, service, opts_client_id)
        if isEmptyString(ngx_request_uri) or isEmptyString(ngx_server_name) or isEmptyString(keycloak_host)
                or isEmptyString(realm) or isEmptyString(service) or isEmptyString(opts_client_id) then
            return
        end
        if string.match(ngx_request_uri, "/change_password") then
            --//TODO требуется доработка в случае хранения пользователей локально в БД Keycloak без подклбченной федерации
            ngx.redirect(keycloak_host .. "/realms/" .. realm .. "/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=" .. service ..
                    "&response_mode=fragment&response_type=code&prompt=login&scope=openid&kc_action=UPDATE_PASSWORD&redirect_uri=https://" ..
                    ngx_server_name .. "/" .. opts_client_id .. "/")
        end
    end

    -- Убираем мусор
    collectgarbage()
    -- Инициализируем переменные
    local env = getEnv('/etc/nginx/data.env')
    local ga_host = env['GA_HOST']
    local gaa_host = env['GAA_HOST']
    local gaf_host = env['GAF_HOST']
    local heartbeat_enabled = env["HEARTBEAT_ENABLED"]
    local keycloak_host = env['KEYCLOAK_HOST']
    local performance_logs = env['PERFORMANCE_LOGS']
    local realm = env['REALM']
    local http_request = http.new()
    local access = false
    local is_public_client = false
    -- Резервирование
    local ga_host_canary = env['GA_HOST_CANARY']
    local gaf_host_canary = env['GAF_HOST_CANARY']
    -- Разграничение доступов по IP
    local client_limited_access = env['CLIENT_LIMITED_ACCESS']
    local ip_limited_access = env['IP_LIMITED_ACCESS']
    local endpoints_limited_access = env['ENDPOINTS_LIMITED_ACCESS']
    -- Заголовки
    -- Время жизни сессии по бездействию по умолчанию (далее по тексту значение подстовляется из настроек Keycloak)
    ngx.var.x_timeout_session = "600"
    ngx.var.previous_auth = ""
    ngx.var.password_exp = ""
    ngx.var.cp_uri = ""
    ngx.var.nginx_url = "https://" .. ngx.var.server_name
    ngx.var.user_groups = ""
    ngx.var.new_request = ""
    ngx.var.new_url = ""
    ngx.var.allow_patterns = ""
    ngx.var.forbidden_patterns = ""
    ngx.var.user_login = ""
    ngx.var.user_ip = ""
    ngx.var.security_signature = ""
    ngx.var.system_is_recovery = false
    ngx.var.visibility_zone = ""
    ngx.var.canary = ""
    local url_logout = ""
    local update_url = ""
    local ssl_status = true
    local headers = ngx.req.get_headers()
    local client_for_opts_information_json = ""
    local client_for_backend_information_json = ""
    local lua_clients_info_json = ""
    local lead_time = 0
    local redirect_url_custom = ""
    local ws_proto = ngx.var.arg_token
    ngx.var.user_ip = headers["X-REAL-IP"] or headers["X-FORWARDED-FOR"] or ngx.var.remote_addr or "0.0.0.0"
    --Аудит
    local execution_log = {}
    local user_login = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["x-user-login"], "unknown")

    local function checking_network_availability(url)
        local res, err =
            http_request:request_uri(
            url,
            {
                method = "GET",
                headers = {
                    ["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
                },
                ssl_verify = ssl_status
            }
        )

        if not res then
            ngx.log(ngx.ERR, "Ошибка запроса сетевой доступности: " .. url)
            return "DOWN"
        end

        if res.status == 200 then
            return "UP"
        else
            return "DOWN"
        end
    end

    if (endsWith(keycloak_host, "/")) then
        keycloak_host = keycloak_host:sub(1, -2)
    end

    if (ngx.var.request_uri == "/health") then
        local health = {
            status_nginx = "UP",
            network_availability_keycloak = checking_network_availability(keycloak_host .. "/realms/master/.well-known/openid-configuration"),
            network_availability_grant_access = checking_network_availability(ga_host .. "/v1/")
        }
        ngx.status = 200
        ngx.header.content_type = "application/json"
        ngx.say(cjson.encode(health))
        ngx.exit(ngx.HTTP_OK)
    end
    if ngx.var.http_referer == (ngx.var.nginx_url .. "/health") then
        ngx.exit(ngx.HTTP_OK)
    end

    local network_availability_keycloak = checking_network_availability(keycloak_host .. "/realms/master/.well-known/openid-configuration")

    --Безопасный режим
    if network_availability_keycloak == "DOWN" then
        --Обозначаем статус аварийного режима
        ngx.var.system_is_recovery = true
        local file = io.open('/var/lib/nginx/routes/routes.effective.json', 'rb')
        if not file then return ngx.exit(ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE) end
        local ok, catalog = pcall(cjson.decode, file:read('*a'))
        file:close()
        if not ok or type(catalog) ~= 'table' or type(catalog.routes) ~= 'table' then
            return ngx.exit(ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
        end
        local application_id = ngx.var.uri:match('^/([^/]+)')
        local route = application_id and catalog.routes[application_id]
        if not route then return ngx.exit(ngx.HTTP_NOT_FOUND) end
        ngx.var.new_url = route.endpoint
        local remainder = ngx.var.request_uri:sub(#application_id + 2)
        if remainder == '' then remainder = '/' end
        if remainder:sub(1, 1) == '?' then remainder = '/' .. remainder end
        ngx.var.new_request = remainder
        ngx.var.user_groups = headers['x-user-groups']
        ngx.var.user_id = headers['x-user-id']
        ngx.var.user_login = headers['x-user-login']
        ngx.var.user_fullname = headers['x-user-fullname']
        ngx.log(ngx.WARN, "Аварийный режим: ", ngx.req.get_method() .. " запрос по адресу " .. ngx.var.new_url .. ngx.var.new_request)
    else
        local service = string.match(ngx.var.request_uri, "^/([^/?]+)")
        local serviceExchange = ""

        if ngx.var.http_referer ~= nil then
            local referel_url = ngx.var.http_referer
            local urlForReferer = "https://" .. ngx.var.server_name
            local urlForStyles = string.sub(referel_url, urlForReferer:len() + 1)
            serviceExchange = string.match(urlForStyles, "^/([^/?]+)")
        end

        -- все что в /static/ - статический контент. Обрабатыается как и любой другой запрос
        local isStatic = isStaticResource(ngx.var.request_uri);
        -- оставлено для совместимости. Ниакой модификации названия сервиса не требуется, берем из url
        local isLegacyStatic = false

        -- Работа со статическими файлами
        if not isStatic and
            ((string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, ".js$") or
            string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, ".css$") or
            string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, ".ttf$") or
            string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, ".ico$") or
            string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, ".wav$") or
            string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, ".png$") or
            string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, ".svg$") or
            string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, "config.json") or
            string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, ".mp3$")) and
            ngx.var.http_referer ~= nil) then
            isLegacyStatic = true;
        end

        -- Работа со статическими файлами
        if isLegacyStatic then
            local referel_url = ngx.var.http_referer
            local urlForReferer = "https://" .. ngx.var.server_name
            local urlForStyles = string.sub(referel_url, urlForReferer:len() + 1)
            service = string.match(urlForStyles, "^/([^/?]+)")
        end

        if service == nil or isEmptyString(service) then ngx.log(ngx.ERR, "Запрос без адресата: cервис равен nil")
        elseif (ngx.var.request_uri == "/") then ngx.log(ngx.ERR, "На вход пришел пустой request_uri")
        -- Определяем сервис адресат
        elseif service ~= "resources" and service ~= "realms" then
            -- Получаем информацию по сервису для которого получаем токен через opts ( clientId, secret, redirectUrl, backendFlag )
            if (isEmptyString(service) and ngx.var.request_uri == "/") then
                ngx.log(ngx.ERR, "На вход пришел пустой request_uri. Сервис равен nil. Входящий запрос не корректен")
            end

            local audience = service
            local audience_urlencoded = urlencode(audience, update_url, false, "Запрос отклонён: не известен целевой сервис")
            serviceExchange = ifStringPresentOrElse(serviceExchange, service)

            update_url = ngx.var.nginx_url .. "/" .. serviceExchange .. "/"

            -- Получение данных по клиентам. Повторные запрос в случае ребалансировки infinispan
            local lua_clients_info, error_lua_clients_info
            ngx.update_time()
            local begin = ngx.now() -- Фиксируем время первого запроса
            local count = 11 -- Максимально допустимое количество поторных запросов
            while count > 0 do
                lua_clients_info, error_lua_clients_info =
                    http_request:request_uri(ga_host ..
                        "/v1/clientsInformation?userService=" .. audience_urlencoded ..
                        "&userServiceExchange=" .. urlencode(serviceExchange, update_url, false, "Запрос отклонён: не указан сервис-отправитель. Отправленный запрос - " .. tostring(ngx.var.request_uri)),
                    {
                        method = "GET",
                        headers = {
                            ["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
                        },
                        ssl_verify = ssl_status
                    }
                )
                count = handle_retrying_by_response_status(lua_clients_info.status, count,"/clientsInformation: Задержка ответа, ожидаем дополнительно 1 секунду для повторного запроса")
            end
            ngx.log(ngx.DEBUG, "lua_clients_info.status: ", lua_clients_info.status)
            ngx.update_time() -- Фиксируем время получения информации информации
            lead_time = ngx.now() - begin
            ngx.log(ngx.DEBUG, "Request grant-access/v1/clientsInformation execution time: ", lead_time) -- Фиксируем в лог быстродействие запроса

            -- Обработка возможной ошибки по недоступности Grant Access
            if lua_clients_info.status == ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE then
                ngx.log(ngx.ERR, "Ошибка запроса информации по клиентам (grant-access/v1/clientsInformation): ", ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
                errorWindow(nil, 'При запросе информации по клиентам Nginx не получил ответ от Grant Access - сервис не доступен.', true, update_url, false, ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
                return
            end

            lua_clients_info_json = cjson.decode(lua_clients_info.body)

            if lua_clients_info_json.message ~= nil then
                if string.find(lua_clients_info_json.message, "UnknownHostException: keycloak") then
                    ngx.log(ngx.ERR, "Ошибка запроса информации по клиентам: ", ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
                    errorWindow(nil, "При запросе информации по клиентам Grant Access не получил ответ от KeyCloak - сервис не доступен.", true, update_url, false, ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
                else
                    ngx.log(ngx.ERR, "Неизвестная ошибка запроса информации по клиентам: ", lua_clients_info_json.message)
                    errorWindow(nil, "При запросе информации по клиентам Nginx получил неизвестную ошибку от Grant Access.", true, update_url, false, ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
                end
            end
            client_for_opts_information_json = lua_clients_info_json.referrer_client
            client_for_backend_information_json = lua_clients_info_json.target_client
            -- Получение данных по клиентам (конец)
            execution_log.get_clients_data = {
                    type = "get_clients_data",
                    referer = ngx.var.http_referer,
                    to_service = client_for_opts_information_json.client_id,
                    user_id = user_login,
                    uri = "GA/v1/clientsInformation",
                    lead_time = lead_time
                }

            if "userdata" == type(client_for_opts_information_json.redirect_urls) then
                local err_mess = 'Отсутствует ресурс для перенаправления. Проверьте конфигурацию сервиса ' .. tostring(client_for_opts_information_json.client_id)
                errorWindow(url_logout, err_mess, false, nil, false, ngx.HTTP_BAD_REQUEST)
            end
            redirect_url_custom = client_for_opts_information_json.redirect_urls[1]

            -- Генерируем ссылку для самостоятельной смены пароля пользователем
            ngx.var.cp_uri = "https://" .. ngx.var.server_name .. "/" .. serviceExchange .. "/change_password"

            ngx.log(ngx.DEBUG, "audience = ", audience)

            -- Забираем токен из запроса (если его прислали)
            local access_token = ifStringPresentOrElse(ws_proto, headers["X-SECURITY-SIGNATURE"])

            -- Endpoint для проверки токена с фронт-приложения
            if ngx.var.request_uri and string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, "/introspect", 1, true) then
                --Проверяем наличие токена в запросе
                if not access_token or access_token == "" then
                    ngx.status = ngx.HTTP_BAD_REQUEST
                    ngx.header["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
                    ngx.say(cjson.encode({ error = "token is missing" }))
                    ngx.exit(ngx.HTTP_BAD_REQUEST)
                end
                --Отправляем запрос на introspection endpoint Keycloak
                local response_introspect, error_introspect = http_request:request_uri(
                    keycloak_host .. "/realms/" .. realm .. "/protocol/openid-connect/token/introspect",
                    {
                        method = "POST",
                        headers = {
                            ["Content-Type"] = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
                        },
                        body = ngx.encode_args(
                            {
                                client_id = client_for_backend_information_json.client_id,
                                client_secret = client_for_backend_information_json.client_secret,
                                token = access_token
                            }
                        ),
                        ssl_verify = ssl_status
                    }
                )

                -- Проверяем, что HTTP-запрос вообще выполнился
                if not response_introspect then
                    -- Возвращаем ошибку, если запрос не удалось отправить
                    ngx.status = ngx.HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
                    ngx.header["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
                    ngx.say(cjson.encode({ error = "introspection request failed", details = error_introspect }))
                    ngx.exit(ngx.HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                end

                -- Проверяем HTTP-статус ответа от Keycloak
                if response_introspect.status ~= ngx.HTTP_OK then
                    -- Пробрасываем статус и тело ответа Keycloak клиенту
                    ngx.status = response_introspect.status
                    ngx.header["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
                    ngx.say(response_introspect.body)
                    ngx.exit(response_introspect.status)
                end

                -- Парсим JSON-ответ от Keycloak
                local ok, data = pcall(cjson.decode, response_introspect.body)

                -- Проверяем, что JSON распарсился и является таблицей
                if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
                    ngx.status = ngx.HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
                    ngx.header["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
                    ngx.say(cjson.encode({ error = "failed to parse introspection response" }))
                    ngx.exit(ngx.HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                end

                -- Возвращаем клиенту значение поля active из ответа Keycloak
                ngx.status = ngx.HTTP_OK
                ngx.header["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
                ngx.say(cjson.encode({ active = data.active }))
                ngx.exit(ngx.HTTP_OK)
            end

            -- Пустой секрет может быть только у публичного клиента. Доступ к такому предоставляется без дополнительных проверок
            if "userdata" == type(client_for_backend_information_json.client_secret) or isEmptyString(client_for_backend_information_json.client_secret) then
                ngx.log(ngx.DEBUG, "Обращение к публичному клиенту [" .. client_for_backend_information_json.client_id .. "] от [" .. client_for_opts_information_json.client_id .. "]")
                is_public_client = true
                access = true
                ngx.var.new_url = client_for_backend_information_json.description
                ngx.var.new_request = ngx.var.request_uri
                ngx.var.previous_auth = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-USER-PREVIOUS_AUTH"], ngx.var.previous_auth)
                ngx.var.password_exp = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-USER-PASSWORD_EXP"], ngx.var.password_exp)
                ngx.var.x_timeout_session = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-TIMEOUT-SESSION"], ngx.var.x_timeout_session)
                ngx.var.cp_uri = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-CP-URI"], ngx.var.cp_uri)
                ngx.var.user_fullname = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-USER-FULLNAME"], ngx.var.user_fullname)
                ngx.var.user_groups = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-USER-GROUPS"], ngx.var.user_groups)
                ngx.var.user_id = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-USER-ID"], ngx.var.user_id)
                ngx.var.user_login = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-USER-LOGIN"], ngx.var.user_login)
                ngx.var.user_ip = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-USER-IP"], ngx.var.user_ip)
                ngx.var.allow_patterns = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-USER-ALLOW-PATTERNS"], ngx.var.allow_patterns)
                ngx.var.forbidden_patterns = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-USER-FORBIDDEN-PATTERNS"], ngx.var.forbidden_patterns)
                ngx.var.nginx_url = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-NGINX-URI"], ngx.var.nginx_url)
                ngx .var.system_is_recovery = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["SYSTEM_IS_RECOVERY"], ngx .var.system_is_recovery)
                ngx.var.security_signature = ifStringPresentOrElse(ws_proto, headers["X-SECURITY-SIGNATURE"])
                ngx.var.visibility_zone = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-Visibility-Zone"], ngx.var.visibility_zone)
                ngx.var.canary = ifStringPresentOrElse(headers["X-SECURITY-CANARY"], ngx.var.canary)
                --Перенаправляем на смену пароля, если нужно
                redirectToPasswordChangeIfRequested(ngx.var.request_uri, ngx.var.server_name, keycloak_host, realm, service, client_for_opts_information_json.client_id)
                if isLegacyStatic then
                    ngx.var.new_url = client_for_opts_information_json.description
                    ngx.var.new_request = ngx.var.request_uri
                elseif isStatic then
                    ngx.var.new_url = client_for_opts_information_json.description
                    ngx.var.new_request = string.sub(ngx.var.request_uri, tostring(string.find(ngx.var.request_uri, "/", 2, true)))
                end
            elseif isNotEmptyString(access_token) then
                -- Валидация токена
                ngx.update_time()
                begin = ngx.now()
                local response_access, error_access = http_request:request_uri(
                    keycloak_host .. "/realms/" .. realm .. "/protocol/openid-connect/token/introspect",
                    {
                        method = "POST",
                        headers = {
                            ["Content-Type"] = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
                        },
                        body = ngx.encode_args(
                            {
                                client_id = client_for_backend_information_json.client_id,
                                client_secret = client_for_backend_information_json.client_secret,
                                token = access_token
                            }
                        ),
                        ssl_verify = ssl_status
                    }
                )
                ngx.update_time()
                lead_time = ngx.now() - begin
                ngx.log(ngx.DEBUG, "response keycloak/realms/" .. realm .. "/protocol/openid-connect/token/introspect execution time ", lead_time)

                if response_access.status == ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE then
                    ngx.log(ngx.ERR, "Ошибка запроса Keycloak/realms/" .. realm .. "/protocol/openid-connect/token/introspect: ", ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
                    errorWindow(nil, 'При проверке токена доступа Nginx не получил ответ от KeyCloak - сервис не доступен..', true, update_url, false, ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
                    return
                end
                execution_log.introspect = {
                        type = "introspect",
                        referer = ngx.var.http_referer,
                        to_service = client_for_backend_information_json.client_id,
                        user_id = user_login,
                        uri = "KK/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token/introspect",
                        lead_time = lead_time
                    }

                local response_access_json = cjson.decode(response_access.body)

                if response_access_json.active and response_access_json.active == true then
                    if client_for_backend_information_json.backend then
                        -- Обмениваем токен, если флоу сервер-сервер (Начало)
                        ngx.update_time()
                        begin = ngx.now()
                        local exchange_token_response, error_access = http_request:request_uri(
                            keycloak_host .. "/realms/" .. realm .. "/protocol/openid-connect/token",
                            {
                                method = "POST",
                                headers = {
                                    ["Content-Type"] = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
                                },
                                body = ngx.encode_args(
                                    {
                                        client_id = client_for_backend_information_json.clientId,
                                        client_secret = client_for_backend_information_json.client_secret,
                                        grant_type = "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange",
                                        subject_token_type = "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token",
                                        subject_token = access_token
                                    }
                                ),
                                ssl_verify = ssl_status
                            }
                        )
                        ngx.update_time()
                        lead_time = ngx.now() - begin
                        ngx.log(ngx.DEBUG, "Request Keycloak/realms/" .. realm .. "/protocol/openid-connect/token execution time ", lead_time)

                        if exchange_token_response.status == ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE then
                            ngx.log(ngx.ERR, "Ошибка запроса Keycloak/realms/" .. realm .. "/protocol/openid-connect/token: ", ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
                            errorWindow(nil, 'При запросе токена доступа Nginx не получил ответ от KeyCloak - сервис не доступен.', true, update_url, false, ngx.HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
                            return
                        end
                        execution_log.exchange = {
                                type = "exchange",
                                referer = ngx.var.http_referer,
                                to_service = client_for_backend_information_json.client_id,
                                user_id = user_login,
                                uri = "KK/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token",
                                lead_time = lead_time
                            }
                        -- Обмениваем токен, если флоу сервер-сервер (Конец)

                        local exchange_token_response_json = cjson.decode(exchange_token_response.body)
                        access_token = exchange_token_response_json.access_token
                        ngx.var.security_signature = access_token
                    end
                else
                    -- Обработка некорректного токена
                    ngx.log(ngx.WARN, "Попытка обратится с невалидным токеном ", ngx.HTTP_UNAUTHORIZED)
                    errorWindow(url_logout, 'Токен доступа не валиден.', false, nil, false, ngx.HTTP_UNAUTHORIZED)
                end
            else

                            ngx.var.user_groups = urlencode(user_information_json.groupsByUser, update_url, true, nil)
                            ngx.var.allow_patterns = cjson.encode(user_information_json.allowedPatterns)
                            ngx.var.forbidden_patterns = cjson.encode(user_information_json.forbiddenPatterns)
                            ngx.var.user_fullname = urlencode(ngx.var.user_fullname, update_url, false, "Ошибка приведения ФИО к URL-escape формату: ФИО не указано")
                            ngx.var.visibility_zone = ifStringPresentOrElse(user_information_json.visibilityZone, "")
                            ngx.var.canary = ifStringPresentOrElse(user_information_json.canary, "")

                            if isEmptyString(ngx.var.security_signature) then
                                if isNotEmptyString(ws_proto) then
                                    ngx.var.security_signature = ws_proto
                                else ngx.var.security_signature = headers["X-SECURITY-SIGNATURE"]
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            ngx.log(ngx.DEBUG, "Доступ запрещен: ", json_user)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            access = true
            ngx.var.new_url = keycloak_host
            ngx.var.new_request = ngx.var.request_uri
        end

        -- Запрет вызова определенных endpoints с некорректным ip на определенные сервисы
        -- (на основе параметров CLIENT_LIMITED_ACCESS,IP_LIMITED_ACCESS,ENDPOINTS_LIMITED_ACCESS)
        local arr_ip = split(ip_limited_access)
        local arr_client = split(client_limited_access)
        local arr_endpoints = split(endpoints_limited_access)
        local access_check = false
        for i_service, v_service in ipairs(arr_client) do
            for i_endpoint, v_endpoint in ipairs(arr_endpoints) do
                --совпадение по endpint и адресу client
                if (v_service .. v_endpoint == string.gsub(ngx.var.new_request, "%?.*", "")) then
                    for i_ip, v_ip in ipairs(arr_ip) do
                        --совпадение по IP
                        if (ngx.var.user_ip == v_ip) then
                            access_check = true
                        end
                    end

                    if (access_check == false) then
                        access = false
                        ngx.log(ngx.WARN,
                            "Доступ к ресурсу: " .. v_service .. v_endpoint .. " с ip адреса: " .. ngx.var.user_ip .. " запрещен")
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        ngx.update_time()
        lead_time = ngx.now() - start_time_request

        execution_log.total = {
            type = "total",
            referer = ngx.var.http_referer,
            to_service = ngx.var.new_url,
            user_login = ngx.var.user_login,
            uri = ngx.var.new_request,
            lead_time = lead_time
        }

        if performance_logs == "true" and not isLegacyStatic and not isStatic then
            ngx.log(ngx.NOTICE, "Итог обработки запроса в Nginx: " .. cjson.encode(execution_log))
        end

        -- Дебаг --
        -- ngx.log(ngx.NOTICE, "URL конечного адреса \nngx.var.new_url: ", ngx.var.new_url
        -- .. "\n ngx.var.new_request: " .. ngx.var.new_request
        -- .. "\n Заголовки:{"
        -- .. "\nngx.var.user_fullname: " .. ngx.var.user_fullname
        -- .. "\n, ngx.var.user_groups: " .. ngx.var.user_groups
        -- .. "\n, ngx.var.user_id: " .. ngx.var.user_id
        -- .. "\n, ngx.var.user_login: " .. ngx.var.user_login
        -- .. "\n, ngx.var.user_ip: " .. ngx.var.user_ip
        -- .. "\n, ngx.var.previous_auth: " .. ngx.var.previous_auth
        -- .. "\n, ngx.var.password_exp: " .. ngx.var.password_exp
        -- .. "\n, ngx.var.security_signature: " .. ngx.var.security_signature
        -- .. "\n, ngx.var.x_timeout_session: " .. ngx.var.x_timeout_session
        -- .. "\n, ngx.var.nginx_url: " .. ngx.var.nginx_url
        -- .. "\n}")

        if access == nil or access == false then
            errorWindow(urlToLogoutUrl(update_url), 'Доступы отозваны', false, update_url, false, ngx.HTTP_FORBIDDEN)
        end
    end
end

    return "Для проверки настройте узел выполнения на странице «Серверы». Сохранённый проект не изменён.";
  if (code === "EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED")
    return "Для проверки нужен готовый узел выполнения. Откройте «Серверы» и проверьте его состояние.";
  if (code === "EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED")
