function projectFolderNameError(value: string): string | null {
  const leaf = value.trim();
  if (!leaf) return null; // The existing required-field message handles this.
  if (
    value !== leaf ||
    new TextEncoder().encode(leaf).length > 256 ||
    /[<>:"/\\|?*\u0000-\u001f]/u.test(leaf) ||
    leaf === "." ||
    leaf === ".." ||
    leaf.endsWith(".") ||
    /^(con|prn|aux|nul|com[1-9]|lpt[1-9])(\..*)?$/iu.test(leaf)
  ) {
    return "Название должно быть допустимым именем одной папки Windows (не более 256 байт).";
  }
  return null;
}

function certificateSourceOptions(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: StructuralIntent[],
): CertificateSourceOptions {
  const hosts = new Set(Object.keys(managed?.servers || {}));
  const deployments = new Set(Object.keys(managed?.deployments || {}));
  const members = new Map<string, { deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>();
  for (const placement of managed?.memberPlacements || [])
    members.set(`${placement.deploymentId}\u0000${placement.memberId}`, {
      deploymentId: placement.deploymentId,
      memberId: placement.memberId,
    });
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServer") hosts.add(intent.hostId);
    if (intent.operation === "DeleteServer") hosts.delete(intent.hostId);
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServiceDeployment")
      deployments.add(intent.deploymentId);
    if (intent.operation === "DeleteServiceDeployment") {
      deployments.delete(intent.deploymentId);
      for (const [key, member] of members)
        if (member.deploymentId === intent.deploymentId) members.delete(key);
    }
    if (intent.operation === "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement") {
      for (const [key, member] of members)
        if (member.deploymentId === intent.deploymentId) members.delete(key);
      for (const member of intent.members)
        members.set(`${intent.deploymentId}\u0000${member.memberId}`, {
          deploymentId: intent.deploymentId,
          memberId: member.memberId,
        });
    }
  }
  return {
    hosts: [...hosts].sort(),
    deployments: [...deployments].sort(),
    members: [...members.values()]
      .filter((member) => deployments.has(member.deploymentId))
      .sort((left, right) =>
        `${left.deploymentId}\u0000${left.memberId}`.localeCompare(
          `${right.deploymentId}\u0000${right.memberId}`,
        ),
      ),
  };
}

      })
      .catch(
        () => live && setConfigError("Конфигурация типов серверов недоступна."),
      );
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [api]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    if (!projectOpen) {
      setCredentialStatus(null);
      return () => {
        live = false;
      };
    }
    if (!api.getSessionCredentialStatus)
      return () => {
        live = false;
      };
    api
      .getSessionCredentialStatus()
      .then((value) => live && setCredentialStatus(value))
      .catch(() => live && setCredentialStatus(null));
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [api, projectOpen, result.root]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    if (!projectOpen || !api.getExecutionNodeContext) {
      setExecutionNode(null);
      return () => {
        live = false;
      };
    }
    api
      .getExecutionNodeContext()
      .then((value) => live && setExecutionNode(value))
      .catch(() => live && setExecutionNode(null));
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [api, projectOpen, result.root, commandCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    setServiceConfigurationPreview(undefined);
    setServiceConfigurationPreviewError("");
    const revision = result.managed?.projectRevision;
    const runtimeDigest = executionNode?.runtimeDigest;
    if (
      !projectOpen ||
      !revision ||
      !result.root ||
      executionNode?.status !== "READY" ||
      !runtimeDigest ||
      !api.getServiceConfigurationPreview
    )
      return () => {
        live = false;
      };
    const root = result.root;
    const selectionKind = executionNode.selectionKind;
    const selectedHostId = executionNode.selectedHostId;
    const safeLabel = executionNode.safeLabel;
    const requestKey = JSON.stringify([
      root,
      revision,
      runtimeDigest,
      selectionKind,
      selectedHostId,
      safeLabel,
    ]);
    let request = servicePreviewRequests.current.get(requestKey);
    if (!request) {
      request = api.getServiceConfigurationPreview();
      servicePreviewRequests.current.set(requestKey, request);
      const pending = request;
      const clear = () => {
        if (servicePreviewRequests.current.get(requestKey) === pending)
          servicePreviewRequests.current.delete(requestKey);
      };
      void pending.then(clear, clear);
    }
    request
      .then((value) => {
        if (
          live &&
          value.projectRevision === revision &&
          value.runtimeDigest === runtimeDigest
        )
          setServiceConfigurationPreview({
            value,
            root,
            selectionKind,
            selectedHostId,
            safeLabel,
          });
      })
      .catch((reason: unknown) => {
        if (live) {
          setServiceConfigurationPreview(undefined);
          const safeCode = String(reason).match(
            /\b(SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_(?:UNAVAILABLE|UNSUPPORTED|STALE|RESPONSE_INVALID|INPUT_INVALID)|PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED|EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED)\b/,
          )?.[1];
          setServiceConfigurationPreviewError(
            `Core-проекция недоступна для текущей сохранённой ревизии.${safeCode ? ` Код: ${safeCode}.` : ""} Показаны безопасные локальные значения.`,
          );
        }
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [
    api,
    projectOpen,
    result.root,
    result.managed?.projectRevision,
    executionNode?.status,
    executionNode?.runtimeDigest,
    executionNode?.selectionKind,
    executionNode?.selectedHostId,
    executionNode?.safeLabel,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    if (!projectOpen || !api.getInstallationState) {
      setInstallationState(undefined);
      setInstallationPlan(undefined);
      setInfrastructureObservation(undefined);
      return () => {
        live = false;
      };
    }
    api
      .getInfrastructureVerification?.()
      .then((value) => live && setInfrastructureObservation(value))
      .catch(() => live && setInfrastructureObservation(undefined));
    api
      .getInstallationState()
      .then((value) => live && setInstallationState(value))
      .catch(() => live && setInstallationState(undefined));
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [
    api,
    projectOpen,
    result.root,
    result.managed?.projectRevision,
    commandCount,
    executionNode?.status,
    verification.status,
    verification.error?.code,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    const planId = installationState?.plan.planId;
    if (!planId || !api.getInstallationPlan) {
      setInstallationPlan(undefined);
      return () => {
        live = false;
      };
    }
    api
      .getInstallationPlan(planId)
      .then((value) => live && setInstallationPlan(value))
      .catch(() => live && setInstallationPlan(undefined));
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [api, installationState?.plan.planId]);

  const clearDraft = () => {
    setImportReview(false);
    setEdit(null);
    setEditError(null);
    setSessionId("");
    setCommandCount(0);
    setIntents([]);
    setReviewOpen(false);
    setServiceFormEpoch((current) => current + 1);
  };
  const resetTopologySelection = () => {
    setTopologyTab("services");
    setSelectedTopologyDeployment("");
    setSelectedTopologyHost("");
    setServicesView("list");
    setSelectedServiceDeployment("");
    setSelectedServiceMember("");
    setCertificateReturn(null);
    endpointPreviewRequest.current += 1;
    setEndpointPreview(undefined);
    setVerifiedPKI(undefined);
    setInstallationTab("summary");
    setInstallationPlan(undefined);
  };
  const clearRefreshFailure = () => {
    setRefreshRequired(false);
    setRefreshRoot("");
    setRefreshError("");
  };
  const open = async () => {
    if (!confirmApplicationExit()) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const next = await api.chooseProject();
      setResult(next);
      clearRefreshFailure();
      resetTopologySelection();
      setPage("project");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const chooseParent = async () => {
    const selected = await api.chooseProjectParent();
    if (selected) {
      setParent(selected);
      setSeparator("\\");
    }
  };
  const updateDestination = (value: string) => {
    setParent("");
    setRoot(value);
  };
  const adoptDestinationParent = () => {
    const index = Math.max(root.lastIndexOf("\\"), root.lastIndexOf("/"));
    if (index >= 0) {
      setParent(root.slice(0, index));
      setSeparator(root[index]);
    }
  };
  const create = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!name.trim()) {
      setNameRequired(true);
      return;
    }
    if (nameError) return;
    setCreating(true);
    setCreateError(null);
    try {
      const next = await api.createProject({
        projectRoot: destination,
        displayName: name,
        compatibilitySourceId: "default",
      });
      if (next.status !== "OPEN") {
        setCreateError(
          next.error || {
            code: "PROJECT_CREATE_FAILED",
            message: "Не удалось создать проект.",
          },
        );
        return;
      }
      setResult(next);
      clearRefreshFailure();
      resetTopologySelection();
      setProjectDialog(false);
      setPage("project");
      setName("");
      setRoot("");
      setParent("");
      setSeparator("\\");
      setNameRequired(false);
    } catch {
      setCreateError({
        code: "PROJECT_CREATE_UNAVAILABLE",
        message: "Не удалось создать проект. Попробуйте снова.",
      });
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };
  const close = async () => {
    if (!confirmApplicationExit()) return;
    setResult(await api.closeProject());
    clearRefreshFailure();
    resetTopologySelection();
    setPage("project");
  };
  const refreshBundleUpdate = async () => {
    if (!api.chooseRuntimeBundleUpdate) return;
    setBundleBusy(true);
    try {
      setBundleUpdate(await api.chooseRuntimeBundleUpdate());
    } finally {
      setBundleBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const confirmBundleUpdate = async () => {
    if (!api.confirmRuntimeBundleUpdate || !bundleUpdate?.previewId) return;
    setBundleBusy(true);
    try {
      const next = await api.confirmRuntimeBundleUpdate(bundleUpdate.previewId);
      setBundleUpdate(next);
      if (next.status === "UPDATED" && result.root)
        setResult(await api.openProject(result.root));
    } finally {
      setBundleBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const [lastNodeCheck, setLastNodeCheck] = useState<{
    binding: string;
    readiness: ExecutionNodeReadiness;
  } | null>(null);
  const nodeCheckBinding = (context: ExecutionNodeContext | null) =>
    JSON.stringify([
      result.root,
      context?.selectedHostId,
      context?.runtimeDigest,
      credentialStatus?.expiresAt,
      credentialStatus?.sshMode,
      credentialStatus?.status,
    ]);
  useEffect(
    () => setServerInformation({}),
    [
      result.root,
      result.managed?.projectRevision,
      credentialStatus?.expiresAt,
      credentialStatus?.status,
      credentialStatus?.sshMode,
    ],
  );
  const informationBinding = JSON.stringify([
    result.root,
    result.managed?.projectRevision,
    credentialStatus?.expiresAt,
    credentialStatus?.status,
    credentialStatus?.sshMode,
    executionNode?.selectedHostId,
  ]);
  const informationBindingRef = useRef(informationBinding);
  informationBindingRef.current = informationBinding;
  const probeServerInformation = useCallback(
    (hostId: string) => {
      if (!api.probeServerInformation)
        throw new Error("SERVER_INFORMATION_UNAVAILABLE");
      return api.probeServerInformation(hostId);
    },
    [api],
  );
  const checkServerInformation = async (probeId: string) => {
    if (!api.checkServerInformation)
      throw new Error("SERVER_INFORMATION_UNAVAILABLE");
    const binding = informationBindingRef.current;
    const info = await api.checkServerInformation(probeId);
    if (binding !== informationBindingRef.current)
      throw new Error("SERVER_INFORMATION_BINDING_CHANGED");
    if (info.hostId)
      setServerInformation((current) => ({ ...current, [info.hostId!]: info }));
    if (
      info.status === "CHECKED" &&
      info.hostId === executionNode?.selectedHostId
    ) {
      // Runtime readiness is independent and may take longer than SSH facts.
      void checkExecutionNode().catch(() => {});
    }
    return info;
  };
  const inspectOrphanRun = async () => {
    if (!api.inspectOrphanRun) return;
    setBundleBusy(true);
    try {
      const inspected = await api.inspectOrphanRun();
      setOrphanRun(inspected);
      if (
        ["RESOLVED", "NONE"].includes(inspected.status) &&
        api.chooseRuntimeBundleUpdate
      ) {
        setBundleUpdate(await api.chooseRuntimeBundleUpdate());
      }
    } finally {
      setBundleBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const refreshInstallationState = async () => {
    if (!api.getInstallationState) return;
    const next = await api.getInstallationState();
    setInstallationState(next);
  };
  const attachOrphanRun = async () => {
    if (!api.attachOrphanRun || !orphanRun?.recoveryId) return;
    setBundleBusy(true);
    try {
      const operation = await api.attachOrphanRun(orphanRun.recoveryId);
      if (operation.status !== "READY" || !operation.run) {
        setOrphanRun({
          ...orphanRun,
          status: "BLOCKED",
          error: operation.error,
        });
        return;
      }
      if (
        installationSubscriptionRef.current &&
        api.unsubscribeInstallationRun
      ) {
        await api.unsubscribeInstallationRun(
          installationSubscriptionRef.current,
        );
      }
      installationSubscriptionRef.current = "";
      setInstallationSubscription("");
      setInstallationRun(operation);
      setInstallationEvents([]);
      const recoveredPlan = operation.plan as InstallationPlanOperation["plan"];
      setRunPlan(recoveredPlan);
      activeRunIdRef.current = operation.run.runId;
      lastRecoveryCursorRef.current.delete(operation.run.runId);
      runProgressRef.current = beginRunProgress(
        operation.run.runId,
        recoveredPlan,
      );
      setRunProgress(runProgressRef.current);
      setPage("installation");
      setInstallationTab(operation.result ? "result" : "execution");
      setOrphanRun(null);
      if (api.subscribeInstallationRun) {
        const subscription = await api.subscribeInstallationRun(
          operation.run.runId,
          0,
        );
        installationSubscriptionRef.current = subscription.subscriptionId || "";
        setInstallationSubscription(installationSubscriptionRef.current);
      }
    } finally {
      setBundleBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const installationOrderRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const installationLibraryOrderRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const installationSkippedLibrariesRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const createInstallationPlan = async (
    deploymentOrder: string[],
    executionMode: InstallationExecutionMode = "FULL_PROJECT",
    skipInfrastructureVerify = false,
    applicationLibraryOrder: string[] = [],
    skipApplicationLibraries: string[] = [],
  ) => {
    if (
      ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
        installationRun?.run?.state || "",
      )
    )
      return;
    if (!api.createInstallationPlan && !api.createInstallationPlanForMode)
      return;
    setInstallationBusy(true);
    installationOrderRef.current = deploymentOrder;
    installationLibraryOrderRef.current = applicationLibraryOrder;
    installationSkippedLibrariesRef.current = skipApplicationLibraries;
    try {
      const operation: InstallationPlanOperation =
        api.createInstallationPlanForMode
          ? await api.createInstallationPlanForMode({
              executionMode,
              deploymentOrder,
              ...(applicationLibraryOrder.length
                ? { applicationLibraryOrder }
                : {}),
              applicationVaultSources: {},
              skipInfrastructureVerify,
              ...(skipApplicationLibraries.length
                ? { skipApplicationLibraries }
                : {}),
            })
          : executionMode === "FULL_PROJECT" &&
              !skipApplicationLibraries.length &&
              api.createInstallationPlan
            ? await api.createInstallationPlan(deploymentOrder)
            : {
                status: "BLOCKED",
                error: {
                  code: "EXECUTION_MODE_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED",
                  message:
                    "Режим библиотек не поддерживается текущим transport. Полная установка не запущена.",
                },
              };
      setInstallationPlan(operation);
      await refreshInstallationState();
      setInstallationTab("plan");
    } finally {
      setInstallationBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const approveInstallationPlan = async (
    planId: string,
    acknowledgements: string[],
  ) => {
    if (
      ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
        installationRun?.run?.state || "",
      )
    )
      return;
    if (!api.approveInstallationPlan) return;
    setInstallationBusy(true);
    try {
      if (
        (installationPlan?.plan?.executionMode || "FULL_PROJECT") !==
        installationExecutionMode
      ) {
        if (!api.createInstallationPlanForMode) return;
        const skippedLibraries =
          installationPlan?.plan?.skipApplicationLibraries ??
          installationSkippedLibrariesRef.current;
        const fresh = await api.createInstallationPlanForMode({
          executionMode: installationExecutionMode,
          deploymentOrder: installationOrderRef.current,
          ...(installationLibraryOrderRef.current.length
            ? { applicationLibraryOrder: installationLibraryOrderRef.current }
            : {}),
          applicationVaultSources: {},
          ...(skippedLibraries.length
            ? { skipApplicationLibraries: skippedLibraries }
            : {}),
        });
        setInstallationPlan(fresh);
        const previous = installationPlan?.plan;
        const next = fresh.plan;
        if (
          !next ||
          next.status !== "EXECUTABLE" ||
          fresh.error ||
          installationExecutionMode === "FULL_PROJECT" ||
          next.executionNodeId !== previous?.executionNodeId ||
          JSON.stringify(next.runtime) !== JSON.stringify(previous?.runtime) ||
          next.projectRevision !== previous?.projectRevision ||
          next.acknowledgements.some(
            (item) =>
              !previous.acknowledgements.some(
                (old) =>
                  old.code === item.code &&
                  old.summary === item.summary &&
                  acknowledgements.includes(item.code),
              ),
          )
        ) {
          await refreshInstallationState();
          return;
        }
        planId = next.id;
        acknowledgements = next.acknowledgements.map((item) => item.code);
      }
      const operation = await api.approveInstallationPlan(
        planId,
        acknowledgements,
      );
      setInstallationPlan(operation);
      if (operation.error) setApprovalErrorAttempt((attempt) => attempt + 1);
      await refreshInstallationState();
    } finally {
      setInstallationBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const startApprovedInstallation = async (planId: string) => {
    if (
      ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
        installationRun?.run?.state || "",
      )
    )
      return;
    if (!api.startApprovedInstallation) return;
    setInstallationBusy(true);
    try {
      const operation = await api.startApprovedInstallation(planId);
      if (operation.status === "BLOCKED" && api.getInstallationPlan) {
        setInstallationPlan(await api.getInstallationPlan(planId));
      }
      setInstallationRun(operation);
      setInstallationEvents([]);
      setRunPlan(operation.run ? installationPlan?.plan : undefined);
      activeRunIdRef.current = operation.run?.runId || "";
      runProgressRef.current = operation.run
        ? beginRunProgress(operation.run.runId, installationPlan?.plan)
        : undefined;
      setRunProgress(runProgressRef.current);
      setInstallationTab("execution");
      if (operation.run && api.subscribeInstallationRun) {
        if (
          installationSubscriptionRef.current &&
          api.unsubscribeInstallationRun
        ) {
          await api.unsubscribeInstallationRun(
            installationSubscriptionRef.current,
          );
          installationSubscriptionRef.current = "";
        }
        const subscription = await api.subscribeInstallationRun(
          operation.run.runId,
          0,
        );
        installationSubscriptionRef.current = subscription.subscriptionId || "";
        setInstallationSubscription(installationSubscriptionRef.current);
      }
      await refreshInstallationState();
    } finally {
      setInstallationBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const cancelInstallationRun = async (runId: string) => {
    if (!api.cancelInstallationRun) return;
    setInstallationBusy(true);
    try {
      const operation = await api.cancelInstallationRun(runId);
      setInstallationRun({
        ...operation,
        run: operation.run ?? installationRun?.run,
      } as InstallationRunOperation);
      if (operation.status !== "BLOCKED") {
        setInstallationPlan(undefined);
        await refreshInstallationState();
      }
    } finally {
      setInstallationBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const setOutputEncryptionPassword = async (
    password: string,
    confirm: string,
  ) => {
    if (!api.setSecretOutputEncryptionPassword)
      throw new Error("SECRET_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE");
    await api.setSecretOutputEncryptionPassword(password, confirm);
    if (installationPlan?.plan?.id && api.getInstallationPlan) {
      setInstallationPlan(
        await api.getInstallationPlan(installationPlan.plan.id),
      );
    }
  };
  const refreshSecretOutputs = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!api.listPendingSecretOutputs) return;
    try {
      setSecretOutputPackages(await api.listPendingSecretOutputs());
    } catch {
      setSecretOutputPackages(secretOutputListingUnavailable());
    }
  }, [api]);
  const collectAndDeliverSecretOutputs = useCallback(
    async (runId: string, manual = false) => {
      if (!api.listPendingSecretOutputs) return;
      let pending: SecretOutputPackagesOperation;
      try {
        pending = await api.listPendingSecretOutputs();
      } catch {
        setSecretOutputPackages(secretOutputListingUnavailable());
        return;
      }
      setSecretOutputPackages(pending);
      const plan = installationPlan?.plan;
      if (
        pending.status !== "READY" ||
        (!manual &&
          (!plan?.secretOutputEncryptionRequired ||
            !plan.secretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresent))
      )
        return;
      const candidates = [...(pending.packages || [])];
      let cursor = pending.nextCursor;
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      for (let page = 1; cursor && page < 128; page++) {
        if (seen.has(cursor)) break;
        seen.add(cursor);
        let next: SecretOutputPackagesOperation;
        try {
          next = await api.listPendingSecretOutputs(cursor);
        } catch {
          setSecretOutputPackages(secretOutputListingUnavailable());
          return;
        }
        if (next.status !== "READY") break;
        candidates.push(...(next.packages || []));
        cursor = next.nextCursor;
      }
      for (const item of candidates) {
        if (
          (!manual && runId && item.sourceRunId !== runId) ||
          item.state === "LOCAL_DELIVERED"
        )
          continue;
        if (!api.deliverPendingSecretOutput) break;
        try {
          const delivery = await api.deliverPendingSecretOutput(item.packageId);
          setOutputDelivery(delivery);
          if (delivery.status !== "DELIVERED") break;
        } catch {
          setOutputDelivery(secretOutputDeliveryUnavailable());
          return;
        }
      }
      try {
        setSecretOutputPackages(await api.listPendingSecretOutputs());
      } catch {
        setSecretOutputPackages(secretOutputListingUnavailable());
      }
    },
    [api, installationPlan?.plan],
  );
  const recoverInstallationRunEvents = useCallback(
    async (runId: string, afterSequence: number) => {
      if (
        !api.subscribeInstallationRun ||
        !api.unsubscribeInstallationRun ||
        resyncingRunIdRef.current === runId
      )
        return;
      const lastAttempt = lastRecoveryCursorRef.current.get(runId);
      if (lastAttempt !== undefined && afterSequence <= lastAttempt) return;
      lastRecoveryCursorRef.current.set(runId, afterSequence);
      resyncingRunIdRef.current = runId;
      const previous = installationSubscriptionRef.current;
      installationSubscriptionRef.current = "";
      setInstallationSubscription("");
      try {
        if (previous) await api.unsubscribeInstallationRun(previous);
        const subscription = await api.subscribeInstallationRun(
          runId,
          afterSequence,
        );
        if (
          subscription.status === "SUBSCRIBED" &&
          subscription.subscriptionId
        ) {
          installationSubscriptionRef.current = subscription.subscriptionId;
          setInstallationSubscription(subscription.subscriptionId);
        } else if (api.getInstallationRun) {
          setInstallationRun(await api.getInstallationRun(runId));
        }
      } catch {
        if (api.getInstallationRun)
          void api
            .getInstallationRun(runId)
            .then(setInstallationRun)
            .catch(() => {});
      } finally {
        resyncingRunIdRef.current = "";
      }
    },
    [api],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!api.subscribeInstallationRunEvents) return undefined;
    return api.subscribeInstallationRunEvents(
      (value: {
        subscriptionId?: string;
        event?: InstallationEventView;
        errorCode?: string;
      }) => {
        if (!value.event) {
          if (
            value.errorCode === "OBSERVER_HISTORY_GAP" &&
            activeRunIdRef.current &&
            api.getInstallationRun
          ) {
            void api
              .getInstallationRun(activeRunIdRef.current)
              .then(setInstallationRun)
              .catch(() => {});
          }
          if (
            value.errorCode === "OBSERVER_SUBSCRIBER_SLOW" &&
            activeRunIdRef.current
          ) {
            void recoverInstallationRunEvents(
              activeRunIdRef.current,
              runProgressRef.current?.lastContiguousSequence || 0,
            );
          }
          return;
        }
        const subscriptionMatches =
          value.subscriptionId === installationSubscriptionRef.current;
        if (
          !subscriptionMatches &&
          value.event.runId !== activeRunIdRef.current
        )
          return;
        setInstallationEvents((current) => {
          if (current.some((event) => event.sequence === value.event!.sequence))
            return current;
          return [...current, value.event!].sort(
            (left, right) => left.sequence - right.sequence,
          );
        });
        const previousProgress = runProgressRef.current;
        const nextProgress = previousProgress
          ? observeRunEvent(previousProgress, value.event)
          : undefined;
        if (nextProgress) {
          runProgressRef.current = nextProgress;
          setRunProgress(nextProgress);
          if (nextProgress.pendingSequences.length > 0) {
            void recoverInstallationRunEvents(
              value.event.runId,
              nextProgress.lastContiguousSequence,
            );
          }
        }
        if (
          ["SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED", "INTERRUPTED"].includes(
            value.event.status,
          ) &&
          api.getInstallationRun
        ) {
          void api
            .getInstallationRun(value.event.runId)
            .then((next) => {
              setInstallationRun(next);
              if (next.reconnected) {
                if (next.result) setInstallationTab("result");
              } else {
                void collectAndDeliverSecretOutputs(value.event!.runId).catch(
                  () => setOutputDelivery(secretOutputDeliveryUnavailable()),
                );
              }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        }
      },
    );
  }, [
    api,
    installationSubscription,
    collectAndDeliverSecretOutputs,
    recoverInstallationRunEvents,
  ]);
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (installationSubscriptionRef.current && api.unsubscribeInstallationRun)
        void api.unsubscribeInstallationRun(
          installationSubscriptionRef.current,
        );
    },
    [api],
  );

                  void discard();
                  setImportReview(false);
                }

              onSave={save}
              onDiscard={discard}

              onClose={() => !exportBusy && setExportDialog(false)}
            />

        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

function ProjectPage({
  catalogStatus,
  bundleUpdate,
  bundleBusy,
  onRefreshBundle,
  onConfirmBundle,
  empty,
  snapshot,
  managed,
  verification,
  local,
  onClose,
  onServers,
  closeDisabled,
  exportAvailable,
  onExport,
}: {
  catalogStatus?: string;
  bundleUpdate: RuntimeBundleUpdate | null;
  bundleBusy: boolean;
  onRefreshBundle: () => void;
  onConfirmBundle: () => void;
  empty: boolean;
  snapshot: OpenResult["snapshot"];
  managed: OpenResult["managed"];
  verification: NonNullable<OpenResult["verification"]>;
  local: OpenResult["project"];
  onClose: () => void;
  onServers: () => void;
  closeDisabled: boolean;
  exportAvailable: boolean;
  onExport: () => void;
}) {
  const bundleCard = (
    <section className="card" aria-label="Набор установки">
      <h2>Набор установки</h2>
      {catalogStatus !== "READY" && (
        <p role="status">
          Нужна перепривязка набора установки: сохранённые данные проекта
          доступны, но текущий проверенный набор не соответствует проекту или
          отсутствует. Проверка Core и новый план пока недоступны.
        </p>
      )}
      <p>
        Поместите полученный набор целиком в папку bundle внутри проекта.
        Обнаружение не меняет привязку.
      </p>
      <button
        className="outline"
        onClick={onRefreshBundle}
        disabled={bundleBusy}
      >
        Проверить новый набор
      </button>
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "NOT_FOUND" && <p>Новый набор не найден.</p>}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "UNCHANGED" && (
        <p>Набор уже привязан к проекту.</p>
      )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "PREVIEW" && (
        <>
          <dl>
            <dt>Текущий digest</dt>
            <dd>{bundleUpdate.currentArtifactDigest}</dd>
            <dt>Новый digest</dt>
            <dd>{bundleUpdate.newArtifactDigest}</dd>
            <dt>Каталог</dt>
            <dd>{bundleUpdate.newCatalogDigest}</dd>
            <dt>Версия набора / Core</dt>
            <dd>
              {bundleUpdate.bundleVersion} / {bundleUpdate.coreVersion}
            </dd>
          </dl>
          <p>
            После привязки прежняя проверка и одобренный план станут
            недействительными. Перед установкой заново подготовьте узел,
            проверьте проект и создайте план.
          </p>
          <button onClick={onConfirmBundle} disabled={bundleBusy}>
            Привязать
          </button>
        </>
      )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "UPDATED" && (
        <p>
          Новый набор привязан. Подготовьте узел выполнения и создайте свежий
          план.
        </p>
      )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "BLOCKED" &&
        bundleUpdate.error?.code !== "INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE" && (
          <p role="alert">
            Привязка сейчас недоступна:{" "}
            {bundleUpdate.error?.message ||
              bundleUpdate.error?.code ||
              "проверьте набор и состояние выполнения"}
            .
          </p>
        )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "BLOCKED" &&
        bundleUpdate.error?.code &&
        bundleUpdate.error.code !== "INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE" && (
          <p className="muted">Код: {bundleUpdate.error.code}</p>
        )}
      {bundleUpdate?.error?.code === "INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE" && (
        <div role="alert">
          <p>
            Прежний запуск установки не подтверждён как завершённый. Проверка
            нового набора пока недоступна.
          </p>
          <p>
            Перейдите на страницу «Серверы», восстановите доступ к узлу
            выполнения и нажмите «Проверить прежний запуск».
          </p>
          <button className="outline" onClick={onServers}>
            Перейти к серверам
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "PUBLISHED_NOT_BOUND" && (
        <p role="alert">
          Набор опубликован, но проект не перепривязан. Проверьте проект и
          повторите операцию.
        </p>
      )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "BOUND_REFRESH_REQUIRED" && (
        <p role="alert">Привязка записана, но проект нужно открыть заново.</p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
  if (empty && local)
    return (
      <>
        <section className="title">
          <div>
            <h1>Проект ещё не настроен</h1>
            <p>
              Это корректный проект только с метаданными. Добавьте серверы,
              затем проверьте и сохраните проект.
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            className="outline"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={closeDisabled}
          >
            Закрыть проект
          </button>
        </section>
        <section className="grid">
          <Stat label="Серверы" value={0} />
          <Stat label="Развёртывания / Сервисы" value={0} />
          <Stat label="Выполнения" value={0} />
          <Stat label="Инвентарь" value="Не создан" />
        </section>
        <section className="card">

            <dd>{local.name}</dd>
            <dt>Project ID</dt>
            <dd>{local.id}</dd>
            <dt>Источник совместимости</dt>
            <dd>{local.source?.bundleDigest}</dd>
          </dl>
          <button onClick={onServers}>Добавить первый сервер</button>
          <button
            className="outline"
            onClick={onExport}
            disabled={!exportAvailable}
          >
            Экспортировать проект
          </button>
        </section>
        {bundleCard}
      </>
    );
  return (
    <>
      <section className="title">
        <div>
          <h1>
            {(snapshot?.project as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.name
              ? String((snapshot?.project as Record<string, unknown>).name)
              : "Проект"}
          </h1>
          <p>Сохранённые поля проекта, управляемые инсталлером.</p>
        </div>
        <button className="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={closeDisabled}>
          Закрыть проект
        </button>
      </section>
      <section className="grid">
        <Stat
          label="Серверы"
          value={managed ? count(managed.servers) : "Нет данных"}
        />
        <Stat
          label="Развёртывания"
          value={managed ? count(managed.deployments) : "Нет данных"}
        />
        <Stat
          label="Профили сертификатов"
          value={managed ? count(managed.pki?.profiles) : "Нет данных"}
        />
        <Stat
          label="Замечания проверки"
          value={
            snapshot?.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision &&
            ["VERIFIED", "INVALID"].includes(verification.status) &&
            snapshot?.findings
              ? snapshot.findings.length
              : "Не проверено"
          }
        />
      </section>
      <section className="card">
        <h2>Состояние проекта</h2>
        <dl>
          <dt>Статус</dt>
          <dd>
            {verificationLabel(verification.status, !!verification.error)}
          </dd>
          <dt>Ревизия</dt>
          <dd>{managed?.projectRevision || snapshot?.projectRevision}</dd>
        </dl>
        {verification.error && (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert">
            {verificationErrorMessage(verification.error.code)}
          </p>
        )}
        <button onClick={onServers}>Открыть серверы</button>
        <button
          className="outline"
          onClick={onExport}
          disabled={!exportAvailable}
        >
          Экспортировать проект
        </button>
      </section>
      {bundleCard}
    </>
  );

function ProjectExportDialog({
  parent,
  name,
  operation,
  busy,
  onParentChange,
  onNameChange,
  onChooseParent,
  onPreview,
  onCommit,
  onReopen,
  onClose,
}: {
  parent: string;
  name: string;
  operation: ProjectExportOperationResult | null;
  busy: boolean;
  onParentChange: (value: string) => void;
  onNameChange: (value: string) => void;
  onChooseParent: () => void;
  onPreview: (event: React.FormEvent) => void;
  onCommit: () => void;
  onReopen: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const plan = operation?.plan;
  const result = operation?.result;
  const canPreview = !!parent && !!name.trim() && !busy && !plan;
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <form
        className="card dialog review-dialog"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="project-export-title"
        onSubmit={onPreview}
      >
        <h1 id="project-export-title">Экспорт проекта</h1>
        {!plan && !result && (
          <>
            <p>
              Будет создана новая папка с переносимой конфигурацией проекта.
              Секреты, данные выполнения, обнаруженные сведения, планы, журналы
              и результаты не экспортируются.
            </p>
            <label>
              Папка назначения
              <div className="inline-fields">
                <input
                  value={parent}
                  onChange={(event) => onParentChange(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="C:\\Projects"
                  required
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="outline"
                  onClick={onChooseParent}
                  disabled={busy}
                >
                  Выбрать
                </button>
              </div>
            </label>
            <label>
              Имя проекта и новой папки
              <input
                value={name}
                onChange={(event) => onNameChange(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="portable-project"
                required
                maxLength={128}
              />
            </label>
          </>
        )}
        {operation?.error && (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert">
            <code>{operation.error.code}</code> {operation.error.message}
          </p>
        )}
        {plan && (
          <>
            <p>
              Проверьте состав перед публикацией. Существующая папка назначения
              никогда не будет перезаписана.
            </p>
            <dl>
              <dt>Новая папка</dt>
              <dd>{plan.destinationRoot}</dd>
              <dt>Ревизия проекта</dt>
              <dd>{plan.sourceProjectRevision}</dd>
              <dt>Файлы</dt>
              <dd>{plan.documents.length}</dd>
              <dt>Размер</dt>
              <dd>{plan.aggregateSize} байт</dd>
            </dl>
            <p className="readonly">
              Исключено:{" "}
              {plan.excludedCategories.map(exportExclusionLabel).join(", ")}
            </p>
          </>
        )}
        {result?.status === "EXPORTED" && (
          <p className="success" role="status">
            Экспорт завершён: {result.destinationRoot}
          </p>
        )}
        <footer className="dialog-actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="outline"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={busy}
          >
            {result?.status === "EXPORTED" ? "Готово" : "Отмена"}
          </button>
          {!plan && !result && (
            <button type="submit" disabled={!canPreview}>
              {busy ? "Подготовка…" : "Проверить состав"}
            </button>
          )}
          {plan && (
            <button type="button" onClick={onCommit} disabled={busy}>
              {busy ? "Экспорт…" : "Экспортировать"}
            </button>
          )}
          {result?.status === "EXPORTED" && (
            <button type="button" onClick={onReopen} disabled={busy}>
              {busy ? "Открытие…" : "Открыть экспортированный проект"}
            </button>
          )}
        </footer>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

function reviewFindingMessage(code: string, fallback: string): string {
  if (code === "REFERENCE_IN_USE") {
    if (
      fallback.startsWith("Нельзя удалить экземпляр:") ||
      fallback.startsWith("Нельзя удалить группу endpoint:")
    )
      return fallback;
    return "Объект используется. Сначала удалите связанные ссылки.";
  }
  if (code === "INVALID_VALUE")
    return "Значение не соответствует ограничениям каталога.";
  return fallback;
}

function ReviewDialog({
  edit,
  error,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onReview,
  onSave,
  onDiscard,
}: {
  edit: EditResult | null;
  error: EditResult["error"] | null;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onReview: () => void;
  onSave: () => void;
  onDiscard: () => void;
}) {
  const plan = edit?.plan;
  const conflict =
    error?.code === "EDIT_COMMAND_CONFLICT" ||
    plan?.finding?.code === "EDIT_COMMAND_CONFLICT";
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <section
        className="card dialog review-dialog"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="review-title"
      >
        <h1 id="review-title">Изменения конфигурации</h1>
        {error && (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert">
            <code>{error.code}</code>{" "}
            {reviewFindingMessage(error.code, error.message)}
          </p>
        )}
        {plan ? (
          <>
            {plan.finding && (
              <p className="field-error" role="alert">
                <code>{plan.finding.code}</code>{" "}
                {reviewFindingMessage(
                  plan.finding.code,
                  plan.finding.safeMessage,
                )}
              </p>
            )}
            {plan.status === "NO_CHANGE" ? (
              <p role="status">
                Изменения не затрагивают файлы проекта — сохранять нечего.
                Пароль PKCS#12 хранится только в текущем сеансе и не
                записывается в проект.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p>
                Локальная структурная проверка завершена. Документов:{" "}
                {plan.affectedDocuments?.length ?? 0}.
              </p>
            )}
            <ul>
              {plan.semanticChanges?.map((change, index) => (
                <li key={index}>{change.safeSummary}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            {plan.affectedDocuments && plan.affectedDocuments.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <h2>Затрагиваемые документы</h2>
                <ul>
                  {plan.affectedDocuments.map((document) => (
                    <li key={document.logicalPath}>
                      {document.logicalPath}: {document.before?.state} →{" "}
                      {document.after?.state}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <p>Проверка черновика ещё не вернула план.</p>
        )}
        <div className="actions">
          <button className="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            Вернуться к редактированию
          </button>
          <button className="outline" onClick={onDiscard} disabled={busy}>
            Отменить все изменения
          </button>
          {plan?.saveAllowed ? (
            <button onClick={onSave} disabled={busy}>
              Сохранить проект
            </button>
          ) : !conflict && plan?.status !== "NO_CHANGE" ? (
            <button onClick={onReview} disabled={busy}>
              {busy ? "Проверка…" : "Повторить проверку"}
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
function Stat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: number | string }) {
  return (
    <article className="stat">
      <span>{label}</span>
      <strong>{value}</strong>
      {value === 0 && <small>Нет данных</small>}
    </article>
  );
}

export function ApplicationAccountAccess({

    ? raw.map((value) => objectValue(value) as unknown as Access)
    : [];

    return (
      resource.kind === `${serviceType}.database` &&
      String(objectValue(bindings[String(resource.binding)]).deploymentRef) ===

  const save = async (next: Access[]) => {
    const value: ObjectValue = pg

      : {
          databaseRef:

export function ApplicationRedisAccess({
  value,
  disabled,
  onSave,
  onDirtyChange,
  sentinel = false,
}: {
  value: ObjectValue;
  disabled: boolean;
  sentinel?: boolean;
  onSave: (value: ObjectValue) => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (value: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const [fields, setFields] = useState(() =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      ["commands", "keys", "channels"].map((key) => [
        key,
        Array.isArray(value[key]) ? (value[key] as string[]).join(", ") : "",
      ]),
    ),
  );
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  return (
    <fieldset className="application-redis-access">
      <legend>ACL {sentinel ? "Sentinel" : "Redis"}</legend>
      {["commands", "keys", "channels"].map((key) => (
        <label key={key}>
          {
            {
              commands: "Команды",
              keys: "Шаблоны ключей",
              channels: "Шаблоны каналов",
            }[key]
          }
          <input
            aria-label={`ACL ${key}`}
            disabled={disabled}
            value={fields[key]}
            placeholder="Значения через запятую"
            onChange={(event) => {
              setFields({ ...fields, [key]: event.target.value });
              setDirty(true);
              onDirtyChange(true);
            }}
          />
        </label>
      ))}
      <p className="muted">
        Права задаются списком команд и шаблонов. Core проверит формат данных.
      </p>
      <button
        disabled={disabled || !dirty || !fields.commands.trim()}
        onClick={() => {
          const next = Object.fromEntries(
            ["commands", "keys", "channels"].map((key) => [
              key,
              fields[key]
                .split(",")
                .map((v) => v.trim())
                .filter(Boolean),
            ]),
          );
          void onSave(next).then((ok) => {
            if (ok) {
              setDirty(false);
              onDirtyChange(false);
            }
          });
        }}
      >
        В черновик
      </button>
    </fieldset>
  );
}

  onSave: (value: Obj) => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const dirtyRows = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const names = [
    ...new Set([...Object.keys(hints), ...Object.keys(value), ...added]),
  ];
  const mark = (key: string, dirty: boolean) => {
    if (dirty) dirtyRows.current.add(key);
    else dirtyRows.current.delete(key);
    onDirtyChange(dirtyRows.current.size > 0 || !!name);
  };
  return (
    <section className="application-bindings-table">
      <h3>Подключения библиотеки</h3>
      <p>
        Выберите сервис, предоставляемое подключение или TLS-профиль.
        Совместимость проверяет Core.
      </p>
      <div
        className="application-connections-scroll"
        role="region"
        aria-label="Список подключений"
        tabIndex={0}
      >
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Подключение</th>
              <th>Тип</th>
              <th>Deployment / профиль</th>
              <th>Действия</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {names.map((key) => (
              <BindingRow
                key={key + JSON.stringify(value[key])}
                name={key}
                isVault={
                  deploymentTypes[
                    String(objectValue(value[key]).deploymentRef)
                  ] === "vault"
                }
                selectedVault={vaultBinding === key}
                onSelectVault={
                  onSelectVault ? () => onSelectVault(key) : undefined
                }
                value={objectValue(value[key])}
                hint={hints[key]}
                deployments={deployments}
                profiles={profiles}
                providedConnections={providedConnections}
                disabled={disabled}
                onDirtyChange={(dirty) => mark(key, dirty)}
                onSave={(entry) => onSave({ ...value, [key]: entry })}
                onRemove={() => {
                  const next = { ...value };
                  delete next[key];
                  return onSave(next);
                }}
              />
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {!adding ? (
        <button
          className="outline"
          disabled={disabled || dirtyRows.current.size > 0}
          onClick={() => setAdding(true)}
        >
          Добавить подключение
        </button>
      ) : (
        <div className="application-add-parameter">
          <label>
            Имя подключения
            <input
              value={name}
              disabled={disabled}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setName(e.target.value);
                onDirtyChange(!!e.target.value || dirtyRows.current.size > 0);
              }}
            />
          </label>
          <button
            className="outline"
            disabled={
              disabled ||
              !name ||
              names.includes(name) ||
              dirtyRows.current.size > 0
            }
            onClick={() => {
              setAdded((rows) => [...rows, name]);
              setName("");
              setAdding(false);
              onDirtyChange(dirtyRows.current.size > 0);
            }}
          >
            Добавить
          </button>
          <button
            className="outline"
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => {
              setName("");
              setAdding(false);
              onDirtyChange(dirtyRows.current.size > 0);
            }}
          >
            Отмена
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
function BindingRow({
  name,
  isVault,
  selectedVault,
  onSelectVault,
  value,
  hint,
  deployments,
  profiles,
  providedConnections = [],
  disabled,
  onSave,
  onRemove,
  onDirtyChange,
}: {
  name: string;
  isVault: boolean;
  selectedVault: boolean;
  onSelectVault?: () => Promise<boolean>;
  value: Obj;
  hint?: string;
  deployments: string[];
  profiles: string[];
  providedConnections?: string[];
  disabled: boolean;
  onSave: (value: Obj) => Promise<boolean>;
  onRemove: () => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const [kind, setKind] = useState(
    Object.hasOwn(value, "providedConnectionRef")
      ? "providedConnectionRef"
      : Object.hasOwn(value, "profileRef") || hint === "pki"
        ? "profileRef"
        : "deploymentRef",
  );
  const [ref, setRef] = useState(
    value.providedConnectionRef
      ? String(objectValue(value.providedConnectionRef).libraryId) +
          "/" +
          String(objectValue(value.providedConnectionRef).name)
      : String(value.profileRef ?? value.deploymentRef ?? ""),
  );
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const candidates =
    kind === "providedConnectionRef"
      ? providedConnections
      : kind === "profileRef"
        ? profiles
        : deployments;
  return (
    <tr>
      <td>
        <strong>{name}</strong>{" "}
        {selectedVault && (
          <small className="application-vault-badge">Хранилище секретов</small>
        )}
      </td>
      <td>
        <select
          aria-label={"Тип подключения " + name}
          disabled={disabled}
          value={kind}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setKind(e.target.value);
            setRef("");
            setDirty(true);
            onDirtyChange(true);
          }}
        >
          <option value="deploymentRef">Сервис</option>
          <option value="profileRef">TLS-профиль</option>
          <option value="providedConnectionRef">Подключение приложения</option>
        </select>
      </td>
      <td>
        <select
          aria-label={"Подключение " + name}
          disabled={disabled}
          value={ref}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setRef(e.target.value);
            setDirty(true);
            onDirtyChange(true);
          }}
        >
          <option value="">Не выбрано</option>
          {ref && !candidates.includes(ref) && (
            <option value={ref}>{ref} · недоступно в текущем проекте</option>
          )}
          {candidates.map((id) => (
            <option key={id}>{id}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </td>
      <td>
        <div className="row">
          <button
            disabled={disabled || !dirty || !ref}
            onClick={() => {
              const next = { ...value };
              delete next.deploymentRef;
              delete next.profileRef;
              delete next.providedConnectionRef;
              void onSave({
                ...next,
                [kind]:
                  kind === "providedConnectionRef"
                    ? { libraryId: ref.split("/")[0], name: ref.split("/")[1] }
                    : ref,
              }).then((ok) => {
                if (ok) {
                  setDirty(false);
                  onDirtyChange(false);
                }
              });
            }}
          >
            В черновик
          </button>
          <button
            className="outline"
            disabled={disabled || !Object.keys(value).length}
            onClick={() =>
              void onRemove().then((ok) => {
                if (ok) onDirtyChange(false);
              })
            }
          >
            Сбросить
          </button>
          {isVault && !selectedVault && onSelectVault && (
            <button
              className="outline"
              disabled={disabled || dirty}
              onClick={() => void onSelectVault()}
            >
              Для секретов
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </td>
    </tr>
  );
}

import { useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
export function CredentialSourceEditor({
  label,
  source,
  packageSource,
  allowLiteral,
  disabled,
  onSave,
  onReset,
  onDirtyChange,
  compact = false,
  runtimeInput,
  resolvedLiteralValue,
  literalLabel = "Имя пользователя",
}: {
  label: string;
  source: Obj;
  packageSource: Obj;
  allowLiteral: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  onSave: (source: Obj) => Promise<boolean>;
  onReset: () => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
  compact?: boolean;
  runtimeInput?: ReactNode;
  resolvedLiteralValue?: string;
  literalLabel?: string;
}) {
  const initial = Object.keys(source).length ? source : packageSource;
  const [kind, setKind] = useState(
    String(initial.kind ?? "runtime_secret_ref"),
  );
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Obj>({ ...initial });
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [valueFocused, setValueFocused] = useState(false);
  const showResolvedLiteral =
    kind === "literal" &&
    !dirty &&
    !valueFocused &&
    resolvedLiteralValue !== undefined;
  const fields: Record<string, string[]> = {
    generated: [],
    runtime_secret_ref: ["ref"],
    vault_ref: ["binding", "mount", "document", "field"],
    pki_credential: ["binding", "credential"],
    literal: ["value"],
  };
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    ref: "Runtime secret ref · имя ссылки",
    binding: "Binding",
    mount: "Vault mount",
    document: "Vault document",
    field: "Поле секрета",
    credential: "PKI credential",
    value: literalLabel,
  };
  const keys = fields[kind] ?? [];
  const change = () => {
    setDirty(true);
    onDirtyChange(true);
  };
  const finish = (ok: boolean) => {
    if (ok) {
      setDirty(false);
      onDirtyChange(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <fieldset
      className={
        compact
          ? `application-credential-source${keys.length > 1 ? " application-credential-source-expanded" : ""}`
          : undefined
      }
      title={
        compact
          ? `Пакет: ${String(packageSource.kind ?? "Не объявлен")} · ${Object.keys(source).length ? "Явное переопределение" : "Наследуется"}`
          : undefined
      }
    >
      <legend>{label}</legend>
      {!compact && (
        <p>
          Пакет: {String(packageSource.kind ?? "Не объявлен")} ·{" "}
          {Object.keys(source).length ? "Явное переопределение" : "Наследуется"}
        </p>
      )}
      <label>
        <span className={compact ? "application-credential-label" : undefined}>
          Источник
        </span>
        <select
          disabled={disabled}
          value={kind}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setKind(e.target.value);
            setValues(
              e.target.value === "runtime_secret_ref" &&
                runtimeInput !== undefined
                ? {
                    ref:
                      initial.kind === "runtime_secret_ref" && initial.ref
                        ? initial.ref
                        : `application-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
                  }
                : {},
            );
            change();
          }}
        >
          <option value="runtime_secret_ref">Сессионный секрет</option>
          {!allowLiteral && <option value="generated">Генерируемый</option>}
          <option value="vault_ref">Существующий Vault secret</option>
          <option value="pki_credential">PKI credential</option>
          {allowLiteral && <option value="literal">{literalLabel}</option>}
        </select>
      </label>
      {kind === "generated" && (
        <small>
          Создаётся при применении; сохранённый пароль используется повторно.
        </small>
      )}
      {kind === "runtime_secret_ref" && runtimeInput !== undefined ? (
        dirty ? (
          <small>
            Сохраните источник в черновик и проект перед вводом секрета.
          </small>
        ) : (
          runtimeInput
        )
      ) : (
        keys.map((key) => (
          <label key={key}>
            <span
              className={compact ? "application-credential-label" : undefined}
            >
              {labels[key]}
            </span>
            <input
              placeholder={compact ? labels[key] : undefined}
              disabled={disabled}
              value={
                key === "value" && showResolvedLiteral
                  ? resolvedLiteralValue
                  : String(values[key] ?? "")
              }
              title={
                key === "value" && resolvedLiteralValue !== undefined
                  ? `Вычислено Core: ${resolvedLiteralValue}. Для редактирования исходного значения нажмите на поле.`
                  : undefined
              }
              autoComplete="off"
              onFocus={() => {
                if (key === "value") setValueFocused(true);
              }}
              onBlur={() => {
                if (key === "value") setValueFocused(false);
              }}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setValues((v) => ({ ...v, [key]: e.target.value }));
                change();
              }}
            />
          </label>
        ))
      )}
      <div
        className={
          compact
            ? "application-credential-actions"
            : "application-credential-actions-default"
        }
      >
        {(kind !== "runtime_secret_ref" ||
          runtimeInput === undefined ||
          dirty) && (
          <button
            aria-label="В черновик"
            title="В черновик"
            disabled={
              disabled ||
              !dirty ||
              keys.some((k) => !String(values[k] ?? "").trim())
            }
            onClick={() =>
              void onSave({
                kind,
                ...Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k) => [k, values[k]])),
              }).then(finish)
            }
          >
            {compact ? "✓" : "В черновик"}
          </button>
        )}
        <button
          aria-label="Сбросить к default"
          title="Сбросить к default"
          className="outline"
          disabled={disabled || !Object.keys(source).length}
          onClick={() => void onReset().then(finish)}
        >
          {compact ? "↺" : "Сбросить к default"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </fieldset>
  );
}

export function ApplicationCredentials({

  bindings,
  resources = {},
  resolvedResources = {},
  deploymentTypes = {},

  secretSession,

  connectionUsage = {},
  sharedSecretRefs = [],
}: {
  defaults: Obj;
  authored: Obj;
  connections: Obj;
  disabled: boolean;
  onSave: (accounts: Obj) => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
  bindings: Obj;
  resources?: Obj;
  resolvedResources?: Obj;
  deploymentTypes?: Record<string, string>;
  variableBindings?: Obj;

                                              )[field],
                                            ).source,
                                          ).ref ?? "",
                                        )}
                                        shared={sharedSecretRefs.includes(
                                          String(
                                            objectValue(
                                              objectValue(
                                                objectValue(
                                                  objectValue(
                                                    resolvedAccounts[name],
                                                  ).credentials,
                                                )[field],

                                            ).ref ?? "",

                                      />

                                  }
                                  compact

                                  }
                                  source={source}
                                  packageSource={objectValue(

                                  )}
                                  allowLiteral={field === "username"}
                                  disabled={accountDisabled || !account.mode}
                                  onDirtyChange={(dirty) =>
                                    mark(name + field, dirty)
                                  }
                                  onSave={(source) =>
                                    save({

                                      credentials: {

                                  onReset={() => {

                                  }}
                                />
                              </td>

                        })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )}
              {serviceType === "kafka" && (
                <ApplicationKafkaAccess
                  key={name + JSON.stringify(account.grants)}
                  account={account}
                  inherited={packageAccount}
                  resolved={objectValue(resolvedAccounts[name])}
                  resolvedResources={resolvedResources}
                  disabled={accountDisabled || !account.mode}
                  onDirtyChange={(dirty) => mark(name + "acl", dirty)}
                  onSave={(grants) => {
                    const next = { ...account };
                    if (grants === undefined) delete next.grants;
                    else next.grants = grants;
                    return save(next);
                  }}
                />
              )}
              <ApplicationAccountAccess
                key={
                  name +
                  JSON.stringify([account.databaseAccess, account.grants])
                }
                serviceType={serviceType}
                deployment={deployment}
                resources={resources}
                resolvedResources={resolvedResources}
                bindings={bindings}
                account={account}
                inherited={packageAccount}
                disabled={accountDisabled || !account.mode}
                onDirtyChange={(dirty) => mark(name + "access", dirty)}
                onSave={(metadata) => {
                  const next = { ...account };
                  for (const key of ["databaseRef", "grants", "databaseAccess"])
                    delete next[key];
                  return save({ ...next, ...metadata });
                }}
              />
              {serviceType === "redis" && (
                <ApplicationRedisAccess
                  key={name + JSON.stringify(account.grants)}
                  value={objectValue(account.grants ?? packageAccount.grants)}
                  sentinel={
                    objectValue(bindings[binding]).connectionRef === "sentinel"
                  }
                  disabled={accountDisabled || !account.mode}
                  onDirtyChange={(dirty) => mark(name + "acl", dirty)}
                  onSave={(grants) => save({ ...account, grants })}
                />
              )}
            </section>
          );
        })}
    </>
  );
}

  disabled,
  onSave,
  onReset,
  onDirtyChange,
}: {
  authored: unknown;
  defaults: unknown;
  disabled: boolean;
  onSave: (files: Record<string, unknown>[]) => Promise<boolean>;
  onReset: () => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;

    : Array.isArray(defaults)
      ? defaults
      : [];

          delete next.template;

        next[key] = value;
        return next;

    );

              disabled={disabled}
              onChange={(e) =>
                change(
                  i,
                  Object.hasOwn(file, "template") ? "template" : "source",
                  e.target.value,
                )
              }
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Назначение
            <input
              value={String(file.destination ?? "")}
              disabled={disabled}
              onChange={(e) => change(i, "destination", e.target.value)}

              value={name}
              placeholder={hasDefault ? "Из defaults библиотеки" : ""}

            />

          {kind !== "redis.key" && (

              </select>

          {error && <p role="alert">{error}</p>}

            <button type="button" className="outline" onClick={close}>
              Отмена
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

export function ApplicationReadiness({
  value,
  defaults,
  disabled,
  onSave,
  onReset,
  onDirtyChange,
}: {
  value: ObjectValue;
  defaults: ObjectValue;
  disabled: boolean;
  onSave: (value: ObjectValue) => Promise<boolean>;
  onReset: () => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const current = (key: string) =>
    draft[key] ?? String(value[key] ?? defaults[key] ?? "");
  const authored = Object.keys(value).length > 0;
  const dirty = Object.keys(draft).length > 0;
  const valid =
    ["container", "healthcheck"].includes(current("mode")) &&
    [
      ["retries", 60],
      ["delay", 30],
    ].every(([key, max]) => {
      const text = current(String(key));
      return (
        text === "" ||
        (Number.isInteger(Number(text)) &&
          Number(text) >= 1 &&
          Number(text) <= Number(max))
      );
    });
  const change = (key: string, text: string) => {
    setDraft((previous) => ({ ...previous, [key]: text }));
    onDirtyChange(true);
  };
  const origin = (key: string) =>
    Object.hasOwn(draft, key)
      ? "Не сохранено"
      : Object.hasOwn(value, key)
        ? "Переопределено"
        : Object.hasOwn(defaults, key)
          ? "Из пакета"
          : "По умолчанию Core";
  return (
    <section className="application-section application-readiness">
      <div className="row">
        <h3>Проверка готовности</h3>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="application-link"
          disabled={disabled}
          onClick={() => setEditing(true)}
        >
          Изменить readiness
        </button>
        {authored && (
          <button
            className="application-link"
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={async () => {
              if (await onReset()) {
                setDraft({});
                setEditing(false);
                onDirtyChange(false);
              }
            }}
          >
            Сбросить readiness к пакету
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="application-readiness-fields">
        <label>
          Режим проверки
          <select
            aria-label="Режим проверки"
            value={current("mode")}
            disabled={disabled || !editing}
            onChange={(e) => change("mode", e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">По умолчанию Core</option>
            <option value="container">Контейнер запущен</option>
            <option value="healthcheck">Docker healthcheck</option>
          </select>
          <small>{origin("mode")}</small>
        </label>
        {(
          [
            ["retries", "Число попыток", 60],
            ["delay", "Интервал, сек.", 30],
          ] as const
        ).map(([key, label, max]) => (
          <label key={key}>
            {label}
            <input
              aria-label={label}
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={max}
              step={1}
              placeholder="По умолчанию Core"
              value={current(key)}
              disabled={disabled || !editing}
              onChange={(e) => change(key, e.target.value)}
            />
            <small>{origin(key)}</small>
          </label>
        ))}
      </div>
      {current("mode") === "healthcheck" && (
        <p className="muted">
          Docker healthcheck должен быть объявлен в пакете. Успешность проверки
          определяется при выполнении плана.
        </p>
      )}
      {dirty && !valid && (
        <p role="alert">
          Выберите режим; попытки — от 1 до 60, интервал — от 1 до 30 секунд.
        </p>

          <span>{name}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="outline"
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => {
              const next = { ...entries };
              delete next[name];
              onChange(next);
            }}
          >
            Убрать назначение
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}

            inline
            registryOnly
            libraryId={libraryId}
            disabled={runtimeDisabled}
            title="Логин и пароль registry"
            load={load}
            save={save}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </section>

export function ApplicationSecretAvailabilityBadge({
  session,
  sourceRefs,
  resolved,
}: {
  session: Session;
  sourceRefs: string[];
  resolved: boolean;
}) {
  const evidence = session.availability;
  const states = sourceRefs.map((sourceRef) => {
    const matches = evidence?.applicationInputs?.filter(
      (item) =>
        item.purpose === "APPLICATION_SECRET" &&
        item.sourceRef === sourceRef &&
        item.applicationLibraries.includes(session.libraryId),
    );
    return matches?.length === 1
      ? evidence?.applicationSecretAvailability?.[matches[0].requirementRef]
      : undefined;
  });
  const current =
    !session.disabled &&
    resolved &&
    evidence?.status === "READY" &&
    evidence.projectRevision === session.projectRevision;
  const present =
    current && states.length > 0 && states.every((state) => state === true);
  const missing = current && states.some((state) => state === false);
  const unneeded = !session.disabled && resolved && sourceRefs.length === 0;
  return (
    <span
      className={`status-chip status-chip--${present ? "success" : missing ? "warning" : "neutral"}`}
      role="status"
    >
      <span className="status-chip-symbol" aria-hidden="true">
        {present ? "✓" : missing ? "!" : "?"}
      </span>
      {present
        ? "Секрет задан"
        : missing
          ? "Секрет не задан"
          : unneeded
            ? "Сессионный секрет не требуется"
            : "Статус секрета недоступен"}
    </span>
  );
}

function RuntimeSecretField({
  session,
  sourceRef,
  label,
  shared,
}: {
  session: Session;
  sourceRef: string;
  label: string;
  shared: boolean;
}) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const disabled = session.disabled || busy || !sourceRef;
  const submit = async () => {
    if (disabled || !value) return;
    const submitted = value;
    setValue("");
    setMessage("");
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const operation = await session.load();
      const matches = operation.applicationInputs?.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.purpose === "APPLICATION_SECRET" &&
          item.sourceRef === sourceRef &&
          item.applicationLibraries.includes(session.libraryId),
      );
      if (
        operation.status !== "READY" ||
        operation.projectRevision !== session.projectRevision ||
        !operation.descriptorSetFingerprint ||
        matches?.length !== 1
      )
        throw new Error("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTOR_UNAVAILABLE");
      const requirementRef = matches[0].requirementRef;
      await session.save({
        projectRevision: operation.projectRevision,
        descriptorSetFingerprint: operation.descriptorSetFingerprint,
        serviceDeployment: "",
        applicationLibrary: session.libraryId,
        applicationRequirementRef: requirementRef,
        values: { [requirementRef]: submitted },
      });
      setMessage("Секрет отправлен в сессию");
    } catch {
      setMessage(
        "Не удалось сохранить секрет; проверьте актуальность проекта и runtime-сессии",
      );
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="application-runtime-secret">
      <div className="application-runtime-secret-entry">
        <label>
          <span className="application-credential-label">{label}</span>
          <input
            type="password"
            aria-label={label}
            autoComplete="new-password"
            placeholder="Введите секрет"
            value={value}
            disabled={disabled}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setValue(event.target.value);
              setMessage("");
            }}
          />
        </label>
        <button
          type="button"
          title="Сохранить в сессии"
          aria-label={`Сохранить в сессии: ${label}`}
          disabled={disabled || !value}
          onClick={() => void submit()}
        >
          ✓
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="outline"
          title="Очистить ввод"
          aria-label={`Очистить ввод: ${label}`}
          disabled={busy || !value}
          onClick={() => {
            setValue("");
            setMessage("");
          }}
        >
          ×
        </button>
      </div>
      {shared && (
        <small title="Один секрет используется несколькими ресурсами; замена действует на всех потребителей.">
          <span className="application-credential-label">
            Один секрет используется несколькими ресурсами; замена действует на
            всех потребителей.
          </span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">ⓘ</span>
        </small>
      )}
      {message && (
        <small role="status" title={message}>
          <span className="application-credential-label">{message}</span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">ⓘ</span>
        </small>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
