function CredentialVariableNames({
  label,
  inherited,
  aliases,
  names,
  disabled,
  explicit,
  onDirtyChange,
  onSave,
  onReset,
}: {
  label: string;
  inherited: string[];
  aliases: string[];
  names: string[];
  disabled: boolean;
  explicit: boolean;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
  onSave: (names: string[]) => Promise<boolean>;
  onReset: () => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState(aliases.join(", "));
  const next = text
    .split(",")
    .map((v) => v.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
  const valid =
    next.every(
      (v) =>
        /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(v) &&
        (!names.includes(v) || aliases.includes(v)),
    ) && new Set(next).size === next.length;
  const finish = (ok: boolean) => {
    if (ok) {
      onDirtyChange(false);
      setEditing(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="application-credential-variables">
      <span
        className="application-credential-variable-names"
        title={[...inherited, ...(!editing ? aliases : [])].join(", ")}
      >
        {inherited.map((name) => (
          <code key={name} title={`Из пакета: ${name}`}>
            {name}
          </code>
        ))}
        {!editing && aliases.map((name) => <code key={name}>{name}</code>)}
      </span>
      {editing ? (
        <>
          <input
            aria-label={`Переменные ${label}`}
            placeholder="Дополнительные имена, через запятую"
            value={text}
            disabled={disabled}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setText(e.target.value);
              onDirtyChange(true);
            }}
          />
          <button
            title="В черновик"
            aria-label={`Сохранить переменные ${label}`}
            disabled={disabled || !valid}
            onClick={() => void onSave(next).then(finish)}
          >
            ✓
          </button>
        </>
      ) : (
        <button
          className="outline"
          title="Переопределить переменные; пакетные имена сохраняются"
          aria-label={`Переопределить переменные ${label}`}
          disabled={disabled}
          onClick={() => setEditing(true)}
        >
          ✎
        </button>
      )}
      <button
        className="outline"
        title="Сбросить переменные к default"
        aria-label={`Сбросить переменные ${label} к default`}
        disabled={disabled || !explicit}
        onClick={() => void onReset().then(finish)}
      >
        ↺
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
function BindingRow({
  variable,
  current,
  packageSource,
  explicit,
  disabled,
  sources,
  onSave,
  onReset,
  onDirtyChange,
}: {
  variable: string;
  current: string;
  packageSource: string;
  explicit: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  sources: { key: string; account: string; field: string }[];
  onSave: (key: string) => Promise<boolean>;
  onReset: () => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(explicit),
    [source, setSource] = useState(current),
    [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const finish = (ok: boolean) => {
    if (ok) {
      setDirty(false);
      onDirtyChange(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>{variable}</legend>
      <p>
        Пакет: {packageSource.replace(":", " · ") || "Не объявлена"} ·{" "}
        {explicit ? "Переопределено" : "Из пакета"}
      </p>
      <label>
        Источник {variable}
        <select
          aria-label={`Источник ${variable}`}
          value={source}
          disabled={disabled || !editing}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setSource(e.target.value);
            setDirty(true);

              {item.account} · {item.field}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      <div className="row">
        <button
          className="outline"
          disabled={disabled || editing}
          onClick={() => setEditing(true)}
        >
          Переопределить {variable}
        </button>
        <button
          disabled={
            disabled || !dirty || !sources.some((item) => item.key === source)
          }
          onClick={() => void onSave(source).then(finish)}
        >
          В черновик
        </button>
        <button
          className="outline"
          disabled={disabled || !explicit}
          onClick={() => void onReset().then(finish)}
        >
          Сбросить {variable} к default
        </button>
      </div>
    </fieldset>
  );
}

export function ApplicationSecretInputs({

  save,

  title = "Секреты библиотек",
  registryOnly = false,
}: {
  disabled: boolean;

  title?: string;

          serviceDeployment: "",
          ...(libraryId ? { applicationLibrary: libraryId } : {}),
          values,
        })
          .then(() => {
            close();
            setMessage("Секреты сохранены только в сессии");
          })
          .catch(() => {
            setValues({});
            setMessage(

          .finally(() => setBusy(false));

      <p className="muted">
        {registryOnly
          ? "Логин и пароль остаются только в runtime-сессии и применяются на целевых серверах."
          : "Значения остаются только в памяти и передаются через runtime lease для одобренного плана."}
      </p>
      {operation?.applicationInputs?.map((item) => (
        <label key={item.requirementRef}>
          <span>{item.displayLabel}</span>
          {inline && (
            <small>
              Источник: {item.sourceRef} ·{" "}
              {registryOnly
                ? "Registry"
                : (item.providerDeployment ?? "Приложение")}
            </small>
          )}
          <input
            aria-label={item.displayLabel}
            type={
              item.purpose === "APPLICATION_REGISTRY_USERNAME"
                ? "text"
                : "password"
            }
            autoComplete="new-password"
            required
            disabled={disabled || busy}
            value={values[item.requirementRef] || ""}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setValues((current) => ({
                ...current,
                [item.requirementRef]: event.target.value,
              }))
            }
          />
        </label>
      ))}
      <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={close}>
        Отмена
      </button>
      <button type="submit" disabled={disabled || busy}>
        Сохранить в сессии
      </button>
    </form>
  );
  return (
    <section className="card">
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled || busy}
        onClick={() => void open()}
      >
        {title}
      </button>
      {message && <p role="status">{message}</p>}
      {inline ? (
        operation && <div className="application-inline-secrets">{form}</div>
      ) : (
        <dialog
          ref={dialog}
          className="runtime-secret-dialog"
          aria-label={title}
          onCancel={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            close();
          }}
        >
          {form}{" "}
        </dialog>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import { useRef, useState } from "react";

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
// Small authored key/value control for concrete parameter/environment sections.
// It edits JSON-shaped data; it never evaluates schema rules or Ansible values.
export function ApplicationValueFields({
  label,
  value,
  defaults,
  disabled,
  onSave,
  onDirtyChange,
  excludeKeys = [],
  hiddenKeys = [],
  defaultLabel = "Из пакета · без вычисления Ansible",
  compact = false,
  addControl,
  resolvedValues = {},
}: {
  label: string;
  value: Obj;
  defaults: Obj;
  disabled: boolean;
  onSave: (value: Obj) => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
  excludeKeys?: string[];
  hiddenKeys?: string[];
  defaultLabel?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
  addControl?: { adding: boolean; setAdding: (adding: boolean) => void };
  resolvedValues?: Obj;
}) {
  const dirtyFields = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const mark = (key: string, dirty: boolean) => {
    if (dirty) dirtyFields.current.add(key);
    else dirtyFields.current.delete(key);
    onDirtyChange(dirtyFields.current.size > 0);
  };
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [localAdding, setLocalAdding] = useState(false);
  const adding = addControl?.adding ?? localAdding;
  const setAdding = addControl?.setAdding ?? setLocalAdding;
  const keys = Object.keys({ ...defaults, ...value, ...resolvedValues }).filter(
    (key) => !hiddenKeys.includes(key),
  );
  return (
    <section className={compact ? "application-compact-values" : undefined}>
      <h3>{label}</h3>
      {compact && keys.length > 0 && (
        <div className="application-value-heading" aria-hidden="true">
          <div>
            <span>Имя</span>
            <span>Значение</span>
          </div>
          <span>Действия</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {keys.map((key) => {
        const inherited = defaults[key],
          authored = value[key];
        const current = authored ?? inherited;
        const reset = () => {
          const next = { ...value };
          delete next[key];
          return onSave(next);
        };
        if (current && typeof current === "object" && !Array.isArray(current))
          return (
            <fieldset key={key}>
              <legend>{key}</legend>
              <ApplicationValueFields
                label={key}
                compact={compact}
                value={objectValue(authored)}
                defaults={objectValue(inherited)}
                defaultLabel={defaultLabel}
                disabled={disabled}
                onSave={(next) => onSave({ ...value, [key]: next })}
                onDirtyChange={(dirty) => mark(key, dirty)}
              />
              <button
                className="outline"
                disabled={disabled || !Object.hasOwn(value, key)}
                onClick={() => void reset()}
              >
                Сбросить {key}
              </button>
            </fieldset>
          );
        if (Array.isArray(current))
          return (
            <div key={key}>
              <strong>{key}</strong>
              <ApplicationArrayFields
                label={key}
                compact={compact}
                value={current}
                disabled={disabled}
                onDirtyChange={(dirty) => mark(key, dirty)}
                onSave={(rows) => onSave({ ...value, [key]: rows })}
              />
              <button
                className="outline"
                disabled={disabled || !Object.hasOwn(value, key)}
                onClick={() => void reset()}
              >
                Сбросить {key}
              </button>
            </div>
          );
        return (
          <ScalarValue
            compact={compact}
            key={key + JSON.stringify(current)}
            label={key}
            value={current}
            resolvedValue={resolvedValues[key]}
            defaultValue={inherited}
            inferType={inherited === undefined && current === ""}
            explicit={Object.hasOwn(value, key)}
            defaultLabel={defaultLabel}
            disabled={disabled}
            onDirtyChange={(dirty) => mark(key, dirty)}
            onSave={(next) => onSave({ ...value, [key]: next })}
            onReset={reset}
          />
        );
      })}
      {!adding ? (
        !addControl && (
          <button
            className="outline"
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => setAdding(true)}
          >
            Добавить параметр · {label}

        <form
          className="application-add-parameter"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (
              !name ||
              keys.includes(name) ||
              excludeKeys.includes(name) ||
              hiddenKeys.includes(name)
            )
              return;
            void onSave({ ...value, [name]: "" }).then((ok) => {
              if (ok) {
                setName("");
                setAdding(false);
                mark("__add", false);
              }
            });
          }}
        >
          <label>
            Имя параметра
            <input
              value={name}
              disabled={disabled}
              autoFocus
              onChange={(e) => {
                setName(e.target.value);
                mark("__add", true);
              }}
            />
          </label>
          <button
            disabled={
              disabled ||
              !name ||
              keys.includes(name) ||
              excludeKeys.includes(name) ||
              hiddenKeys.includes(name)
            }
          >
            Добавить
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="outline"
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => {
              setName("");
              setAdding(false);
              mark("__add", false);
            }}
          >
            Отмена
          </button>
          <small>Значение задаётся в строке параметра после добавления.</small>

export function ApplicationArrayFields({
  label,
  value,
  disabled,
  onSave,
  onDirtyChange,
  compact = false,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: unknown[];
  disabled: boolean;
  onSave: (value: unknown[]) => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
  compact?: boolean;
}) {
  const dirtyRows = useRef(new Set<number>());
  const mark = (index: number, dirty: boolean) => {
    if (dirty) dirtyRows.current.add(index);
    else dirtyRows.current.delete(index);
    onDirtyChange(dirtyRows.current.size > 0);
  };
  return (
    <section>
      <p>Изменение заменяет список {label} целиком.</p>
      {value.map((row, index) => (

          </legend>
          {row && typeof row === "object" && !Array.isArray(row) ? (
            <ApplicationValueFields
              label={label}
              compact={compact}
              value={objectValue(row)}
              defaults={{}}
              disabled={disabled}
              onDirtyChange={(dirty) => mark(index, dirty)}
              onSave={(next) =>
                onSave(value.map((v, i) => (i === index ? next : v)))
              }
            />
          ) : Array.isArray(row) ? (
            <ApplicationArrayFields
              label={label}
              compact={compact}
              value={row}
              disabled={disabled}
              onDirtyChange={(dirty) => mark(index, dirty)}
              onSave={(next) =>
                onSave(value.map((v, i) => (i === index ? next : v)))
              }
            />
          ) : (
            <ScalarValue
              label={label}
              compact={compact}
              value={row}
              explicit={true}
              disabled={disabled}
              onDirtyChange={(dirty) => mark(index, dirty)}
              onSave={(next) =>
                onSave(value.map((v, i) => (i === index ? next : v)))
              }
              onReset={() => onSave(value.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}
            />
          )}
          <button
            className="outline"
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => void onSave(value.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}
          >
            Убрать элемент
          </button>
        </fieldset>
      ))}
      <button
        className="outline"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => void onSave([...value, ""])}
      >
        Добавить строку
      </button>
      <button
        className="outline"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => void onSave([...value, {}])}

function ScalarValue({
  label,
  value,
  explicit,
  disabled,
  onSave,
  onReset,
  onDirtyChange,
  inferType = false,
  defaultLabel = "Из пакета · без вычисления Ansible",
  compact = false,
  resolvedValue,
  defaultValue,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: unknown;
  explicit: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  onSave: (value: unknown) => Promise<boolean>;
  onReset: () => Promise<boolean>;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
  inferType?: boolean;
  defaultLabel?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
  resolvedValue?: unknown;
  defaultValue?: unknown;
}) {
  const [text, setText] = useState(String(value ?? ""));
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const showResolved =
    compact &&
    !focused &&
    !dirty &&
    ["string", "number", "boolean"].includes(typeof resolvedValue);
  const [manualType, setManualType] = useState("auto");
  const inferred = inferParameterValue(text);
  const originalType = typeof value;
  const type = compact
    ? typeof inferred
    : manualType !== "auto"
      ? manualType
      : inferType
        ? typeof inferred
        : originalType;
  const parsed =
    type === "number"
      ? Number(text)
      : type === "boolean"
        ? text === "true"
        : text;
  const valid =
    type === "number"
      ? text.trim() !== "" && Number.isFinite(Number(text))
      : type === "boolean"
        ? ["true", "false"].includes(text)
        : true;
  const typeLabel =
    type === "number" ? "Число" : type === "boolean" ? "Логическое" : "Строка";
  const saveValue = () =>
    void onSave(parsed).then((ok) => {
      if (ok) {
        setDirty(false);
        onDirtyChange(false);
      }
    });
  const resetValue = () =>
    void onReset().then((ok) => {
      if (ok) {
        setDirty(false);
        onDirtyChange(false);
      }
    });
  if (compact)
    return (
      <div className="application-value-row">
        <label
          className="application-value-key"
          title={`${label}${defaultValue === undefined ? "" : ` · Default: ${String(defaultValue)}`}`}
        >
          <span>{label}</span>
          <input
            aria-label={label}
            value={showResolved ? String(resolvedValue) : text}
            disabled={disabled}
            title={`${showResolved ? "Текущий расчёт Core · " : ""}Тип ввода: ${typeLabel} · автоматически · ${explicit ? "Явное значение" : defaultLabel}${defaultValue === undefined ? "" : ` · Default: ${String(defaultValue)}`}`}
            onFocus={() => setFocused(true)}
            onBlur={() => setFocused(false)}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setText(event.target.value);
              setDirty(true);
              onDirtyChange(true);
            }}
          />
        </label>
        <button disabled={disabled || !dirty || !valid} onClick={saveValue}>
          В черновик
        </button>
        <button
          className="outline"
          disabled={disabled || !explicit}
          onClick={resetValue}
        >
          Сбросить к default
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <div className="application-field">
      <label>
        {label}
        <input
          value={text}
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setText(e.target.value);
            setDirty(true);
            onDirtyChange(true);
          }}
        />
      </label>
      <small>
        Тип: {typeLabel}
        {manualType === "auto" ? " · автоматически" : " · задан вручную"}
      </small>
      <details className="application-parameter-type">
        <summary>Дополнительно</summary>
        <label>
          Тип · {label}
          <select
            value={manualType}
            disabled={disabled}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setManualType(e.target.value);
              setDirty(true);
              onDirtyChange(true);
            }}
          >
            <option value="auto">Автоматически</option>
            <option value="string">Строка</option>
            <option value="number">Число</option>
            <option value="boolean">Логическое</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <div className="row">
          {[
            { title: "Создать объект", value: {} },
            { title: "Создать список", value: [] },
          ].map((choice) => (
            <button
              key={choice.title}
              className="outline"
              disabled={disabled}
              onClick={() => {
                if (
                  text &&
                  !window.confirm("Заменить текущее значение структурой?")
                )
                  return;
                void onSave(choice.value).then((ok) => {
                  if (ok) onDirtyChange(false);
                });
              }}
            >
              {choice.title}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </details>
      {!valid && (
        <small role="alert">Значение не соответствует типу {typeLabel}.</small>
      )}
      <small>{explicit ? "Явное значение" : defaultLabel}</small>
      <div className="row">
        <button disabled={disabled || !dirty || !valid} onClick={saveValue}>
          В черновик
        </button>
        <button
          className="outline"
          disabled={disabled || !explicit}
          onClick={resetValue}
        >
          Сбросить к default
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// UI input conversion only; package validation and Ansible resolution stay in Core.
export function inferParameterValue(text: string): string | number | boolean {
  if (text === "true" || text === "false") return text === "true";
  if (
    /^-?(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(text) &&
    Number.isFinite(Number(text)) &&
    Math.abs(Number(text)) <= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  )
    return Number(text);
  return text;
}

    replacement: ApplicationIntent | null,
  ) => Promise<boolean>;
  onReview: () => void;
  onInstallation: () => void;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const { libraries, placements } = applicationDraft(managed, intents);
  const packages = objectValue(managed?.applicationPackages);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState("");
  const [slot, setSlot] = useState("");
  const [hostOverrides, setHostOverrides] = useState("");
  const [hostSettingsOpen, setHostSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("Общее");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [formEpoch, setFormEpoch] = useState(0);
  const [addingEnvironment, setAddingEnvironment] = useState(false);
  const [create, setCreate] = useState(false);
  const [id, setId] = useState("");
  const [ref, setRef] = useState("");
  const [runtime, setRuntime] = useState("");
  const runtimeOptions = Object.entries(managed?.deployments ?? {})
    .filter(([, row]) => row.serviceType === "docker")
    .map(([key]) => key);
  const selectedRuntime =
    runtime || (runtimeOptions.length === 1 ? runtimeOptions[0] : "");
  const [local, setLocal] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  // One public descriptor query per saved revision and execution context.
  // A fresh query intentionally invalidates attached service inputs on the backend.
  const secretDescriptors = useRef<
    { context: string; operation: RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation } | undefined
  >(undefined);
  const descriptorContext = JSON.stringify([
    managed?.projectRevision,
    executionContextKey,
  ]);
  const secretScope = JSON.stringify([
    selected,
    slot,
    managed?.projectRevision,
    executionContextKey,
  ]);
  const [secretAvailability, setSecretAvailability] = useState<{
    value: RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation;
    snapshot: OpenResult["snapshot"];
    scope: string;
  }>();
  const availabilityGeneration = useRef(0);
  const availabilityQueue = useRef<Promise<void>>(Promise.resolve());
  const secretDescriptorLoad = useRef<
    | {
        context: string;
        promise: Promise<RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation>;
      }
    | undefined
  >(undefined);
  const loadApplicationSecrets = useCallback(async () => {
    if (
      secretDescriptors.current &&
      secretDescriptors.current.context === descriptorContext
    )
      return secretDescriptors.current.operation;
    const revision = managed?.projectRevision ?? "";
    if (secretDescriptorLoad.current?.context === descriptorContext)
      return secretDescriptorLoad.current.promise;
    const promise = loadSecrets!()
      .then((result) => {
        if (secretDescriptorLoad.current?.promise === promise) {
          secretDescriptors.current =
            result.status === "READY" && result.projectRevision === revision
              ? { context: descriptorContext, operation: result }
              : undefined;
        }
        return result;
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (secretDescriptorLoad.current?.promise === promise)
          secretDescriptorLoad.current = undefined;
      });
    secretDescriptorLoad.current = { context: descriptorContext, promise };
    return promise;
  }, [loadSecrets, managed?.projectRevision, descriptorContext]);
  const refreshSecretAvailability = useCallback(() => {
    const generation = ++availabilityGeneration.current;
    const request = availabilityQueue.current
      .catch(() => {})
      .then(async () => {
        if (generation !== availabilityGeneration.current) return;
        try {
          const cached = secretDescriptors.current;
          const descriptors =
            cached?.context === descriptorContext
              ? cached.operation
              : undefined;
          const result = await loadSecretAvailability!();
          if (generation !== availabilityGeneration.current) return;
          setSecretAvailability(
            result.status === "READY" &&
              result.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision &&
              descriptors?.status === "READY" &&
              result.descriptorSetFingerprint ===
                descriptors.descriptorSetFingerprint
              ? {
                  value: {
                    ...descriptors,
                    applicationSecretAvailability:
                      result.applicationSecretAvailability,
                  },
                  snapshot,
                  scope: secretScope,
                }
              : undefined,
          );
        } catch {
          if (generation === availabilityGeneration.current)
            setSecretAvailability(undefined);
        }
      });
    availabilityQueue.current = request;
    return request;
  }, [
    loadSecretAvailability,
    managed?.projectRevision,
    snapshot,
    secretScope,
    descriptorContext,
  ]);
  const saveApplicationSecrets = async (input: RuntimeSecretValuesInput) => {
    ++availabilityGeneration.current;
    setSecretAvailability(undefined);
    try {
      await saveSecrets!(input);
      if (loadSecretAvailability) await refreshSecretAvailability();
    } catch (error) {
      secretDescriptors.current = undefined;
      ++availabilityGeneration.current;
      setSecretAvailability(undefined);
      throw error;
    }
  };
  const childDirtyKeys = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const [childDirty, setChildDirty] = useState(false);
  const dirty = Object.keys(local).length > 0 || childDirty;
  const markChildDirty = (value: boolean, key = "active") => {
    if (value) childDirtyKeys.current.add(key);
    else childDirtyKeys.current.delete(key);
    setChildDirty(childDirtyKeys.current.size > 0);
    onDirtyChange(
      childDirtyKeys.current.size > 0 || Object.keys(local).length > 0,
    );
  };
  const library = libraries[selected] ?? {};
  const packageDefinition = (kind: string, reference: unknown) =>
    objectValue(
      objectValue(packages[kind + ":" + String(reference)]).definition,
    );
  const definition = packageDefinition("library", library.libraryRef);
  const declaredConnections = (value: unknown): ObjectValue =>
    Array.isArray(value)
      ? Object.fromEntries(
          value.map((key) => [
            String(key),
            objectValue(objectValue(definition.connections)[String(key)]),
          ]),
        )
      : objectValue(value);
  const recipe = objectValue(definition.slots);
  const bindingHints: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const raw of Object.values(recipe)) {
    const def = packageDefinition(
      "application",
      objectValue(raw).applicationRef,
    );
    for (const connection of Object.values(
      declaredConnections(def.connections),
    )) {
      const name = objectValue(connection).library_binding;
      if (typeof name === "string") bindingHints[name] = "deployment";
    }
  }
  for (const raw of Object.values(objectValue(definition.shared_secrets))) {
    const source = objectValue(objectValue(raw).source);
    if (source.kind === "pki_credential" && typeof source.binding === "string")
      bindingHints[source.binding] = "pki";
  }
  const slotDefinition = objectValue(recipe[slot]);
  const appDefinition = packageDefinition(
    "application",
    slotDefinition.applicationRef,
  );
  const appConnections = declaredConnections(appDefinition.connections);
  const defaults = objectValue(appDefinition.defaults);
  const authored = objectValue(objectValue(library.applications)[slot]);
  const overrides = objectValue(authored.overrides);
  const change = (key: string, value: string) => {
    setLocal((v) => ({ ...v, [key]: value }));
    onDirtyChange(true);
  };
  const clearLocal = () => {
    setAddingEnvironment(false);
    setLocal({});
    setEditing(new Set());
    setChildDirty(false);
    childDirtyKeys.current.clear();
    setFormEpoch((v) => v + 1);
    onDirtyChange(false);
  };
  const navigate = (next: () => void) => {
    if (
      dirty &&
      !window.confirm(
        "Отбросить несохранённый ввод формы? Изменения, уже добавленные в черновик проекта, сохранятся.",
      )
    )
      return;
    clearLocal();
    setError("");
    next();
  };
  const send = async (c: ApplicationIntent) => {
    const pendingCreate =
      c.operation === "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment"
        ? intents.find(
            (p) =>
              p.deploymentId === c.deploymentId &&
              p.operation === "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment",
          )
        : undefined;
    const previous =
      pendingCreate ??
      [...intents]
        .reverse()
        .find(
          (p) =>
            p.deploymentId === c.deploymentId &&
            p.entityId === c.entityId &&
            p.hostId === c.hostId &&
            p.setting === c.setting &&
            p.property === c.property &&
            p.operation.replace(/^(Set|Remove)/, "") ===
              c.operation.replace(/^(Set|Remove)/, ""),
        );
    try {
      if (
        previous &&
        c.entity &&
        (c.operation === "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment" ||
          c.operation === "SetApplicationLibrarySlot")
      )
        c = { ...c, entity: { ...previous.entity, ...c.entity } };
      if (pendingCreate)
        c = { ...c, operation: "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment" };
      const ok = previous ? await onAmend(previous, c) : await onAppend(c);
      if (ok) {
        setError("");
      }
      return ok;
    } catch {
      setError(
        "Не удалось добавить изменение. Проверьте состояние черновика и повторите.",
      );
      return false;
    }
  };
  const override = (
    setting: string,
    value: unknown,
    property?: string,
  ): ApplicationIntent => ({
    operation: "SetApplicationLibraryOverride",
    deploymentId: selected,
    entityId: slot,
    setting,
    ...(property ? { property } : {}),
    value,
  });
  const remove = (setting: string, property?: string): ApplicationIntent => ({
    operation: "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride",
    deploymentId: selected,
    entityId: slot,
    setting,
    ...(property ? { property } : {}),
  });
  const clearField = (key: string, ok: boolean) => {
    if (!ok) return;
    const next = { ...local };
    delete next[key];
    setLocal(next);
    onDirtyChange(childDirty || Object.keys(next).length > 0);
  };
  const scalar = (
    key: string,
    label: string,
    defaultValue: unknown,
    authoredValue: unknown,
    save: (v: string) => Promise<boolean>,
    reset?: () => Promise<boolean>,
    type = "text",
  ) => (
    <div
      className={
        "application-field" +
        (key === "image" ? " application-image-field" : "")
      }
      key={key}
    >
      <div className="application-field-origin">
        <span>
          {authoredValue === undefined
            ? defaultValue === undefined
              ? "Не задано в пакете"
              : "Из пакета"
            : "Переопределено"}
        </span>
        <button
          className="application-link"
          type="button"
          disabled={busy}
          aria-label={`Переопределить: ${label}`}
          onClick={() => setEditing((current) => new Set(current).add(key))}
        >
          Переопределить
        </button>
      </div>
      <label>
        {label}
        {type === "multiline" ? (
          <textarea
            value={local[key] ?? String(authoredValue ?? defaultValue ?? "")}
            disabled={
              busy || (authoredValue === undefined && !editing.has(key))
            }
            onChange={(e) => change(key, e.target.value)}
          />
        ) : (
          <input
            type={type}
            placeholder={
              key.startsWith("port:") && defaultValue === undefined
                ? "См. источники портов"
                : undefined
            }
            min={type === "number" ? 1 : undefined}
            max={type === "number" ? 65535 : undefined}
            value={local[key] ?? String(authoredValue ?? defaultValue ?? "")}
            onChange={(e) => change(key, e.target.value)}
            disabled={
              busy || (authoredValue === undefined && !editing.has(key))
            }
          />
        )}
      </label>
      <small>
        {authoredValue !== undefined
          ? "Переопределено в экземпляре"
          : "Значение пакета · без вычисления Ansible"}
      </small>
      <div className="row">
        <button
          hidden={key === "image" && local[key] === undefined}
          disabled={
            busy ||
            local[key] === undefined ||
            (type === "number" &&
              (!Number.isInteger(Number(local[key])) ||
                Number(local[key]) < 1 ||
                Number(local[key]) > 65535))
          }
          onClick={() =>
            void save(local[key]).then((ok) => clearField(key, ok))
          }
        >
          В черновик
        </button>
        {reset && (
          <button
            className="outline"
            hidden={key === "image" && authoredValue === undefined}
            disabled={busy || authoredValue === undefined}
            onClick={() =>
              void reset().then((ok) => {
                clearField(key, ok);
                if (ok)
                  setEditing((current) => {
                    const next = new Set(current);
                    next.delete(key);
                    return next;
                  });
              })
            }
          >
            Сбросить к default
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
  const tabs = slot
    ? ["Основное", "Секреты", "Файлы", "Запуск", "Состояние"]
    : ["Общее", "Общие параметры", "Подключения", "Ресурсы и секреты"];
  const selectedTab = tabs.includes(tab) ? tab : tabs[0];
  const resolved = snapshot?.applicationLibraries?.libraries?.[selected];
  const freshSecrets =
    !busy &&
    !draftActive &&
    !dirty &&
    intents.length === 0 &&
    snapshot?.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision;
  const secretContext = JSON.stringify([
    selected,
    slot,
    managed?.projectRevision,
    freshSecrets,
  ]);
  useEffect(() => {
    ++availabilityGeneration.current;
    if (
      !["Секреты", "Подключения", "Ресурсы и секреты"].includes(selectedTab) ||
      !freshSecrets ||
      !loadSecrets ||
      !loadSecretAvailability
    )
      return;
    let active = true;
    let pending = false;
    const refresh = async () => {
      if (!active || pending) return;
      pending = true;
      try {
        await refreshSecretAvailability();
      } finally {
        pending = false;
      }
    };
    // Descriptor discovery is an explicit context-entry operation, never a poll.
    void loadApplicationSecrets()
      .then(() => {
        if (active) void refresh();
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active) setSecretAvailability(undefined);
      });
    const interval = window.setInterval(() => void refresh(), 10000);
    window.addEventListener("focus", refresh);
    return () => {
      active = false;
      ++availabilityGeneration.current;
      window.clearInterval(interval);
      window.removeEventListener("focus", refresh);
    };
  }, [
    secretContext,
    slot,
    selectedTab,
    freshSecrets,
    loadSecrets,
    loadSecretAvailability,
    loadApplicationSecrets,
    refreshSecretAvailability,
  ]);
  const resolvedSecretAccounts = freshSecrets
    ? objectValue(
        Object.values(resolved?.instances ?? {}).find(
          (instance) => instance.slotId === slot,
        )?.credentialRequirements,
      )
    : {};
  const librarySecretSession: ApplicationSecretSession | undefined =
    loadSecrets && saveSecrets
      ? {
          projectRevision: managed?.projectRevision ?? "",
          contextKey: executionContextKey,
          libraryId: selected,
          disabled: busy || !freshSecrets,
          load: loadApplicationSecrets,
          save: saveApplicationSecrets,
        }
      : undefined;
  const secretRefCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const resolvedLibrary of Object.values(
    snapshot?.applicationLibraries?.libraries ?? {},
  )) {
    for (const secret of Object.values(
      objectValue(resolvedLibrary.sharedSecretRequirements),
    )) {
      const source = objectValue(objectValue(secret).source);
      if (
        source.kind === "runtime_secret_ref" &&
        typeof source.ref === "string"
      )
        secretRefCounts[source.ref] = (secretRefCounts[source.ref] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    for (const instance of Object.values(resolvedLibrary.instances ?? {})) {
      for (const account of Object.values(
        objectValue(instance.credentialRequirements),
      )) {
        for (const credential of Object.values(
          objectValue(objectValue(account).credentials),
        )) {
          const source = objectValue(objectValue(credential).source);
          if (
            source.kind === "runtime_secret_ref" &&
            typeof source.ref === "string"
          )
            secretRefCounts[source.ref] =
              (secretRefCounts[source.ref] ?? 0) + 1;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  const resolvedTopics =
    !draftActive && snapshot?.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision
      ? objectValue(resolved?.topics)
      : {};
  const resolvedResources =
    !draftActive && snapshot?.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision
      ? objectValue(resolved?.resources)
      : {};
  const [baselineHost, setBaselineHost] = useState("");
  const instancePlacements =
    Object.values(resolved?.instances ?? {}).find(
      (instance) => instance.slotId === slot,
    )?.placements ?? {};
  const hosts = Object.keys(instancePlacements);
  const selectedBaselineHost = hosts.includes(baselineHost)
    ? baselineHost
    : hosts[0];
  const inherited = objectValue(
    objectValue(instancePlacements[selectedBaselineHost]).inherited,
  );
  const commonActive =
    slotDefinition.inherit_defaults !== false &&
    (Object.keys(objectValue(definition.defaults)).length > 0 ||
      Object.keys(objectValue(library.overrides)).length > 0);
  const freshBaseline =
    snapshot?.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision &&
    !draftActive &&
    intents.length === 0 &&
    Object.keys(inherited).length > 0;
  const startupDefaults = freshBaseline
    ? inherited
    : commonActive
      ? {}
      : defaults;
  const portSources: PortSource[] = [
    { label: "Пакет приложения", ports: objectValue(defaults.ports) },
    {
      label: "Пакет библиотеки · " + slot,
      ports: objectValue(objectValue(slotDefinition.overrides).ports),
    },
    { label: "Экземпляр", ports: objectValue(overrides.ports) },
    ...Object.entries(placements)
      .filter(([, members]) => Object.hasOwn(members, selected))
      .map(([host, members]) => ({
        label: "Размещение · " + host,
        ports: objectValue(
          objectValue(objectValue(members[selected]).overrides).ports,
        ),
      })),
    ...Object.entries(resolved?.instances ?? {})
      .filter(([, instance]) => instance.slotId === slot)
      .flatMap(([, instance]) =>
        Object.entries(instance.placements ?? {}).map(([host, placement]) => ({
          label:
            "Core · " +
            host +
            " · " +
            (snapshot?.projectRevision ?? "последняя проверка"),
          ports: objectValue(placement.ports),
        })),
      ),
  ];
  return (
    <section className="applications-page">
      <header className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <h1>Приложения</h1>
          <p>Пакеты, настройки экземпляров и подключения к сервисам</p>
        </div>
        <button className="outline" onClick={() => navigate(onInstallation)}>
          К плану установки
        </button>
      </header>
      {(error || backendError) && <p role="alert">{error || backendError}</p>}
      <div className="applications-layout">
        <aside className="application-list">
          <label>
            Поиск
            <input value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} />
          </label>
          <button
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() =>
              navigate(() => {
                setCreate(true);
                setSelected("");
                setSlot("");
              })
            }
          >
            Добавить библиотеку
          </button>
          <ApplicationPackageImport
            disabled={busy || draftActive || dirty}
            choose={choosePackage}
            review={onImport}
          />
          {Object.keys(libraries).length === 0 && (
            <p>Библиотеки ещё не добавлены.</p>
          )}
          {Object.entries(libraries)
            .filter(([key, row]) =>
              [
                key,
                String(row.libraryRef),
                ...Object.keys({
                  ...objectValue(
                    packageDefinition("library", row.libraryRef).slots,
                  ),
                  ...objectValue(row.applications),
                }),
              ]
                .join(" ")
                .toLocaleLowerCase()
                .includes(search.toLocaleLowerCase()),
            )
            .map(([key, row]) => (
              <div className="application-group" key={key}>
                <button
                  className="outline"
                  aria-current={selected === key && !slot ? "true" : undefined}
                  onClick={() =>
                    navigate(() => {
                      setSelected(key);
                      setSlot("");
                      setCreate(false);
                    })
                  }
                >
                  <strong>{key}</strong>
                  <small>{String(row.libraryRef)}</small>
                </button>
                {Object.keys({
                  ...objectValue(
                    packageDefinition("library", row.libraryRef).slots,
                  ),
                  ...objectValue(row.applications),
                }).map((name) => (
                  <button
                    className="outline application-slot"
                    key={name}
                    aria-current={
                      selected === key && slot === name ? "true" : undefined
                    }
                    onClick={() =>
                      navigate(() => {
                        setSelected(key);
                        setSlot(name);
                        setCreate(false);
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    ↳ {name}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            ))}
        </aside>
        <article className="application-editor" key={formEpoch}>
          {create ? (
            <>
              <h2>Добавить библиотеку</h2>
              <label>
                ID библиотеки
                <input
                  value={id}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setId(e.target.value);
                    markChildDirty(true, "create");
                  }}
                />
              </label>
              <div className="row">
                <small>
                  По умолчанию — имя выбранной библиотеки. Можно изменить до
                  создания.
                </small>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="outline"
                  disabled={busy || !ref || id === ref.split("@")[0]}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setId(ref.split("@")[0]);
                    markChildDirty(true, "create");
                  }}
                >
                  Сбросить ID к имени библиотеки
                </button>
              </div>
              <label>
                Пакет
                <select
                  value={ref}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setRef(e.target.value);
                    if (!id || id === ref.split("@")[0])
                      setId(e.target.value.split("@")[0]);
                    markChildDirty(true, "create");
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="">Выберите пакет</option>
                  {Object.values(packages)
                    .map(objectValue)
                    .filter((p) => p.kind === "library")
                    .map((p) => (
                      <option key={String(p.ref)}>{String(p.ref)}</option>
                    ))}
                </select>
              </label>
              <label>
                Docker runtime
                <select
                  value={selectedRuntime}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setRuntime(e.target.value);
                    markChildDirty(true, "create");
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="">Выберите deployment</option>
                  {runtimeOptions.map((key) => (
                    <option key={key}>{key}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </label>
              <p>Совместимость runtime и пакета проверяет Core.</p>
              <button
                disabled={busy || !id || !ref || !selectedRuntime}
                onClick={() =>
                  void send({
                    operation: "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment",
                    deploymentId: id,
                    entity: { libraryRef: ref, runtimeRef: selectedRuntime },
                  }).then((ok) => {
                    if (ok) {
                      markChildDirty(false, "create");
                      setSelected(id);
                      setCreate(false);
                    }
                  })
                }
              >
                В черновик
              </button>
            </>
          ) : !Object.hasOwn(libraries, selected) ? (
            <p>Выберите библиотеку или приложение.</p>
          ) : (
            <>
              <header>
                <div className="application-breadcrumb">
                  <button
                    className="application-link"
                    onClick={() =>
                      navigate(() => {
                        setSlot("");
                        setTab("Общее");
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    {selected}
                  </button>
                  {slot && <span> / {slot}</span>}
                </div>
                <h2>{slot || selected}</h2>
                <small>
                  {String(
                    slot
                      ? (slotDefinition.applicationRef ?? "Пакет недоступен")
                      : library.libraryRef,
                  )}
                </small>
                {slot && (
                  <button
                    className="outline"
                    disabled={busy || !Object.keys(authored).length}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (
                        window.confirm(
                          "Сбросить настройки экземпляра к пакету? Это не отключает приложение и не удаляет установленные ресурсы.",
                        )
                      )
                        void send({
                          operation: "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot",
                          deploymentId: selected,
                          entityId: slot,
                        });
                    }}
                  >
                    Сбросить настройки
                  </button>
                )}
                {((slot && selectedTab === "Запуск") ||
                  (!slot && selectedTab === "Общие параметры")) && (
                  <button
                    className="outline"
                    disabled={busy || addingEnvironment}
                    onClick={() => setAddingEnvironment(true)}
                  >
                    Добавить параметр
                  </button>
                )}
                <nav className="application-tabs">
                  {tabs.map((t) => (

                              Object.keys(value).length
                                ? override("parameters", value)
                                : remove("parameters"),
                            )
                          }
                        />
                        <p className="muted">
                          Значения для шаблонов конфигурации пакета; не ENV.
                        </p>
                      </section>
                    )}
                  </>
                )}

                {slot && selectedTab === "Секреты" && (
                  <>
                    <h3>Секреты подключений</h3>
                    <p>
                      Подключения настраиваются в библиотеке. Здесь — источники
                      секретов, переменные приложения и права. Пароли — только в
                      сессии.
                    </p>
                    <ApplicationCredentials
                      secretSession={
                        loadSecrets && saveSecrets
                          ? {
                              projectRevision: managed?.projectRevision ?? "",
                              contextKey: executionContextKey,
                              libraryId: selected,
                              disabled: busy || !freshSecrets,
                              availability:
                                freshSecrets &&
                                secretAvailability &&
                                secretAvailability?.snapshot === snapshot &&
                                secretAvailability.scope === secretScope
                                  ? secretAvailability.value
                                  : undefined,
                              load: loadApplicationSecrets,
                              save: saveApplicationSecrets,
                            }
                          : undefined
                      }
                      resolvedAccounts={resolvedSecretAccounts}
                      sharedSecretRefs={Object.keys(secretRefCounts).filter(
                        (ref) => secretRefCounts[ref] > 1,
                      )}
                      renderVariables={(account, field) => (
                        <ApplicationSecretBindings
                          credential={{ account, field }}
                          value={objectValue(overrides.provisioner)}
                          defaults={objectValue(defaults.provisioner)}
                          accounts={[]}
                          disabled={busy}
                          onDirtyChange={(v) =>
                            markChildDirty(
                              v,
                              `secret_bindings:${account}:${field}`,
                            )
                          }
                          onSave={(value) =>
                            send(
                              Object.keys(value).length
                                ? override("provisioner", value)
                                : remove("provisioner"),
                            )
                          }
                        />
                      )}
                      variableBindings={{
                        ...objectValue(
                          objectValue(defaults.provisioner).secret_bindings,
                        ),
                        ...objectValue(
                          objectValue(overrides.provisioner).secret_bindings,
                        ),
                      }}
                      resources={objectValue(library.resources)}
                      resolvedResources={resolvedResources}
                      deploymentTypes={Object.fromEntries(
                        Object.entries(managed?.deployments ?? {}).map(
                          ([id, row]) => [id, row.serviceType],
                        ),
                      )}
                      bindings={objectValue(library.bindings)}
                      onDirtyChange={markChildDirty}
                      defaults={defaults}
                      authored={authored}
                      connections={appConnections}
                      disabled={busy}
                      onSave={(accounts) =>
                        send({
                          operation: "SetApplicationLibrarySlot",
                          deploymentId: selected,
                          entityId: slot,
                          entity: { accounts },
                        })
                      }
                    />
                    {draftActive && (
                      <p>
                        Для сессионного ввода сначала сохраните проект и
                        проверьте текущую ревизию.
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </>
                )}
                {slot && selectedTab === "Файлы" && (
                  <>
                    <ApplicationFileSettings
                      key={
                        selected + slot + JSON.stringify(overrides.config_files)
                      }
                      authored={overrides.config_files}
                      defaults={defaults.config_files}
                      disabled={busy}
                      onDirtyChange={(v) => markChildDirty(v, "files")}
                      onSave={(value) => send(override("config_files", value))}
                      onReset={() => send(remove("config_files"))}
                    />
                    <p>
                      AppRole identity и runtime paths разрешает Core. Значения
                      секретов не сохраняются в файлы проекта.
                    </p>
                  </>
                )}

                {slot && selectedTab === "Состояние" && (
                  <>
                    <p>
                      Расчёт для сохранённой ревизии:{" "}
                      {snapshot?.projectRevision ?? "Не рассчитано"}.{" "}
                      {intents.length > 0 && "Есть изменения проекта."}
                    </p>
                    <p>
                      Origin: ANSIBLE / RESOLUTION_SCOPE; точный источник
                      каждого поля не определяется.
                    </p>
                    <details className="application-state-diagnostics">
                      <summary>
                        Рассчитанная конфигурация · диагностика Core
                      </summary>
                      <pre>
                        {JSON.stringify(
                          Object.fromEntries(
                            Object.entries(resolved?.instances ?? {}).filter(
                              ([, instance]) => instance.slotId === slot,
                            ),
                          ),
                          null,
                          2,
                        )}
                      </pre>
                    </details>
                    <p>
                      Работа контейнера, подключения и endpoint Verify: нет
                      текущих данных наблюдения. Результаты запусков доступны на
                      странице установки.
                    </p>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
          <footer>
            <div className="application-draft-status">
              <strong>
                {intents.length
                  ? `В черновике: ${intents.length}`
                  : "Нет изменений"}
              </strong>
              <small>Сохранение не запускает установку</small>
            </div>
            <button
              className="outline"
              disabled={busy || intents.length === 0 || dirty}
              onClick={onReview}
            >
              Показать изменения проекта
            </button>
            {dirty && (
              <span role="status">
                Есть ввод, ещё не добавленный в черновик
              </span>
            )}
          </footer>
        </article>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type {
  OpenResult,
  SessionCredentialStatus,
  VerificationStatus,
  VerifiedPKIView,
} from "./backend";

export type CertificateIntent =
  | {
      operation:
        | "CreateCertificateAuthority"
        | "UpdateCertificateAuthority"
        | "CreateCertificateProfile"
        | "UpdateCertificateProfile"
        | "CreateTLSProfile"
        | "UpdateTLSProfile"
        | "CreateCertificateScope"
        | "UpdateCertificateScope";
      entityId: string;
      entity: Record<string, unknown>;
    }
  | {
      operation:
        | "DeleteCertificateAuthority"
        | "DeleteCertificateProfile"
        | "DeleteTLSProfile"
        | "DeleteCertificateScope";
      entityId: string;
    };

type PKIKind = "authority" | "profile" | "tls" | "scope";
type PKIEntity = Record<string, unknown>;
type Rows = Record<string, PKIEntity>;
export type CertificateSourceOptions = {
  hosts: string[];
  deployments: string[];
  members: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>;
};

const labels: Record<PKIKind, string> = {
  authority: "Управляемые центры сертификации",
  profile: "Профили сертификатов",
  tls: "Профили TLS",
  scope: "Области применения сертификатов",
};
const kindOrder: PKIKind[] = ["authority", "profile", "tls", "scope"];
const dependencyHints: Record<PKIKind, string> = {
  authority: "Используется в профилях сертификатов.",
  profile: "Ссылается на центр сертификации.",
  tls: "Использует профиль сертификата.",
  scope: "Тоже использует профиль сертификата.",
};
const operations: Record<
  PKIKind,
  {
    create: CertificateIntent["operation"];
    update: CertificateIntent["operation"];
    remove: CertificateIntent["operation"];
  }
> = {
  authority: {
    create: "CreateCertificateAuthority",
    update: "UpdateCertificateAuthority",
    remove: "DeleteCertificateAuthority",
  },
  profile: {
    create: "CreateCertificateProfile",
    update: "UpdateCertificateProfile",
    remove: "DeleteCertificateProfile",
  },
  tls: {
    create: "CreateTLSProfile",
    update: "UpdateTLSProfile",
    remove: "DeleteTLSProfile",
  },
  scope: {
    create: "CreateCertificateScope",
    update: "UpdateCertificateScope",
    remove: "DeleteCertificateScope",
  },
};

function rowsFor(
  kind: PKIKind,
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: CertificateIntent[],
): Rows {
  const pki = managed?.pki;
  const source =
    kind === "authority"
      ? pki?.authorities
      : kind === "profile"
        ? pki?.profiles
        : kind === "tls"
          ? pki?.tlsProfiles
          : pki?.scopes;
  const rows: Rows = { ...(source || {}) };
  for (const intent of intents) {
    const operation = operations[kind];
    if (
      (intent.operation === operation.create ||
        intent.operation === operation.update) &&
      "entity" in intent
    )
      rows[intent.entityId] = intent.entity;
    if (intent.operation === operation.remove) delete rows[intent.entityId];
  }
  return rows;
}

const stringList = (value: unknown) =>
  Array.isArray(value)
    ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string")
    : [];
const listText = (value: unknown) => stringList(value).join(", ");
const parseList = (value: string) =>
  value
    .split(",")
    .map((item) => item.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
const asRecord = (value: unknown): PKIEntity =>
  value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? (value as PKIEntity)
    : {};

function secretRefLabel(value: unknown) {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.startsWith("runtime:")
    ? "runtime:••••"
    : "не задана";
}

export function CertificatesPage({
  managed,

  busy,
  structuralDisabled,
  commandCount,
  sourceOptions,
  verification,
  verifiedPKI,
  credentialStatus,
  onAppend,
  onSetPKIStorePassword,
  onReview,
  onDiscard,
  onVerify,
  onReturnToServices,
}: {
  managed: OpenResult["managed"];
  intents: CertificateIntent[];
  busy: boolean;
  structuralDisabled: boolean;
  commandCount: number;
  sourceOptions: CertificateSourceOptions;
  verification?: VerificationStatus;
  verifiedPKI?: VerifiedPKIView;
  credentialStatus?: SessionCredentialStatus | null;
  onAppend: (intent: CertificateIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
  onSetPKIStorePassword?: (value: string) => Promise<SessionCredentialStatus>;
  onReview: () => void;
  onDiscard: () => void;
  onVerify?: () => void;
  onReturnToServices?: () => void;
}) {
  const [editor, setEditor] = useState<{ kind: PKIKind; id?: string } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [selectedKind, setSelectedKind] = useState<PKIKind>("authority");
  const blocked = busy || structuralDisabled || commandCount >= 16;
  const pkiPasswordPresent =
    credentialStatus?.pkiStorePasswordStatus === "PRESENT";
  const allRows = useMemo(
    () => ({
      authority: rowsFor("authority", managed, intents),
      profile: rowsFor("profile", managed, intents),
      tls: rowsFor("tls", managed, intents),
      scope: rowsFor("scope", managed, intents),
    }),
    [managed, intents],
  );
  const remove = async (kind: PKIKind, entityId: string) => {
    if (
      await onAppend({
        operation: operations[kind].remove as CertificateIntent["operation"],
        entityId,
      } as CertificateIntent)
    )
      setEditor(null);
  };

  return (
    <section className="certificates-page">
      <div className="title">
        <div>
          {onReturnToServices && (
            <button className="outline" onClick={onReturnToServices}>
              Вернуться к настройке сервиса
            </button>
          )}
          <h1>Сертификаты</h1>
          <p>
            Желаемые параметры сертификатов проекта. Выпуск и применение
            сертификатов выполняются отдельно.
          </p>
        </div>
        <DraftActions
          commandCount={commandCount}
          blocked={blocked}
          onReview={onReview}
          onDiscard={onDiscard}
        />
      </div>
      <section
        className="certificate-dependency-guide"
        aria-labelledby="certificate-dependency-heading"
      >
        <div>
          <h2 id="certificate-dependency-heading">
            Порядок настройки и зависимости
          </h2>
          <p>
            Сначала центр и профиль сертификата; TLS-профиль и область
            применения — независимые ветви.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div
          className="certificate-dependency-flow"
          role="img"
          aria-label="Центр сертификации ведёт к профилю сертификата; от него независимо зависят профиль TLS и область применения"
        >
          <div className="certificate-dependency-chain">
            <span>1 · Центр сертификации</span>
            <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
            <span>2 · Профиль сертификата</span>
          </div>
          <div className="certificate-dependency-branches">
            <div>
              <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
              <span>3 · Профиль TLS</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span aria-hidden="true">↘</span>
              <span>4 · Область применения</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <div className="certificate-workspace">
        <nav className="certificate-type-nav" aria-label="Разделы сертификатов">
          {kindOrder.map((kind, index) => (
            <button
              key={kind}
              type="button"
              className={`certificate-type-option${
                selectedKind === kind ? " selected" : ""
              }`}
              aria-label={labels[kind]}
              aria-current={selectedKind === kind ? "page" : undefined}
              onClick={() => setSelectedKind(kind)}
            >
              <span className="certificate-type-title">
                <span className="certificate-type-step">{index + 1}</span>
                <span>{labels[kind]}</span>
                <span className="certificate-type-count">
                  {Object.keys(allRows[kind]).length}
                </span>
              </span>
              <small>{dependencyHints[kind]}</small>
            </button>
          ))}
        </nav>
        <article
          className="card certificate-section"

        >
          <div className="section-head">

              <small>{sectionHint(selectedKind)}</small>
            </div>
            <button
              className="outline"
              disabled={blocked}
              onClick={() => setEditor({ kind: selectedKind })}
            >
              Добавить
            </button>
          </div>
          <CertificateRows
            kind={selectedKind}
            rows={allRows[selectedKind]}
            disabled={blocked}
            onEdit={(id) => setEditor({ kind: selectedKind, id })}
            onDelete={remove}
          />
          {selectedKind === "tls" && pkiPasswordPresent && (
            <p className="muted" role="status">
              Пароль PKCS#12 сохранён в текущем сеансе. В проект он не записывается.
            </p>
          )}
        </article>
      </div>
      <CoreVerification
        verification={verification || { status: "UNVERIFIED" }}
        view={verifiedPKI}
        disabled={
          busy ||
          commandCount > 0 ||
          verification?.status === "VERIFYING" ||
          !onVerify
        }
        onVerify={onVerify || (() => undefined)}
      />
      {editor && (
        <CertificateDialog
          key={`${editor.kind}:${editor.id || "new"}`}
          kind={editor.kind}
          entityId={editor.id}
          entity={editor.id ? allRows[editor.kind][editor.id] : undefined}
          authorityIds={Object.keys(allRows.authority).sort()}
          profileIds={Object.keys(allRows.profile).sort()}
          sourceOptions={sourceOptions}
          disabled={blocked}
          pkiPasswordPresent={pkiPasswordPresent}
          onSetPKIStorePassword={onSetPKIStorePassword}
          onClose={() => setEditor(null)}
          onSubmit={async (entityId, entity) => {
            const operation = editor.id
              ? operations[editor.kind].update
              : operations[editor.kind].create;
            if (
              await onAppend({
                operation: operation as CertificateIntent["operation"],
                entityId,
                entity,
              } as CertificateIntent)
            )
              setEditor(null);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
