import type { OpenResult } from "./backend";
export type ObjectValue = Record<string, unknown>;
export type ApplicationIntent = {
  operation:
    | "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment"
    | "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment"
    | "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment"
    | "SetApplicationLibrarySlot"
    | "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot"
    | "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement"
    | "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement"
    | "SetApplicationLibraryOverride"
    | "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride";
  deploymentId: string;
  entityId?: string;
  hostId?: string;
  entity?: ObjectValue;
  placement?: ObjectValue;
  property?: string;
  setting?: string;
  value?: unknown;
};
export const isApplicationIntent = (value: {
  operation: string;
}): value is ApplicationIntent =>
  value.operation.includes("ApplicationLibrary");
export const objectValue = (value: unknown): ObjectValue =>
  value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? (value as ObjectValue)
    : {};
// This projects authored edit intents only. No inheritance/resolution is performed.
export function applicationDraft(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: ApplicationIntent[],
) {
  const libraries = Object.assign(
    Object.create(null),
    structuredClone(managed?.applicationLibraries ?? {}),
  ) as Record<string, ObjectValue>;
  const placements = Object.assign(
    Object.create(null),
    structuredClone(managed?.applicationPlacements ?? {}),
  ) as Record<string, ObjectValue>;
  for (const c of intents) {
    const id = c.deploymentId;
    if (c.operation === "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment")
      libraries[id] = { ...c.entity };
    else if (c.operation === "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment")
      delete libraries[id];
    else if (c.operation === "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment")
      libraries[id] = { ...libraries[id], ...c.entity };
    else if (c.hostId && c.operation.endsWith("Placement")) {
      placements[c.hostId] ??= {};
      if (c.operation.startsWith("Remove")) delete placements[c.hostId][id];
      else placements[c.hostId][id] = { ...c.placement };
    } else if (c.operation.endsWith("Slot")) {
      const apps = objectValue(libraries[id]?.applications);
      if (c.operation.startsWith("Remove")) delete apps[c.entityId!];
      else
        apps[c.entityId!] = { ...objectValue(apps[c.entityId!]), ...c.entity };
      libraries[id] = { ...libraries[id], applications: apps };
    } else if (c.setting) {
      let target: ObjectValue;
      if (c.hostId) {
        placements[c.hostId] ??= {};
        const member = objectValue(placements[c.hostId][id]);
        target = objectValue(member.overrides);
        member.overrides = target;
        placements[c.hostId][id] = member;
      } else if (c.entityId) {
        libraries[id] ??= {};
        const apps = objectValue(libraries[id].applications);
        const slot = objectValue(apps[c.entityId!]);
        target = objectValue(slot.overrides);
        slot.overrides = target;
        apps[c.entityId!] = slot;
        libraries[id].applications = apps;
      } else {
        libraries[id] ??= {};
        target = objectValue(libraries[id].overrides);
        libraries[id].overrides = target;
      }
      const fields = c.property ? objectValue(target[c.property]) : target;
      if (c.operation.startsWith("Remove")) delete fields[c.setting];
      else
        Object.defineProperty(fields, c.setting, {
          value: c.value,
          enumerable: true,
          writable: true,
          configurable: true,
        });
      if (c.property) target[c.property] = fields;
    }
  }
  return { libraries, placements };
}

import type { InstallationEventView, ProjectBackend } from "./backend";

declare global {
  interface Window {
    __PI_BROWSER_READY__?: Promise<void>;
    __PI_BROWSER_LEASE__?: string;
  }
}

async function browserReady(): Promise<string> {
  if (!window.__PI_BROWSER_READY__) throw new Error("BROWSER_HOST_UNAVAILABLE");
  await window.__PI_BROWSER_READY__;
  const lease = window.__PI_BROWSER_LEASE__;
  if (!lease) throw new Error("BROWSER_TAB_LEASE_UNAVAILABLE");
  return lease;
}

async function invoke<T>(operation: string, args: unknown[] = []): Promise<T> {
  const lease = await browserReady();
  const response = await fetch(`/api/call/${encodeURIComponent(operation)}`, {
    method: "POST",
    credentials: "same-origin",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(args),
  });
  const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
    result?: T;
    error?: { code?: string };
  };
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new Error(payload.error?.code || "BROWSER_API_REQUEST_FAILED");
  return payload.result as T;
}

function promptExecutionNodePath(purpose: string): string {
  return (
    window.prompt(
      `${purpose}\nУкажите абсолютный путь на Linux Execution Node.`,
    ) || ""
  ).trim();
}

function chooseBrowserFile(): Promise<File | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = "file";
    input.accept = ".json,.age,application/json";
    input.onchange = () => resolve(input.files?.[0] || null);
    input.addEventListener("cancel", () => resolve(null), { once: true });
    input.click();
  });
}

function toBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let binary = "";
  const chunkSize = 0x8000;
  for (let offset = 0; offset < bytes.length; offset += chunkSize) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(
      ...bytes.subarray(offset, offset + chunkSize),
    );
  }
  return btoa(binary);
}

async function choosePendingRuntimeSecretFile(
  input: Parameters<
    NonNullable<ProjectBackend["choosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile"]>
  >[0],
): Promise<string> {
  const file = await chooseBrowserFile();
  if (!file) return "CANCELLED";
  if (file.size === 0 || file.size > 131_072)
    throw new Error("SECRET_FILE_INVALID");
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
  try {
    return await invoke("choosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile", [
      input,
      toBase64(bytes),
    ]);
  } finally {
    bytes.fill(0);
  }
}

function sleep(milliseconds: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));
}

function subscribeEvents(
  handler: (value: {
    subscriptionId?: string;
    event?: InstallationEventView;
    errorCode?: string;
  }) => void,
): () => void {
  let stopped = false;
  let lastEventID = "";
  let controller: AbortController | undefined;
  const readStream = async (response: Response) => {
    if (!response.body) throw new Error("BROWSER_EVENT_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE");
    const reader = response.body.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let buffer = "";
    let frame: { id?: string; data: string[] } = { data: [] };
    const dispatch = () => {
      if (frame.id) lastEventID = frame.id;
      if (frame.data.length) {
        try {
          const message = JSON.parse(frame.data.join("\n")) as {
            name?: string;
            payload?: {
              subscriptionId?: string;
              event?: InstallationEventView;
              errorCode?: string;
            };
          };
          if (message.name === "installation-run-event" && message.payload)
            handler(message.payload);
        } catch {
          // Ignore malformed event frames; the next frame remains usable.
        }
      }
      frame = { data: [] };
    };
    while (!stopped) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
      let boundary = buffer.indexOf("\n");
      while (boundary >= 0) {
        const line = buffer.slice(0, boundary).replace(/\r$/, "");
        buffer = buffer.slice(boundary + 1);
        if (line === "") dispatch();
        else if (!line.startsWith(":")) {
          const separator = line.indexOf(":");
          const field = separator < 0 ? line : line.slice(0, separator);
          const valueText =
            separator < 0 ? "" : line.slice(separator + 1).replace(/^ /, "");
          if (field === "id") frame.id = valueText;
          else if (field === "data") frame.data.push(valueText);
        }
        boundary = buffer.indexOf("\n");
      }
    }
    try {
      await reader.cancel();
    } catch {
      // Stream already closed.
    }
  };
  const connect = async () => {
    const lease = await browserReady();
    controller = new AbortController();
    const headers = new Headers({ "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease });
    if (lastEventID) headers.set("Last-Event-ID", lastEventID);
    const response = await fetch("/api/events", {
      method: "GET",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers,
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("BROWSER_EVENT_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE");
    await readStream(response);
  };
  void (async () => {
    let delay = 250;
    while (!stopped) {
      try {
        await connect();
        delay = 250;
      } catch {
        if (stopped) return;
      }
      if (!stopped) {
        await sleep(delay);
        delay = Math.min(delay * 2, 5000);
      }
    }
  })();
  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    controller?.abort();
  };
}

async function requestExit(): Promise<{
  status: "EXITING" | "EXIT_AFTER_RUN";
}> {
  const lease = await browserReady();
  const response = await fetch("/api/exit", {
    method: "POST",
    credentials: "same-origin",
    headers: { "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease },
  });
  const result = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
    status?: "EXITING" | "EXIT_AFTER_RUN";
    error?: { code?: string };
  };
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new Error(result.error?.code || "BROWSER_EXIT_FAILED");
  return { status: result.status || "EXITING" };
}

export function startBrowserActivityKeepAlive(): () => void {
  const touchInterval = 10_000;
  let lastTouch = 0;
  let timer = 0;
  let stopped = false;
  const touch = async () => {
    timer = 0;
    if (stopped || document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
    lastTouch = Date.now();
    const lease = await browserReady().catch(() => "");
    if (!lease || stopped) return;
    void fetch("/api/heartbeat", {
      method: "POST",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers: { "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease },
    }).catch(() => undefined);
  };
  const schedule = () => {
    if (stopped || timer) return;
    const delay = Math.max(0, touchInterval - (Date.now() - lastTouch));
    timer = window.setTimeout(() => void touch(), delay);
  };
  const activity = () => schedule();
  const visibility = () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === "visible") {
      lastTouch = 0;
      schedule();
    }
  };
  for (const eventName of [
    "pointerdown",
    "keydown",
    "input",
    "change",
    "focusin",
  ])
    document.addEventListener(eventName, activity, true);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
    for (const eventName of [
      "pointerdown",
      "keydown",
      "input",
      "change",
      "focusin",
    ])
      document.removeEventListener(eventName, activity, true);
    document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
  };
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"frontend/src/event-format.ts","mode":420,"size":754,"sha256":"fd64f4c499baef2986196d77180b668aeca5d49292d437e08bfe937979c508c3","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":754}
import type { InstallationEventView } from "./backend";

export function eventTimestampLabel(timestamp: string): string {
  const date = new Date(timestamp);
  if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return "время неизвестно";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", {
    dateStyle: "short",
    timeStyle: "medium",
  }).format(date);
}

export function taskNameWithoutRole(
  event: InstallationEventView,
): string | undefined {
  const name = event.task?.name;
  const role = event.task?.role?.trim();
  if (!name || !role || !name.startsWith(role)) return name;

  const remainder = name.slice(role.length);
  const separator = remainder.match(/^\s*:\s*/);
  return separator ? remainder.slice(separator[0].length) || name : name;
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"frontend/src/executionNodeLabels.ts","mode":420,"size":5577,"sha256":"6acb13e2e3f0a36f0163f3964630b76cfa82fc3353ef5a36a304818441230716","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":5577}
// Presentation only: runtime identity and capability decisions remain in Go.
export function executionNodeStatusLabel(status?: string): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "NOT_CONFIGURED": return "Не настроен";
    case "NOT_PREPARED":
    case "UNPREPARED": return "Не подготовлен";
    case "UNREACHABLE": return "Недоступен";
    case "PREPARATION_REQUIRED": return "Требуется подготовка";
    case "UPDATE_REQUIRED": return "Требуется обновление";
    case "INCOMPATIBLE": return "Несовместим";
    case "BROKEN": return "Ошибка узла";
    case "READY": return "Готов";
    default: return "Состояние неизвестно";
  }
}

export function executionNodeSelectionLabel(source?: string): string {
  switch (source) {
    case "NONE": return "Не выбран";
    case "EXPLICIT": return "Выбран вручную";
    case "AUTO_LOCAL_LINUX": return "Автоматически: этот компьютер";
    case "AUTO_FIRST_ELIGIBLE": return "Автоматически: первый подходящий сервер";
    default: return "Источник выбора неизвестен";
  }
}

export function executionNodePreparationLabel(status?: string): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED": return "Ожидает подтверждения";
    case "BLOCKED": return "Подготовка недоступна";
    case "PREPARED": return "Подготовлен";
    default: return executionNodeStatusLabel(status);
  }
}

type ExecutionNodeStatusInput = {
  status?: string;
  error?: { message?: string };
  findings?: Array<{ safeMessage: string }>;
  steps?: Array<{ mutates?: boolean }>;
};

export type ExecutionNodeCombinedStatus = {
  label: string;
  tone: "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "neutral";
  detail?: string;
};

export function executionNodeCombinedStatus(
  readiness?: ExecutionNodeStatusInput | null,
  preparation?: ExecutionNodeStatusInput | null,
): ExecutionNodeCombinedStatus {
  if (preparation?.status === "PREPARING") {
    return { label: "Выполняется подготовка", tone: "warning" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "PREPARED") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Подготовлен", tone: "success" };
  }
  if (preparation?.error) {
    return {
      label: "Ошибка подготовки",
      tone: "danger",
      detail: preparation.error.message,
    };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED") {
    if (preparation.steps?.some((step) => step.mutates)) {
      return {
        label: "Проверен: Требуется подготовка",
        tone: "warning",
        detail: "Ожидает подтверждения",
      };
    }
    if (!preparation.steps?.length) {
      return {
        label: "Проверен: Ожидает подтверждения",
        tone: "warning",
      };
    }
    return {
      label: "Проверен: Подготовлен",
      tone: "success",
      detail: "Ожидает подтверждения проверки",
    };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "BLOCKED") {
    return {
      label: "Подготовка недоступна",
      tone: "danger",
      detail: preparation.findings?.map((finding) => finding.safeMessage).join(" · "),
    };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "UNREACHABLE") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Недоступен", tone: "danger" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "INCOMPATIBLE") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Несовместим", tone: "danger" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "BROKEN") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Ошибка узла", tone: "danger" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "UPDATE_REQUIRED") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Требуется обновление", tone: "warning" };
  }
  if (
    preparation?.status === "PREPARATION_REQUIRED" ||
    preparation?.status === "UNPREPARED" ||
    preparation?.status === "NOT_PREPARED"
  ) {
    return { label: "Проверен: Требуется подготовка", tone: "warning" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "READY") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Подготовлен", tone: "success" };
  }
  if (readiness?.error) {
    return {
      label: "Проверка недоступна",
      tone: "danger",
      detail: readiness.error.message,
    };
  }
  if (!readiness) return { label: "Не проверен", tone: "neutral" };
  switch (readiness.status) {
    case "READY":
      return { label: "Проверен: Подготовлен", tone: "success" };
    case "UPDATE_REQUIRED":
      return { label: "Проверен: Требуется обновление", tone: "warning" };
    case "PREPARATION_REQUIRED":
    case "UNPREPARED":
    case "NOT_PREPARED":
      return { label: "Проверен: Требуется подготовка", tone: "warning" };
    case "UNREACHABLE":
      return { label: "Проверен: Недоступен", tone: "danger" };
    case "INCOMPATIBLE":
      return { label: "Проверен: Несовместим", tone: "danger" };
    case "BROKEN":
      return { label: "Проверен: Ошибка узла", tone: "danger" };
    case "NOT_CONFIGURED":
      return { label: "Не проверен: Узел не настроен", tone: "neutral" };
    default:
      return { label: "Состояние неизвестно", tone: "neutral" };
  }
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"frontend/src/installationPresentation.ts","mode":420,"size":7520,"sha256":"f8737f68cdfa94b1e6363afd5edb5d5525cfe2d278dc03c71c8ec7e2c90084b0","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":7520}
import type {
  InstallationEventView,
  InstallationPlanView,
  InstallationRunOperation,
  InstallationState,
} from "./backend";

export type RunProgress = {
  runId: string;
  // Highest sequence observed, which can advance ahead of delivery order.
  lastSequence: number;
  // Highest sequence for which every preceding event has been observed.
  lastContiguousSequence: number;
  pendingSequences: number[];
  complete: boolean;
  actionIds: string[];
  stepParents: Record<string, string>;
  completedActionIds: string[];
  actionOutcomes: Record<string, string>;
  actionOutcomeSequences: Record<string, number>;
  activeActionId?: string;
};

export function beginRunProgress(
  runId: string,
  plan?: InstallationPlanView,
): RunProgress {
  return {
    runId,
    lastSequence: 0,
    lastContiguousSequence: 0,
    pendingSequences: [],
    complete: true,
    actionIds: [
      ...new Set(
        plan?.phases.flatMap((phase) =>
          phase.actions.flatMap((action) =>
            action.progressSteps?.length
              ? action.progressSteps.map((step) => step.id)
              : [action.id],
          ),
        ) || [],
      ),
    ],
    stepParents: Object.fromEntries(
      plan?.phases.flatMap((phase) =>
        phase.actions.flatMap(
          (action) =>
            action.progressSteps?.map((step) => [step.id, action.id]) || [],
        ),
      ) || [],
    ),
    completedActionIds: [],
    actionOutcomes: {},
    actionOutcomeSequences: {},
  };
}

export function observeRunEvent(
  current: RunProgress,
  event: InstallationEventView,
): RunProgress {
  if (event.runId !== current.runId || event.sequence < 1) return current;
  const pending = new Set(current.pendingSequences);
  let contiguous = current.lastContiguousSequence;
  if (event.sequence > contiguous) pending.add(event.sequence);
  while (pending.delete(contiguous + 1)) contiguous += 1;
  const complete = pending.size === 0;
  const isNewest = event.sequence >= current.lastSequence;
  const knownAction =
    !!event.actionId &&
    (current.actionIds.includes(event.actionId) ||
      Object.values(current.stepParents).includes(event.actionId));
  const outcomeRecorded =
    knownAction &&
    event.eventType === "ACTION_COMPLETED" &&
    [
      "SUCCESS",
      "CHANGED",
      "SKIPPED",
      "FAILED",
      "CANCELLED",
      "INTERRUPTED",
    ].includes(event.status);
  const shouldRecordOutcome =
    outcomeRecorded &&
    event.sequence > (current.actionOutcomeSequences[event.actionId!] || 0);
  const actionOutcomes = shouldRecordOutcome
    ? { ...current.actionOutcomes, [event.actionId!]: event.status }
    : current.actionOutcomes;
  const actionOutcomeSequences = shouldRecordOutcome
    ? { ...current.actionOutcomeSequences, [event.actionId!]: event.sequence }
    : current.actionOutcomeSequences;
  const completedActionIds = current.actionIds.filter((actionId) =>
    ["SUCCESS", "CHANGED", "SKIPPED"].includes(actionOutcomes[actionId]),
  );
  return {
    ...current,
    lastSequence: Math.max(current.lastSequence, event.sequence),
    lastContiguousSequence: contiguous,
    pendingSequences: [...pending],
    complete,
    completedActionIds,
    actionOutcomes,
    actionOutcomeSequences,
    activeActionId: !isNewest
      ? current.activeActionId
      : knownAction && event.eventType === "ACTION_STARTED"
        ? event.actionId
        : event.eventType === "ACTION_COMPLETED" &&
            (event.actionId === current.activeActionId ||
              event.actionId ===
                current.stepParents[current.activeActionId || ""])
          ? undefined
          : current.activeActionId,
  };
}

export function actionResultLabel(
  actionId: string,
  runState: string,
  progress?: RunProgress,
): string {
  const outcome = progress?.actionOutcomes[actionId];
  if (outcome === "SUCCESS" || outcome === "CHANGED") return "Успешно";
  if (outcome === "SKIPPED") return "Пропущено";
  if (outcome === "FAILED") return "Ошибка";
  if (outcome === "CANCELLED" || outcome === "INTERRUPTED") return "Прервано";
  if (terminalStates.has(runState) && progress?.activeActionId === actionId)
    return "Не завершено";
  if (!progress?.complete) return "Сведения неполные";
  return runState === "SUCCEEDED" ? "Событие не получено" : "Не подтверждено";
}

// Keep the executable parent visible; child rows are display-only work units.
export function installationActionRows(plan?: InstallationPlanView) {
  return (
    plan?.phases.flatMap((phase) =>
      phase.actions.flatMap((action) => [
        { ...action, parentId: undefined as string | undefined },
        ...(action.progressSteps?.map((step) => ({
          ...action,
          id: step.id,
          summary: step.summary,
          type: "APPLICATION_PROGRESS",
          progressSteps: undefined,
          parentId: action.id,
        })) || []),
      ]),
    ) || []
  );
}

const terminalStates = new Set([
  "SUCCEEDED",
  "FAILED",
  "CANCELLED",
  "INTERRUPTED",
]);
const activeStates = new Set(["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"]);

export function installationDisplay(
  state?: InstallationState,
  run?: InstallationRunOperation,
  progress?: RunProgress,
): {
  label: string;
  detail: string;
  tone: "neutral" | "running" | "failed" | "succeeded";
  percent?: number;
  stage: "plan" | "execution" | "result";
} {
  const runState = run?.run?.state;
  if (runState === "SUCCEEDED") {
    return {
      label: "Установка выполнена",
      detail: "Все действия завершены",
      tone: "succeeded",
      percent: 100,
      stage: "result",
    };
  }
  if (runState && terminalStates.has(runState)) {
    const label =
      runState === "FAILED"
        ? "Ошибка установки"
        : runState === "CANCELLED"
          ? "Установка отменена"
          : "Установка прервана";
    return {
      label,
      detail: "Откройте результат запуска",
      tone: "failed",
      percent: confirmedPercent(progress),
      stage: "result",
    };
  }
  if (runState && activeStates.has(runState)) {
    return {
      label: runState === "CANCELLING" ? "Отмена установки" : "Идёт установка",
      detail: "Откройте ход выполнения",
      tone: "running",
      percent: confirmedPercent(progress),
      stage: "execution",
    };
  }
  if (run?.error) {
    return {
      label: "Запуск не начался",
      detail: "Требуется исправить ошибку",
      tone: "failed",
      stage: "plan",
    };
  }
  if (state?.status === "PLAN_APPROVED" || state?.status === "PLAN_REVIEW") {
    return {
      label: "Установка не начата",
      detail:
        state.status === "PLAN_APPROVED"
          ? "План одобрен"
          : "План ожидает одобрения",
      tone: "neutral",
      stage: "plan",
    };
  }
  return {
    label: "План не готов",
    detail: "Сформируйте свежий план",
    tone: "neutral",
    stage: "plan",
  };
}

function confirmedPercent(progress?: RunProgress): number | undefined {
  if (!progress || progress.actionIds.length === 0) return undefined;
  return Math.min(
    99,
    Math.floor(
      (progress.completedActionIds.length * 100) / progress.actionIds.length,
    ),
  );
}
